cutting.en: Cutting a cake into equal pieces is rather difficult.

fire.en: Did you hear about the fire yesterday?
fire.zh: 你聽說了昨天的火災嗎?

fire.en: Be sure to put out the fire before you leave.
fire.zh: 一定要熄了火，然后再离开。

fever.en: You have a little fever today, don't you?
fever.zh: 你今天是不是有点发烧？

senior.en: Are you a senior high school student?
John is senior to me by two years.

tongue.en: You've got to learn to hold your tongue.
tongue.zh: 你應該學著閉上你的嘴。

choice.zh: 你做了一個明智的選擇。

choice.en: Smoking or health, the choice is yours.
choice.zh: 吸烟还是健康，选择权在你。

wise.zh: 你做了一個明智的選擇。

monday.en: You have to turn in the reports on Monday.
monday.zh: 星期一你必須繳交報告。

reports.en: You have to turn in the reports on Monday.
reports.zh: 星期一你必須繳交報告。

reports.en: We have to turn in our reports by the end of this month.
reports.zh: 这个月底前，我们必须交报告。

resign.en: You should do the honorable thing and resign.
My boss was forced to resign.

plan.en: You must go through with your plan.
plan.zh: 你必须按照你的计划行事。

plan.en: Do you plan to go abroad?

destiny.en: You are the master of your own destiny.
destiny.zh: 你才是自己命运的主人。

destiny.en: Everyone ought to be a master of his own destiny.
destiny.zh: 每個人都應該是自己命運的主宰。

bank.en: You can get a loan from a bank.

loan.en: You can get a loan from a bank.
I do not need a loan anymore.

smoking.en: You should make an effort to stop smoking.

smoke.en: You had better not smoke while on duty.
smoke.zh: 當你值勤時最好不要抽煙。

smoke.en: You smoke far too much. You should cut back.
smoke.zh: 你吸太多煙了。你應該少抽一點。

duty.en: You had better not smoke while on duty.
duty.zh: 當你值勤時最好不要抽煙。

duty.en: What time are you going on duty?

rule.en: I make it a rule not to watch television after nine o'clock.
rule.zh: 我规定自己在九点之后不看电视。

dangerous.en: Nuclear power plants are dangerous, not to mention nuclear weapons.
dangerous.zh: 核电厂具危险性，更不用说核武器了。

territory.en: The armed forces occupied the entire territory.

sheet.en: You are as white as a sheet.
Bring me a sheet of paper, please.

subjects.en: What subjects are you taking at school?
subjects.zh: 你在學校裡讀哪些科目?

subjects.en: I like English best of all subjects.
subjects.zh: 所有学科中，我比较喜欢英语。

grade.en: What grade is your sister in?

suspicious.en: The police are suspicious of my alibi.
suspicious.zh: 警察覺得我的不在場證明可疑。

books.en: How many books do you have?

let.en: Please let me know what you want.
Let me give you some advice.

clubs.en: Do you belong to any clubs?
When we started out, our band could only find small clubs in small cities that would hire us.
clubs.zh: 我們的樂隊剛起步時，只有小城市里的小俱樂部僱我們。

doctor.en: You'd better go to see your family doctor at once.
doctor.zh: 你最好立刻去看你的家庭醫生。

return.en: You should return home before it gets dark.
return.zh: 你應該在天黑之前回家。

return.en: You must return the book to him.

safe.en: You are in a safe place.
The papers that were in the safe are gone.
safe.zh: 放在保險箱裏面的文件不見了。

habits.en: You must rid yourself of bad habits.
Eating habits differ from country to country.
habits.zh: 各國有不同的飲食習慣。

set.en: Hanako is set on going to Paris.

example.zh: 讓我們來研究一個具體的例子。

raincoat.en: You had better put on a raincoat.
Who's the girl in a yellow raincoat?
raincoat.zh: 穿黃色雨衣的女孩是誰？

worker.en: The rescue worker searched the area, looking for the child.
worker.zh: 援救人员为了找到孩子，仔细搜索了那个区域。

apt.en: You are apt to be forgetful.
The rich are apt to look down upon the poor.

adult.en: And yet, in the "real adult world" there are a lot of competitions.
adult.zh: 但是，在「真實的大人世界」裏是有很多競爭的。

support.en: You are now old enough to support yourself.
support.zh: 你已經到了可以自給自足的年紀了。

support.en: Of course I accepted his offer of support.
support.zh: 当然我接受了他的支援请求。

bus.en: Where do I get an airport bus?
bus.zh: 我能在哪里乘上机场巴士？

manufacture.en: You'll have to manufacture some kind of excuse.
manufacture.zh: 你不得不制造一些借口。

manufacture.en: The date of manufacture is shown on the lid.

office.en: Why did you not go to the office?
Please tell me the closest station to your office.
office.zh: 请告诉我离您办公室最近的车站。

accuse.en: Why do you accuse my son?
How can you accuse me of such a thing? I would never lay a hand on my child.
accuse.zh: 你怎么敢指责我做这种事？我决不会动手打我的儿子。

attend.en: Where do you attend high school?
Are you going to attend the meeting?

drinking.en: You should give up smoking and drinking.
Acid rain in drinking water affects human health.
drinking.zh: 飲用水中的酸雨影響人類的健康。

shoes.en: You may think those shoes are in fashion, but they aren't.
shoes.zh: 你可能認為那些鞋子很時髦, 但是他們不是。

shoes.en: Your shoes do not go with the suit.
shoes.zh: 你的鞋子和衣服不合襯。

fashion.en: You may think those shoes are in fashion, but they aren't.
fashion.zh: 你可能認為那些鞋子很時髦, 但是他們不是。

fashion.en: School uniforms are just out of fashion.

market.en: Did you buy it on the black market?
market.zh: 你是在黑市上买的它吗？

market.en: That market has been rapidly expanding.
market.zh: 那個市場一直在急速擴展。

catch.en: You will not be able to catch the train.
You have to study hard to catch up with your class.
catch.zh: 你必須用功讀書趕上同學。

solve.en: None of the teachers could solve the problem.
solve.zh: 所有的老师都无法解决这个问题。

event.en: You make too much of the event.
event.zh: 你對這件事太過重視了。

event.en: In any event, I will do my best.

overcome.en: You have to overcome the difficulties.
How to overcome the high value of the yen is a big problem.
overcome.zh: 如何克服日元升高是个大问题。

difficulties.en: You have to overcome the difficulties.
We have to cope with hosts of difficulties.
difficulties.zh: 我們要面對許多的困難。

owe.en: You owe me an apology for that.
owe.zh: 关于那件事你欠我一个道歉。

result.en: You are responsible for the result.
One of the great superstitions about education is that learning is the result of teaching.
result.zh: 很多人覺得有教才有學，但其實這個觀念是錯的。

deny.en: Do you deny that you went there?
No one can deny the fact.

behavior.en: You must put an end to this foolish behavior.
behavior.zh: 你该结束这种愚蠢的行为了。

behavior.en: Your behavior is creating a lot of problems.
behavior.zh: 你的行為引起了許多的麻煩。

noise.en: You have to put up with all this noise.
noise.zh: 你必须忍受这一切的噪音了。
男孩們，不要製造任何噪音。

suitable.en: You are suitable for the job.
Fill in the blanks with suitable words.
suitable.zh: 請在空格上填上適當的字詞。

starting.en: You're starting to warm up now.

warm.en: You're starting to warm up now.
I want to eat warm soup.

cream.en: You shouldn't have eaten so much ice cream.
cream.zh: 你不應該吃這麼多冰淇淋。

cream.en: I want ice cream for dessert.

ice.en: You shouldn't have eaten so much ice cream.
ice.zh: 你不應該吃這麼多冰淇淋。

ice.en: Low temperatures turn water into ice.

america.en: Have you ever been to America?
Have you visited foreign countries, say America?
america.zh: 你有出國過嗎？譬如說，美國？

committee.zh: 你是委員會中的成員嗎？

committee.en: The committee is composed of three men and seven women.
committee.zh: 委員會是由三男七女組成的。

television.en: Do you know how high the television tower is?
television.zh: 你知道那座電視塔有多高嗎？

television.en: I make it a rule not to watch television after nine o'clock.
television.zh: 我规定自己在九点之后不看电视。

tower.en: Do you know how high the television tower is?
tower.zh: 你知道那座電視塔有多高嗎？

tower.en: We saw the tower in the distance.
tower.zh: 我们远远地就看见了那座塔。

offer.en: You should have refused his offer.
offer.zh: 你應該拒絕他的提議的。

offer.en: It was foolish of you to accept his offer.
offer.zh: 你真笨去接受他的提議。

clean.en: You must always keep your hands clean.
clean.zh: 你应该一直让手保持干净。

clothes.en: You are always digging at me about my clothes.
Laura is very particular about her clothes.

revise.en: In the light of what you told us, I think we should revise our plan.
revise.zh: 根据你所说的话，我认为我们应该重新审视我们的计划。

address.en: Please give me your permanent address.

permanent.en: Please give me your permanent address.
Absolutely nothing is permanent in life.
permanent.zh: 生活中绝对没有什么是持久的。

position.en: The position requires applicants to be skilled in spoken English.
position.zh: 这份职位要求应征者有一定的英语口语表达能力。

prophecy.en: She has a gift for prophecy.

desk.en: Your book is on the desk.
The vase on my desk overturned when I jumped up in surprise.
desk.zh: 我突然跳起来的时候把花瓶桌子上的打翻了。

similar.en: Your problem is similar to mine.
Your bicycle is similar to mine.
similar.zh: 你的腳踏車和我的很相似。

compare.en: Compare your answers with the teacher's.
compare.zh: 把你的答案和老师的比较一下。

suggestion.en: Your suggestion came up at the meeting.
suggestion.zh: 您的建议在会议上提过了。

suggestion.en: Mike said a few words by way of suggestion.
suggestion.zh: 麦克以建议的口气说了些话。

favor.en: I am in favor of your proposal.
Would you do me a favor?

bicycle.en: I will give you a bicycle for your birthday.
bicycle.zh: 你生日的时候，我送你一辆自行车。

bicycle.en: Could you lend me your bicycle for a couple of days?
bicycle.zh: 你能把你的自行车借我两天吗？

field.en: I found the field trip very educational.
field.zh: 我發現實地考察很有教育意義。

major.en: According to some scholars, a major earthquake could occur at any moment now.
major.zh: 据一些学者称，现在可能随时发生一场特大地震。

envy.zh: 你的成功使我感到嫉妒。

blame.en: You have no one but yourself to blame.

cooking.en: Her daughter is bad at cooking.

average.zh: 你的工作表現低於平均水平。

average.en: What is the average height of the players?
average.zh: 选手们的平均身高是多少？

composition.en: Your composition was good except for the spelling.
composition.zh: 你的文章寫得很好，但卻有很多字拼錯了。

composition.en: Your composition is very good, and it has few mistakes.
composition.zh: 你的作文非常好，而且错误很少。

rice.en: Do you eat rice in your country?

rice.zh: 我们日本人以米饭为主食。

dignity.en: Your action has offended his dignity.
dignity.zh: 你的行為已經冒犯了他的尊嚴。

action.en: Your action has offended his dignity.
action.zh: 你的行為已經冒犯了他的尊嚴。

action.en: I leave it in your hands what course of action to take.
action.zh: 接下来该采取什么行动就交给你了。

view.en: As we went around the corner, the lake came into view.
view.zh: 当我们走到转角处，湖就映入了眼帘。

luck.en: A little bit of luck sometimes leads to an unexpected success.
luck.zh: 一點點的運氣有時會導致意想不到的成功。

correspond.en: Your words must correspond with your actions.

become.en: We've become a mockery to the whole village.
become.zh: 我们成了整个村庄的笑柄。

conclusion.zh: 你的结论具有高度争议性。

conclusion.en: We've come to the conclusion that this is a true story.
conclusion.zh: 我們的結論就是，那個傳言是真的。

suit.en: Your shoes do not go with the suit.
suit.zh: 你的鞋子和衣服不合襯。

suit.en: I'll make you a new suit.
suit.zh: 我會給你做一套新衣服。

basic.en: I think your basic theory is wrong.
basic.zh: 我認為你的基本理論是錯的。

basic.en: This law will deprive us of our basic rights.
basic.zh: 这项法律会剥夺我们的基本权利。

remind.en: Your eyes remind me of stars.
remind.zh: 你的眼睛让我想到了星星。

remind.en: Please remind me to post the letter.

house.en: I wish I could live near your house.
Our house was robbed while we were away.
house.zh: 我们走开的时候，房子被盗窃了。

method.en: Your method is different from mine.
method.zh: 你的方法和我的不一樣。

method.en: Such a method is out of date.

track.en: The track meet was called off on account of the heavy rain.
track.zh: 田徑運動會因天雨關係取消了。

dress.en: Tom made Jill a new dress.
dress.zh: 湯姆做了一套新衣服給吉兒。

suitcase.en: What's the weight of your suitcase?
Bob, help me carry his suitcase to the living room.
suitcase.zh: Bob，帮我把他的行李搬到客厅。

weight.en: What's the weight of your suitcase?
She does not eat cake, so as not to put on any more weight.
weight.zh: 她不想一直胖下去，所以正在戒吃蛋糕。

delicious.en: This is the most delicious apple.

size.en: Your camera is only half the size of mine.
size.zh: 你的照相機只有我那台的一半大小。

size.en: What size shoes do you wear?

girlfriend.en: You'll get into trouble if your girlfriend finds out the truth.
girlfriend.zh: 如果你女朋友发现真相的话，你会有麻烦的。

girlfriend.en: Robert enjoyed talking with his girlfriend.
girlfriend.zh: 羅伯特喜歡和他的女朋友談話。

trouble.en: You'll get into trouble if your girlfriend finds out the truth.
trouble.zh: 如果你女朋友发现真相的话，你会有麻烦的。

trouble.en: How can you be so indifferent to your wife's trouble?
trouble.zh: 你妻子遇上麻煩，你怎麼還一副事不關己，己不勞心的樣子？

condition.en: Your mother is in critical condition.
I can on no condition forgive her.

critical.en: Your mother is in critical condition.
I can't understand why you are so critical of him.
critical.zh: 我不明白为什么你这么批评他。

noble.en: Your sister looks as noble as if she were a princess.
noble.zh: 你妹妹看上去那么高贵，就像是个公主一样。

notebook.zh: 我會借給你我的筆記本。

notebook.en: The notebook is not yours. It's his.
notebook.zh: 这本笔记本不是你的，是他的。

punctual.en: I expect you to be punctual.
Compared with her sister, she isn't very punctual.
punctual.zh: 與她的妹妹相比，她不是很準時。

sore.en: I have a very sore arm where you hit me.
sore.zh: 你打在我手臂上的地方超级痛。

concert.en: I would like to go to the concert with you.
concert.zh: 我想和你一起去音乐会。

concert.en: The concert is about to start.

private.en: I would prefer to speak to you in private.
The man turned out to be a private detective.
private.zh: 这个男子竟然是一个私家侦探。

nucleus.en: You two are the nucleus of the team.

team.en: You two are the nucleus of the team.
Your team is stronger than ours.
team.zh: 你們的隊伍比我們的強。

imperative.en: It is imperative for you to act at once.
It is imperative for you to finish by Sunday.
imperative.zh: 你必須在星期日前完成。

baseball.en: He as well as you likes baseball.
What do you play baseball for?

information.en: The information you gave me is of little use.
information.zh: 你給我的資料沒有多大的用處。

information.en: Where is the tourist information office?

object.en: I don't object to your going out to work, but who will look after the children?
object.zh: 我并不反对你出去工作，可是小孩靠谁来照看呢？

object.en: The surface of the object is fairly rough.
object.zh: 這件物件的表面頗為粗糙。

approval.en: With your approval, I would like to offer him the job.
approval.zh: 如果您同意, 我想給他這份工作。

approval.en: He gave me his stamp of approval.

color.en: Choose the color you like the best.
Gold is similar in color to brass.
color.zh: 金的顏色和黃銅很相似。

estimate.en: Try to estimate how much you spent on books.
estimate.zh: 算一算你花了多少錢買書。

estimate.en: At a rough estimate, I would say the job will take two weeks.
estimate.zh: 我想這工作粗略估計得花上兩個星期的時間。

absurd.en: It's absurd of you to do that.
absurd.zh: 你那么做真是太过荒谬了.

absurd.en: It is absurd of you to do that.
absurd.zh: 你那么做真是太过荒谬了.

amount.en: We will pay you according to the amount of work you do.
amount.zh: 我們會按照你的工作量付錢給你。

amount.en: The amount of paper produced by a country is closely related to its cultural standards.
amount.zh: 一个国家纸的产量和它的文明程度密切相关。

york.en: It is out of the question for you to go to New York this weekend.
york.zh: 這個週末去紐約對你來說是不可能的事。

york.en: We moved to New York last fall.
york.zh: 我們去年秋天搬到了紐約。

empty.en: My life would be completely empty without you.
empty.zh: 如果沒有你，我的人生就會變得空白一片。

empty.en: I want a few empty glasses.

description.en: Have you ever seen Mt. Fuji? It is beautiful beyond description.
description.zh: 你看過富士山嗎? 它美得無法形容。

description.en: The beauty of that country is beyond description.
description.zh: 那个国家的美是语言无法形容的。

appearance.en: No one noticed the bear's appearance.
appearance.zh: 誰也沒注意到熊的出現。

appearance.en: Don't judge a person by his appearance.

pair.en: I bought a pair of shoes.
There is a pair of scissors on the desk.

wear.en: What size shoes do you wear?
It's not what you wear, it's how you wear it.
wear.zh: 关键不在穿什么，而是怎么穿。

restaurant.en: I found that restaurant by accident.
restaurant.zh: 我偶然发现了那家餐馆。

restaurant.en: Michael, this is the restaurant where your father and I had our first date.
restaurant.zh: 麥可, 這家餐廳就是你爸爸和我第一次約會的地方。

odd.en: Even times odd is even, odd times odd is odd.
odd.zh: 偶数乘以奇数是偶数，奇数乘以奇数是奇数。

odd.en: One, three, and five are odd numbers.

sauce.en: I'd like the sauce on the side.

airport.en: I'll drive you to the airport.
How far is it to the airport?

accompany.en: I'll accompany you to the airport.
She will accompany me on the piano.

taxi.en: I went to the airport by taxi.
On his arrival at the station, he called a taxi.
taxi.zh: 他到了火车站，就叫了辆出租车。

hand.en: The airport is close at hand.
The rescue workers are going to hand out supplies to the victims of the earthquake.
hand.zh: 救助人员将为地震受灾者发放物资。

hotel.en: How far is it from the airport to the hotel?
I'm staying at the Sheraton Hotel.

air.en: To live without air is impossible.
air.zh: 沒有空氣生活是不可能的。

air.en: Tiny particles in the air can cause cancer.
air.zh: 空气中的微粒可以引发癌症。

cause.en: Tiny particles in the air can cause cancer.
cause.zh: 空气中的微粒可以引发癌症。

cause.en: Slight inattention can cause a great disaster.

pollution.en: Because of the problem of air pollution, the bicycle may some day replace the automobile.
pollution.zh: 因為空氣汙染的問題，也許有一天自行車會取代汽車。

pollution.en: Environmental pollution is causing abnormal weather conditions.
pollution.zh: 環境污染正造成異常的天氣情況。

automobile.en: Because of the problem of air pollution, the bicycle may some day replace the automobile.
automobile.zh: 因為空氣汙染的問題，也許有一天自行車會取代汽車。

automobile.en: In the United States the automobile is a necessity and not a luxury.
automobile.zh: 在美國，汽車並不是奢華的象徵，而是生活的必需品。

various.en: Air is a mixture of various gases.
various.zh: 空氣是由許多種氣體組成的混合物。

indispensable.zh: 空氣是生命中不可或缺的。

indispensable.en: Both air and water are indispensable for life.
indispensable.zh: 沒有空氣和水，人類就無法生存。

quality.en: Air quality has deteriorated these past few years.
quality.zh: 这些年空气质量恶化了。

quality.en: In general, consumers prefer quantity to quality.
quality.zh: 一般來說，消费者喜歡數量勝於質量。

water.en: Both air and water are indispensable for life.
water.zh: 沒有空氣和水，人類就無法生存。

water.en: Gold is far heavier than water.

single.en: There isn't a single cloud in the sky.
Not a single cloud could be seen in the sky.

mass.en: There is a mass of dark clouds in the sky.
Mass production reduced the price of many goods.
mass.zh: 大量生產降低許多商品的價格。

spare.en: We have three spare rooms, none of which can be used.
spare.zh: 虽然有三间空屋，但哪间都用不了。

spare.en: I spend what time I can spare reading.
spare.zh: 我把空閒時間全都花在閱讀上。

bolt.en: A fool's bolt is soon shot.
bolt.zh: 蠢人一下子就把箭射完。

bolt.en: It was like a bolt out of the blue.

lions.en: Lions, wolves, elephants, and horses are all animals.
lions.zh: 狮子，狼，大象，马，这些都是动物。

jungle.en: The lion is the king of the jungle.

jungle.zh: 他写了一本关于丛林冒险的书。

european.en: The European likes to drink wine.
The suits in this row are all made of imported European fabric.
european.zh: 这里一排都是进口面料欧版的西装。

tribe.en: Europeans tried to civilize the tribe.
tribe.zh: 欧洲人试着去教化部落的人

tribe.zh: 部落成员沿着河岸定居了。

traveling.en: While traveling in Europe, I was pickpocketed on a train.
traveling.zh: 我去歐洲旅行的時候，在火車上給人偷了東西。

traveling.en: The train is traveling at the rate of 50 miles an hour.
traveling.zh: 火车以每小时50英里的速度前行。

asia.en: Europe has a smaller population than Asia.
Asia is roughly four times the size of Europe.
asia.zh: 亚洲的大小约四倍于欧洲。

phenomenon.en: Many of Europe's metropolises are plagued by the doughnut phenomenon.
phenomenon.zh: 许多欧洲的大都市饱受“甜甜圈现象”困扰。

phenomenon.en: The aurora is a phenomenon characteristic of the polar regions.
phenomenon.zh: 極光是極地特有的自然現象。

september.en: School starts in September in Europe.
september.zh: 歐洲的學校在九月開學。

september.en: Scotland can be very warm in September.
september.zh: 蘇格蘭在9月可以變的很溫暖。

batter.en: To be a good batter, you've got to hang loose and follow your instincts.
batter.zh: 想成為一個好的擊球手的話，你要在球場上時刻保持鎮定，還要學會相信自己的直覺。

cradle.en: What is learned in the cradle is carried to the tomb.

clock.en: The clock gains five minutes a day.
clock.zh: 那个钟每天都快了五分钟。

skin.en: The skin of peaches bruises easily.

fiber.en: You need to eat more fiber.
fiber.zh: 你要吃多點含膳食纖維的食物。

fiber.en: I love my country with every fiber of my being.

detailed.en: He gave a detailed description of the accident.
detailed.zh: 他詳細地敍述了那場意外的經過。

sizes.en: Do you have any smaller sizes?
sizes.zh: 你有任何比較小的尺寸嗎?

behave.en: You should try to behave better.

behave.zh: 瑪麗要求她的兒子守規矩。

achieve.en: You'll never achieve anything if you don't study harder.
achieve.zh: 如果你不更加努力地學習, 你將永遠不會有所成就。

achieve.en: I have made up my mind to achieve my goals in three years.
achieve.zh: 我下定决心要在三年之内达成目标。

roast.en: How about some more roast beef?
roast.zh: 再多一些烤牛肉怎麼樣?

roast.en: Dad uses fire to roast a chicken.

museum.en: If time permits, I'll visit the museum.
museum.zh: 如果時間允許，我會去參觀博物館。

museum.en: The museum is open from Monday to Friday.
museum.zh: 博物馆周一到周五开门。

unfair.en: It would be unfair if we treated him so badly.
unfair.zh: 我們這樣待他，好像不是太好。

unfair.en: You should've rejected such an unfair proposal.
unfair.zh: 你本该拒绝一个那么不公平的提议。

fly.en: If I were a bird, I could fly to you.
fly.zh: 如果我是一隻小鳥，我就可以飛到你的身邊了。

fly.en: A fly can walk on the ceiling.

successful.en: If I had worked hard in my youth, I would be successful now.
successful.zh: 如果我年輕的時候努力工作, 我現在就成功了。

successful.en: The party was, on the whole, successful.

painting.en: If I had bought the painting then, I would be rich now.
painting.zh: 如果當時買了那幅畫，我現在就是一個富翁了。

painting.en: The value of the painting was estimated at several million dollars.
painting.zh: 这幅画被估价数百万元。

apply.en: If you want this job, you must apply for it by tomorrow.
apply.zh: 如果你想要這份工作的話，就一定要在明天之前申請。

apply.en: I haven't decided which job to apply for.
apply.zh: 我还没确定找哪份工作。

visa.en: If you want to study in the United States, you need to get a student visa.
visa.zh: 你想去美國讀書的話，一定要先申請一張學生簽證。

stores.en: I don't really like the stores there.
stores.zh: 我不是很喜歡那裡的商店。

stores.en: There are many stores on either side of the street.

fluent.en: You will be able to speak fluent English in another few months.
fluent.zh: 再過兩、三個月，你就能說得一口流利的英語了。

fluent.en: Tom is a fluent speaker of Japanese.

sugar.en: Put in a little more sugar.
The store sells foodstuffs, such as butter, cheese, and sugar.
sugar.zh: 這家店賣的是牛油、奶酪、砂糖之類的食品。

discount.en: Can you give me a discount?
We give a 10% discount for cash.
discount.zh: 如用現金付款，我們給予九折優惠。

barely.en: I barely escaped being hit by the truck.

salad.en: Would you like some more salad?
You have the choice of soup or salad.
salad.zh: 你有两种选择，汤，或沙拉。

survival.en: I gave up all hope of survival.
survival.zh: 我放棄了所有生存的希望。

survival.en: Air pollution will be a threat to our survival.
survival.zh: 空气污染将会威胁我们的生存。

patch.en: The Sargasso Sea is a vast patch of ocean named for a genus of free-floating seaweed called Sargassum.
patch.zh: 馬尾藻海是一片廣闊的海域，因一種名為「馬尾藻」的自由漂浮海藻而得名。

spring.en: Sometimes it's good for a married couple to go to a hot spring together—just the two of them.
spring.zh: 兩夫婦應該閒時去浸溫泉，過過二人世界。

knowledge.en: Mary made a cake without her mother's knowledge.
knowledge.zh: 瑪莉不讓母親知道，自己做了一個蛋糕。

knowledge.en: A little knowledge of Spanish will go a long way toward making your trip to Mexico enjoyable.
knowledge.zh: 懂一點西班牙語的話，你去墨西哥一定會玩得更愉快。

beauty.en: Mary prided herself on her beauty.
beauty.zh: 玛丽对她自己的美感到很自豪。

beauty.en: The beauty of that country is beyond description.
beauty.zh: 那个国家的美是语言无法形容的。

dishes.zh: 菜單上有各種各樣的菜色。

dishes.zh: 不久，同样的服务员回来拿起菜。

opportunity.en: All you have to do is take advantage of this rare opportunity.
opportunity.zh: 你所要做的便是好好把握這千載難逢的機會。

opportunity.en: You should avail yourself of every opportunity.
opportunity.zh: 你應該好好利用一切的機會。

jeans.en: Meg was the only girl that was wearing jeans.
jeans.zh: Meg是唯一一个穿牛仔裤的女生。

kitchen.en: Mary went down to the kitchen.

piano.en: Maria takes piano lessons once a week.
piano.zh: 瑪麗亞每週上一次鋼琴課。

attractive.en: Mary has as attractive a personality as her sister.
attractive.zh: 玛丽性格很好，就像她姐姐一样。

farewell.en: I got a farewell present from everyone.
farewell.zh: 每個人都送了我一份歡送禮物。

farewell.zh: 舉行了一場歡送會以紀念瓊斯先生。

allergy.zh: 在过敏的季节不断地擤他的鼻子.

magazine.en: Mick killed time by reading a magazine while waiting for his date.

date.zh: Mick等待约会的时候靠读杂志打发时间。

lessons.en: Maria takes piano lessons once a week.
lessons.zh: 瑪麗亞每週上一次鋼琴課。

model.zh: 迈克吃完早饭以后一直在做一个模型飞机。

model.zh: 我想在买之前先试试这个新机型。

teeth.zh: 麥克上週做了牙齒檢查。

extent.zh: 我們從酒店裏可以把整個公園看得清清楚楚。

rough.en: Boxing is not always a rough sport.

suburb.zh: 海伦和凯蒂在东京郊区租了个套间。

hunting.zh: 海明威喜歡在非洲的大狩獵。

sociology.zh: 弗蘭克在大學主修社會學。

sociology.zh: 那个学生正在学习社会学。

code.zh: 在这个密码里，每个数字取代了一个字母。

decorate.zh: 你可以用一个樱桃或菠萝来装饰这杯鸡尾酒。

decorate.en: People there decorate their homes with potted flowers to add to the festival atmosphere.
decorate.zh: 為了增添節日的氣氛 ，那裡的人用盆栽裝飾他們的家。

desirable.en: It is the things that we do not possess which seem to us most desirable.
desirable.zh: 得不到的东西就最想得到。

discharge.en: The crowd obstructed the police in the discharge of their duties.
discharge.zh: 群众妨碍了警员执行任务。

duties.en: The crowd obstructed the police in the discharge of their duties.
duties.zh: 群众妨碍了警员执行任务。

governments.en: Few governments can manage the economy successfully.
governments.zh: 能把經濟管好的政府不多。

agreement.en: There is not one person who is in agreement with the plan.
agreement.zh: 贊成計劃的人一個也沒有。

cart.en: Sometimes being overcautious in planning could upset the apple cart.
cart.zh: 計劃時如果過於謹慎的話，可能會反把計劃搞亂。

cart.en: I saw a horse pulling a cart.
cart.zh: 我看見一匹馬拉著一架馬車。

theft.en: The police accused him of theft.
Betty has a previous conviction for theft.

crawl.en: I'm so embarrassed I could dig a hole and crawl into it.
crawl.zh: 我窘得想找個洞鑽進去。

crawl.en: She knows how to do the crawl.

wedding.en: Where is the wedding to be?
The wedding will take place on Saturday.

satellite.en: The moon is the earth's only satellite.
satellite.zh: 月球是地球唯一的卫星。

satellite.en: They are going to launch an artificial satellite tomorrow.
satellite.zh: 明天將要發射一顆人造衛星。

eclipse.en: An eclipse of the moon is a rare phenomenon.
eclipse.zh: 月食是一種罕見的現象。

eclipse.en: An eclipse of the sun is a rare appearance.

achievement.en: The moon landing was a monumental achievement.
achievement.zh: 登月是一項里程碑式的成就。

bark.en: A dog will bark at strangers.

profits.en: A wise man profits from his mistakes.
profits.zh: 聰明人會從自己的錯誤中受益。

profits.en: Someone else profits from the situation.

offspring.en: The atomic bomb is the offspring of 20th century physics.
offspring.zh: 原子弹是二十世纪物理学的产物。

stimulate.en: Tax cuts are often used as a major fiscal tool to stimulate the economy.
stimulate.zh: 减税常被用作刺激经济的主要财政手段。
咖啡和茶使我感到兴奋。

unemployment.en: What is the unemployment rate at the moment?
The unemployment rate went up to 5%.

retirement.en: After retirement, Teresa devoted herself to caring for orphans.
retirement.zh: 退休後，德蕾莎投身照顧孤兒的工作。

retirement.en: His income was diminished by half after retirement.
retirement.zh: 退休后他的收入少了一半。

individual.en: She had an individual style of speaking.

decline.en: An increase in customer complaints could signal a decline in business.
decline.zh: 顧客投訴量增加，可能代表生意正在走下坡。

decline.en: Unfortunately I must decline your invitation.
decline.zh: 很遗憾我无法接受您的邀请。

signal.en: An increase in customer complaints could signal a decline in business.
signal.zh: 顧客投訴量增加，可能代表生意正在走下坡。

imperial.en: Meet me at the lobby of the Imperial Hotel at 6:30 p.m.
imperial.zh: 下午六点半到帝国酒店的大堂找我。

imperial.en: Aristocrats lived to the east and west of the imperial palace.
imperial.zh: 贵族住在故宫的东边和西边。

lobby.en: Meet me at the lobby of the Imperial Hotel at 6:30 p.m.
lobby.zh: 下午六点半到帝国酒店的大堂找我。

lobby.en: I have a friend waiting for me in the lobby.
lobby.zh: 有個朋友正在大堂等我。

accidents.en: Speaking of traffic accidents, I saw one last year.
accidents.zh: 说起交通事故，我去年目睹了一场。

accidents.en: Not a day passes without traffic accidents.
accidents.zh: 交通事故没有一天是不在发生的。

regulate.en: Traffic lights are used to regulate traffic.
regulate.zh: 交通燈是用來控制交通的。

refrain.en: Please refrain from smoking in public places.
refrain.zh: 在公共场所请控制自己不要吸烟。

refrain.en: She could not refrain from tears.

role.en: Computers are certainly playing an important role in our life, whether we like it or not.
role.zh: 无论我们是否喜欢电脑，它在我们的生活中始终起着重要的作用。

role.en: He will play the leading role for the first time in the next school festival.
role.zh: 这次校庆时，他将第一次做主角。

graduates.en: The principal presented each of the graduates with diploma.
graduates.zh: 校长向每个毕业生颁发了毕业证书。

diploma.en: The principal presented each of the graduates with diploma.
diploma.zh: 校长向每个毕业生颁发了毕业证书。

campus.en: I met her on campus yesterday.
campus.zh: 我昨天在校園裡遇到了她。

campus.en: In the center of the university campus stands the statue of the founder.
campus.zh: 創校人的雕像在大學校園的中心矗立著。

harbor.en: There are many ships in the harbor.
We saw many ships in the harbor.
harbor.zh: 我們在港口裡看到了許多船。

metal.en: The value of the coins depended on the weight of the metal used.
metal.zh: 钱币的价值取决于所使用的金属的重量。

metal.en: The acid ate into the metal.

strain.en: The rope broke under the strain.
Tom has been under a great deal of strain lately.

surrender.en: I would rather die than surrender.
The garrison was forced to surrender.

disputes.en: International disputes must be settled peacefully.
disputes.zh: 國際間的紛爭一定要用和平的方法來解決。

overseas.en: I'd like to make an overseas call.
His music has attained great popularity overseas.
overseas.zh: 他的音樂在國外很受歡迎。

semester.en: I haven't studied physics much all semester.
semester.zh: 我这学期几乎没学物理。

surplus.en: Our surplus has swelled by nearly ten percent in this quarter.
surplus.zh: 我們公司今季的赤字上漲了差不多一成。

steel.en: Steel production will increase 2% this month from last month.
steel.zh: 今個月的鋼鐵產量和上個月比起來，估計會上升兩個巴仙。

steel.en: According to an estimate, steel production will reach 100 million tons this year.
steel.zh: 一項估計顯示，今年的鋼鉄產量將會達到一億噸。

frost.en: We had a heavy frost this morning.

miracle.en: All Sadako could do now was to make paper cranes and hope for a miracle.
miracle.zh: 今祯子当时能做的就是折纸鹤并期盼奇迹。

miracle.en: Love is the miracle of civilization.

funeral.en: At lunchtime today, our usual restaurant was closed because of a funeral in the family.
funeral.zh: 今天午餐時間，我們常去的飯館關門了，因為他們家在辦喪事。

funeral.en: A great many people attended his funeral.
funeral.zh: 很多人都参加了他的葬礼。

performance.en: I am not satisfied with my performance today.
performance.zh: 我对我今天的表演不满意。

performance.en: What time is the next performance?

minimum.zh: 今天的最低氣溫是三度。

minimum.en: The minimum wage in Okinawa is 642 yen per hour.
minimum.zh: 冲绳的最低时薪是每小时642日元。

deliver.en: We can deliver it this evening.
deliver.zh: 我們今天晚上可以運送它。

mood.en: Dad's in an impatient mood today.
Mother was in a bad mood since she could not play golf because of bad weather.
mood.zh: 因為天氣不好，不能打高爾夫球，所以母親的心情很差。

skill.en: Fluency in English is a very marketable skill today.
skill.zh: 流利的英語在今天是一種十分搶手的技能。

sales.en: Who's in charge of the sales section?

anticipate.en: I anticipate that there will be trouble.
We do not anticipate their buying a new car.
anticipate.zh: 我們認為他們不會買新車。

stressful.en: Men and women between the ages of 25 and 54 have the most stressful lives.
stressful.zh: 25 歲至 54 歲的男女生活壓力最大。

stressful.en: Cities are exciting places, but also stressful.
stressful.zh: 城市是令人興奮的地方，但也會讓人產生壓力。

survey.en: A recent survey shows that the number of smokers is decreasing.
survey.zh: 最近的一项调查显示吸烟的人数减少了。

survey.en: According to the latest survey, 99% of employees want a free iPad.
survey.zh: 根据最新的调查，99%的员工想要一个免费的iPad。

shortage.en: The recent shortage of coffee has given rise to a lot of problems.
shortage.zh: 近来咖啡的短缺造成了许多问题。

shortage.en: There was a shortage of fuel.

prevail.en: Justice will prevail in the end.

prevail.zh: 在哥伦比亚，天主教习俗盛行。

target.en: The first attack missed the target.
target.zh: 第一次攻击错过了目标。

target.en: Her success made her the target of jealousy.
target.zh: 她的成功讓她受盡嫉妒。

maximum.en: Note that the maximum doesn't always exist.
maximum.zh: 注意，最大值不总是存在的。

vegetarian.en: Can you recommend any vegetarian dishes?

triangle.en: Please find the area of the triangle.
A triangle has 3 corners, and a hexagon has 6 corners.
triangle.zh: 三角形有三个角，而六边形有六个角

participants.en: The participants were for the most part women.
There are thousands of participants at today's event.
participants.zh: 有成千的人来参加今天的集会。

accuracy.zh: 准确性在计算中很重要。

accuracy.en: I began to doubt the accuracy of his statement.
accuracy.zh: 我開始懷疑他陳述的準確性。

hydrogen.en: Water consists of hydrogen and oxygen.

accomplish.en: He is sure to accomplish his purpose.
accomplish.zh: 他很肯定可以达到目标。

identify.en: You can identify children's voices without any problem.
identify.zh: 你可以毫无问题地辨别孩子们的声音。

kids.en: How many kids do you have?
The kids are picking flowers in the garden.
kids.zh: 孩子们正在花园里摘花。

recall.en: I recall less and less of my childhood.
recall.zh: 我对童年的记忆越来越模糊了.

recall.en: I can't recall her name at the moment.
recall.zh: 我突然想不起她的名字。

bribe.en: The mayor denied having taken a bribe.

constitution.en: Freedom of thought is guaranteed by the constitution.
constitution.zh: 思想自由為憲法所保障。

constitution.en: Equality is guaranteed by the Constitution.

manager.en: The manager ordered all the rooms to be swept clean as soon as possible.
manager.zh: 經理命令要把所有房間儘快打掃乾淨。
經理批准了我們的計劃。

issues.en: Why don't we stop arguing over these piddling matters and get to the issues at hand?
issues.zh: 為什麼我們糾纏細枝末節而不進入正題呢？

issues.en: These issues have no effect on us.
issues.zh: 这些问题对我们毫无效果。

release.en: With the release of Skype, studying languages has become easier.
release.zh: 学习语言随着Skype的发行而变得更容易。

junk.en: The antiques my father left when he died turned out to be nothing but worthless junk.
junk.zh: 父親生前留下來的老古董，原來只是一堆不值錢的垃圾。

junk.en: Instead of eating real food, we just ate junk food all day.
junk.zh: 我們整天吃的都是雜七雜八的零嘴，並沒有甚麼正規的食物下過肚。

cellar.en: I realized then that this awful cellar was the only place that could save our lives.
cellar.zh: 我意识到这个可怕的地下室是唯一可以救我们命的地方。

cellar.en: Reception in the cellar is very poor.

fossil.en: What I have in my hand is a fossil seashell.
fossil.zh: 在我手裡的是一個貝殼化石。

fossil.en: As a result of some factories using fossil fuels, chemical emissions have already caused serious environmental problems.
fossil.zh: 由于一些工厂使用矿物燃料，化学品的排放已经产生严重的环境问题。

deputy.en: He will be my deputy while I am away.
deputy.zh: 我不在的时候，他将是我的代理人。

considerate.en: You were considerate not to disturb us.
considerate.zh: 你考虑周到，没有打扰我们。

hens.en: Our hens laid a lot of eggs yesterday.
hens.zh: 我們養的母雞昨天生了很多蛋。

echo.en: We heard the echo of our voices from the other side of the valley.
echo.zh: 我們聽見自己說話的回音從山谷的另一邊傳了回來。

bubble.en: Our love affair was as short-lived as a soap bubble.
bubble.zh: 我们的爱情就像肥皂泡一样脆弱。

conform.en: We must conform to the rules.

campaign.en: We started a campaign against smoking.
campaign.zh: 我們開始了一個反對吸煙運動。

campaign.en: Lobbyists for the bill funneled bribes into a campaign fund.
campaign.zh: 該法案的說客把遊說賄款匯入了競選基金。

slope.en: The path zigzagged up the steep slope.
slope.zh: 這條小路沿著陡峭的斜坡蜿蜒而上。

trap.en: We set a trap to catch a fox.
trap.zh: 我们设了个陷阱来抓狐狸。

trap.en: Using a trap, they caught the fox.
trap.zh: 他们利用陷阱捕捉狐狸。

drill.en: We had a fire drill yesterday.
drill.zh: 我們昨天進行了火警演習。

nature.en: We must learn to live in harmony with nature.
nature.zh: 我们必须学会与自然和谐共处。

nature.en: I am an optimist by nature.
nature.zh: 我天生是一個樂觀主義者。

harmony.en: We must learn to live in harmony with nature.
harmony.zh: 我们必须学会与自然和谐共处。

harmony.en: Together, you represent the harmony between tradition and progress.
harmony.zh: 你們共同代表著傳統與進步之間的和諧。

imposing.en: We should try to avoid imposing our own beliefs on others.
imposing.zh: 我們應該盡量避免把我們自己的信念強加在別人身上。

gym.en: We played basketball in the gym.
The crowd poured out of the gym.
gym.zh: 人群從體育館中湧了出來。

methods.en: As far as I could make out, he was experimenting with new methods.
methods.zh: 就我所了解的，他正在實驗新的方法。

amateur.en: My uncle is an amateur cricket player.
I was still an amateur at that time.

cricket.en: My uncle is an amateur cricket player.
That's not a cricket, that's a grasshopper.

outskirts.en: My house is on the outskirts of town.
outskirts.zh: 我的家在那座城市的郊外.

outskirts.en: I live on the outskirts of Tokyo.

grammar.en: According to my experience, it takes one year to master French grammar.
grammar.zh: 根據我的經驗，掌握法語語法需要一年的時間。

accurate.en: Most important of all a clock has to be accurate.
accurate.zh: 一個時鐘最重要的是準確。

response.en: She made no response to my question.
I'm sorry for the late response.

disposal.en: My car is at your disposal.
Oh, I almost forgot! Today is garbage disposal day!
disposal.zh: 啊！差点忘了。今天是扔垃圾的日子！

sincere.en: Any emotion, if it is sincere, is involuntary.
sincere.zh: 任何情绪，只要它是真诚的，就说明它是发自内心的自然流露。

agriculture.en: Agriculture consumes a great amount of water.
agriculture.zh: 農業需要消耗大量的水。

journalist.en: I think of the woman as a journalist.
journalist.zh: 我想到那位當記者的女人。

tender.en: My father was no less affectionate and tender to me than my mother was.
tender.zh: 我爸爸对我的爱和照顾不比我妈妈少。

sake.en: My father doesn't drink so much sake.
I stopped smoking for the sake of my health.

decent.en: Please keep your language decent while my parents are here.
decent.zh: 我父母在的时候，请你言语注意分寸。

decent.en: Finding a decent man is more difficult than winning a lottery.
decent.zh: 找一个好男人比中彩票还要难。

orchard.en: I delight in going to the apple orchard each fall.
orchard.zh: 我樂意每年秋季去蘋果園。

orchard.en: They stole apples from my orchard.
orchard.zh: 他們從我的果園偷了蘋果。

absorb.en: I can't absorb all of the lesson in an hour.
absorb.zh: 我不能一小時內徹底的了解那堂課程。

absorb.en: Trees give off oxygen and absorb carbon dioxide.
absorb.zh: 树木排出氧气，吸收二氧化碳。

goals.en: I have made up my mind to achieve my goals in three years.
goals.zh: 我下定决心要在三年之内达成目标。

goals.en: How do you plan to achieve the goals you set?
goals.zh: 你们准备如何达到你们制定的目标？

objection.en: I have no objection to your plan.
As for me, I have no objection.

cassette.en: I got a video cassette recorder cheap at that shop.
cassette.zh: 我在那商店花低價買了臺錄像機。

cassette.en: My cassette tape recorder needs fixing.
cassette.zh: 我的磁带录音机需要维修。

stubborn.en: I have never come across such a stubborn person.
stubborn.zh: 我从来没碰到过这么倔的人。

floors.en: I prefer hardwood floors to carpet.
floors.zh: 我喜歡硬木地板勝過地毯。

guardian.en: I regard myself as your guardian.
guardian.zh: 我把自己当成你的监护人。

treatment.en: I'm not accustomed to such treatment.
You should stay in the hospital for treatment.
treatment.zh: 你應該留在醫院，接受治療。

kilograms.en: I have put on two kilograms this summer.
kilograms.zh: 这个夏天我胖了两公斤。

thursday.en: I want this work done by next Thursday.
thursday.zh: 我下週四前要這份工作。

thursday.en: It has been raining since last Thursday.
thursday.zh: 從上週四開始一直下雨。

vacuum.en: I got this vacuum cleaner for nothing.
vacuum.zh: 我免費得到了這個吸塵器。

vacuum.en: I sucked up the dust on the floor with a vacuum cleaner.
vacuum.zh: 我用吸塵機把地上的灰塵吸掉了。

draft.en: I am writing a draft of the speech.
Draft beer tastes especially good on a hot day.
draft.zh: 生啤酒在大熱天時特別好喝。

participate.en: I don't want to participate in the ceremony.
The government will provide interest-free loans to firms that participate in the program.
participate.zh: 政府将会对参与该项计划的企业提供无息贷款。

chief.en: I got acquainted with the chief executive.
chief.zh: 我認識了這位行政長官。

chief.en: He is the chief of my department.

underneath.en: I found the key underneath the mat.
underneath.zh: 我在擦鞋墊下面發現了這把鑰匙。

underneath.en: Underneath we wrote the names of the students in our class.
underneath.zh: 下面写上我们班同学的名字。

guest.en: I felt as if I were an uninvited guest.
guest.zh: 我覺得自己像是不請自來似的。

guest.en: I'm back! Oh? Have we got a guest?
guest.zh: 我回来了！啊？我们有客人啊？

sailing.en: I belong to the sailing club.
Several yachts were sailing side by side far out at sea.
sailing.zh: 數艘游艇在遠方的海洋並列航行。

faith.en: I have complete faith in my doctor.
He has something that I don't: faith.
faith.zh: 他有我所沒有的東西: 信心。

devote.en: I intend to devote a few hours a day to the study of English.
devote.zh: 我打算每天花幾個小時來學英文。

devote.en: She seems to devote all her effects to her career.
devote.zh: 她似乎把自己所有的精力都投入到了事业上。

innumerable.en: I have tried innumerable times to contact him.

shell.en: I found a beautiful shell on the shore.
shell.zh: 我在海滩上发现了一个漂亮的贝壳。

shell.en: The shell of an egg is easily broken.

fingers.en: I had no feeling in my fingers.
My fingers are so numb with cold that I can't play the piano.
fingers.zh: 我的手指冻僵了，以至于无法弹钢琴了。

stake.en: I felt that my honor was at stake.
stake.zh: 我覺得我的名譽受到了威脅。

stake.en: I'll stake my reputation on it.

garage.en: I rented a house with a garage.
garage.zh: 我租了一間有車庫的房子。

garage.en: I adapted the garage for use as a workshop.
garage.zh: 我把车库改造成工作室使用。

tremble.zh: 我感覺到我的手在震動

tremble.en: The terrible scene made him tremble in fear.
tremble.zh: 令人震惊的场面让他吓得发抖。

mission.en: I am charged with an important mission.
mission.zh: 我身负一个重要的任务。

mission.en: He was charged with a secret mission.

bedroom.en: I share a bedroom with my sister.
bedroom.zh: 我跟我姐姐共用同一間臥房。

bedroom.en: I could hear her sobbing in her bedroom.
bedroom.zh: 我能聽到她在臥室裡抽泣。

spectacle.en: I need to buy new spectacle frames.

fountain.en: I have lost my new fountain pen.
fountain.zh: 我把我的新鋼筆搞丟了。

bent.en: I bent over to pick up my pen which had fallen on the floor.
bent.zh: 我俯身撿起了掉在地上的筆。

bent.en: He bent over backward to please his wife.
bent.zh: 他竭尽全力地讨好他老婆。

collection.en: I have a large collection of stamps.
I would like to have a look at your collection of stamps.
collection.zh: 我想看看您的邮票收藏。

dim.en: I have a dim memory of my grandmother.
dim.zh: 我对祖母的记忆很模糊。

dim.en: You shouldn't read a book in a room this dim.
dim.zh: 你不應該在這麼暗的房間裏看書。

literature.en: I majored in American literature at college.
literature.zh: 我在大學主修美國文學。

literature.en: He went to America for the purpose of studying American literature.

focus.en: The focus of the discussion was unemployment.

focus.en: Although people like to focus on the differences, I think that on the whole it's the same.
focus.zh: 虽然人们喜欢集中于不同的方面，但是我认为大部分的差不多。

defeat.en: But a man is not made for defeat. A man can be destroyed but not defeated.
defeat.zh: 人不是为失败而生的, 一个人可以被毁灭, 但不能给打败。

defeat.en: To those who would tear the world down: we will defeat you.
defeat.zh: 那些想要颠覆这个世界的人们，我们将击败你们。

flavour.en: If and only if the ice-cream is vanilla flavour will Xiao Wang eat it.
flavour.zh: 当且仅当冰淇淋是香草口味，小王会吃这个冰淇淋。

prominent.zh: 知名文学界人士昨晚齐聚一堂。

representative.en: Who is the current representative from France?
representative.zh: 这个年级的法方代表是谁？

bless.en: Thank you. God bless you. And may God bless the United States of America.
bless.zh: 感谢你们。上帝保佑你们。愿上帝保佑美利坚合众国

clue.en: I haven't got a clue as to why he quit so suddenly.
clue.zh: 我完全不明白他為甚麼會突然辭職。

reimburse.en: Your school is so kind to reimburse you for the return airfare.
reimburse.zh: 你们学校真好，还帮你们报销来回的机票。

literally.en: I didn't literally translate from English into Japanese.
literally.zh: 我没有把英语直译成日语。

create.zh: 大部分程序员讨厌调试，设置故障比纠正它们有意思多了。

create.en: Can an omnipotent God create a stone so heavy that even He may not lift it?
create.zh: 萬能的神能不能創造一塊重得連祂自己也拿不起的石頭呢？

badminton.en: I used to play badminton a lot, but I don’t play anymore.
badminton.zh: 我以前常去打羽毛球，但現在不打了。
他们常在这儿打羽毛球。

pamphlet.en: This pamphlet is free of charge.

fees.en: My travel fees to Japan are paid for by the university.
fees.zh: 去日本的旅費由大學替我支付。

design.en: He studies French and web design.
design.zh: 他又学法语，又学怎么做网站。

design.zh: 这件衣服样式倒是挺好，就是贵了点儿。

text.en: While he was waiting for the train, he listened to music and sent text messages.
text.zh: 他等火车的时候，一会儿听音乐，一会儿发短信。

text.zh: 我们已经有那篇课文了吗？

cola.en: Instead of drinking cola, why not drink champagne?
cola.zh: 与其喝可乐，倒不如喝香槟。

champagne.en: Instead of drinking cola, why not drink champagne?
champagne.zh: 与其喝可乐，倒不如喝香槟。

champagne.zh: 這箇政客是典型的香檳社會主義者。

cannon.en: Never use a cannon to kill a fly.

november.en: In China, the 11th of November is Singles Day.
november.zh: 在中国十一月十一号是光棍节。

extension.en: Grace goes upstairs to the extension telephone.
extension.zh: 格雷斯去樓上的分機電話。

convert.en: He is a recent convert to Catholicism.
convert.zh: 他新近皈依的天主教徒。

convert.en: The cells have the capacity to convert food into energy.
convert.zh: 細胞具有將食物轉化為能量的能力。

unique.en: These flowers have a unique smell.
unique.zh: 這些花有一種獨特的氣味。

unique.en: The weather here has its own unique characteristics.
unique.zh: 这里的天气有独一无二的特点。

clinic.en: She went to the Takasu clinic.

clinic.zh: 这个诊所正在做激光手术。

millennium.en: We've already prepared for the millennium bug.
millennium.zh: 我們已經準備好應付千年蟲。

possession.en: The ball is that boy's prized possession.
possession.zh: 这个球是那个男孩的宝贝。

host.en: A guest should not try to make himself superior to the host.

host.zh: 派对主席说话时有葡萄牙腔

centre.en: At this language centre, about 15 international languages are taught, including English.
centre.zh: 在這個語言中心，教授約15種國際語言，包括英語。

centre.en: In the Ming Dynasty (early 15th century) the centre of Beijing was the Forbidden City.
centre.zh: 明代十五世纪初紫禁城是北京的中心。

whilst.en: The performers danced whilst singing - they performed extremely well.
whilst.zh: 演员们一边唱，一边跳，表演得好极了。

whilst.en: Whilst at university, Xiaowang held the post of class monitor.
whilst.zh: 上大學的时候，小王擔任過班長。

significant.en: As everyone knows, today is a very significant day for us.
significant.zh: 大家知道，今天对我们来说是一个很有意义的日子。

significant.en: Life is like a marathon, where short-term gains and losses are not significant in and of themselves.
significant.zh: 人生是一次长跑，暂时的落后和领先都不算什么。

appropriate.en: I need to configure this server with an appropriate firewall system.
appropriate.zh: 我该在这个服务器上设置一个防火墙。

appropriate.en: Contact the appropriate customer service helpline if the device does not operate properly.
appropriate.zh: 如果裝置無法正常運作，請聯絡對應的客服專線。

violent.en: She's violent right now. It'd be better to avoid her.
violent.zh: 她现在很暴力。最好避着点。

violent.zh: 进一步的检查发现头骨受到剧烈的撞击而碎裂。

initiative.en: He takes the initiative in helping his mother do the housework.
initiative.zh: 他主动帮他妈妈做家务。

initiative.en: The initiative measurably improved quality of life for the villagers.
initiative.zh: 計劃使村民的生活改善了不少。

stall.en: For years he has been at the market every Tuesday morning with his fish stall.
stall.zh: 他在街市賣魚賣了許多年了，這些年來每逢星期二都會在街市見到他。

officer.en: The police officer arrested the burglar.
How did you become a police officer?
officer.zh: 你是怎么成为一名警察的？

belly.en: I hit him in the belly.
His body type is born balanced! Wide shoulders, slim waist, belly not popping outwards.
belly.zh: 他的体形生得很匀称！肩膀宽，腰身窄，肚子又没凸出来。

prey.en: Cornered prey is the most dangerous kind.
prey.zh: 最危险的猎物是无路可走的那种。

prey.en: Men are hunters, and women are prey.
prey.zh: 男人是獵人, 女人是獵物。

resume.en: I asked the company for his resume.
resume.zh: 我向他公司询问了他的经历。

resume.en: I don't worry so much about my resume.
resume.zh: 我對自己的履歷不那麼在意。

relevant.en: I thought his opinion was relevant.
relevant.zh: 我認為他的意見很中肯。

trustworthy.en: I was mistaken in thinking that he was a trustworthy man.
trustworthy.zh: 我還以為他是個信得過的人。

trustworthy.en: He is a man of strong, stable and trustworthy character.
trustworthy.zh: 他是個性格強、穩定且可靠的男人。

slippery.en: The skin of nectarines is slippery.
Driving on a slippery road can lead to a car wreck.
slippery.zh: 在光滑的路上开车会导致车祸。

stitch.en: A stitch in time saves nine.
stitch.zh: 小洞及時補，免遭大洞苦。

commute.en: Do you commute to school by bus?

combat.en: In real combat, you must not forget that hesitation is a very dangerous thing.
combat.zh: 在实战中，你要知道三心二意是很危险的。

redeem.en: The only thing that will redeem mankind is co-operation.
redeem.zh: 合作是人類唯一的救贖。

co-operation.en: The only thing that will redeem mankind is co-operation.
co-operation.zh: 合作是人類唯一的救贖。

merit.en: Charms strike the sight, but merit wins the soul.
merit.zh: 魅力冲击视觉，美德征服心灵。

deceive.en: Nature never deceives us; it is always we who deceive ourselves.
deceive.zh: 自然从不会欺骗我们，骗我们的永远是我们自己。

deceive.en: It's wrong to deceive people, but worse to deceive yourself.
deceive.zh: 欺騙別人是錯的, 但更糟的欺騙自己。

charity.en: It is justice, not charity, that is wanting in the world.
charity.zh: 世界需要的是公正，不是施舍。

charity.en: Tom donates half his salary to his favorite charity.
charity.zh: 汤姆捐一半他的薪水给他最喜欢的慈善机构。

tractor.zh: 當雞像煎餅一樣平的時候, 那麼一定是拖拉機跑得比它們快。

tractor.en: When chickens pancake-shape maintain, the tractor must have won again.
tractor.zh: 當雞像煎餅一樣平的時候, 那麼一定是拖拉機跑得比它們快。

chest.zh: 你觉得胸毛是性感的吗？

chest.zh: 胸口有点儿疼，所以吃不下饭。

catching.en: I'm grateful to him for catching my hat that I lost on the windy street.
catching.zh: 我的帽子被風吹到大街上，我很感謝他幫我接住了。

graphic.zh: 书桌上一叠专业书里有几本卡通书混在里面。

heading.zh: 我们要回去啦，你托我们的事情一定留心着。

fabric.zh: 这里一排都是进口面料欧版的西装。

concrete.zh: 太棒了！是毛坯房还是装修房？

concrete.zh: 他一向只关心具体问题。

remittance.zh: 对不起，没有身份证是不能领汇款的。

occupation.zh: 我喜欢画油画，但是我不想拿它做我的终身职业。

bar.en: Zailaiba Bar is hiring waiters; are you interested?
bar.zh: “再来吧”酒吧要招一个服务员，你有兴趣吗？

adept.zh: 黑客很會利用電腦安全措拖的漏洞。

gossip.zh: 人們不喜歡流言蜚語的唯一時間是當你閒聊他們的事。

costly.zh: 为什么你买了一本那么贵的词典？

excursion.zh: 旅行社會爲你安排去安達盧西亞的旅行。

bowls.zh: 我要麻婆豆腐，还有两碗米饭。

licence.zh: 我母亲有驾照，但是她不开车。

male.zh: 我有三只狗，其中一只是公的，另外两只是母的。

spiritual.zh: 我们的生活不是由物质，而是由精神来决定的。

essay.zh: 这篇作文花了我两个小时来完成。

essay.zh: 这篇英语作文离完美还差得远。

explode.en: The aim of this game is to explode all the bombs on the screen.
explode.zh: 這個遊戲的目的是引爆螢幕上所有的炸彈。

auction.zh: 她没有准备烛光晚餐，而是把她的男友放到Ebay上拍卖。

auction.zh: 无人领取的物品被拍卖了。

intent.en: The only difference between a bad cook and a poisoner is the intent.
intent.zh: 一個差勁的廚師和下毒者唯一的不同在於他們的意圖。

incredible.zh: 你母亲说六种语言真是让人难以置信！

muscles.zh: 他的腿部肌肉在他卧床不起的七个月中萎缩了。

hero.zh: 我们把他称为“英雄”，但是他却背叛了我们。

seafood.zh: 如果你喜歡吃海鮮的話，你就來對地方了！

diligent.zh: 就我所知，他是个很用功的学生。

ally.zh: 德国曾是意大利的同盟国。

ally.zh: Ally喜欢和她的双胞胎妹妹Anne一起玩。

outcome.zh: 测试的结果显示，系统已经满足了所有设计要求。

stern.zh: 老師把學生狠狠地罵了一頓。

blunt.zh: 我的剑虽然是钝的，但应付你的话是绰绰有余的。

grand.zh: 不管你有什么冠冕堂皇的理由，这样做是不对的。

creation.zh: 大部分学校的创建不是用来转变社会，而是用来重建社会的。

creation.zh: 爱把喜悦带给所有的生命。

marble.en: Thousands of workers and artisans toiled for 22 years to create this breathtaking white marble structure.
marble.zh: 數千名工人和工匠辛勤工作了 22 年，才打造出這座令人驚嘆的白色大理石建築。

retail.en: Currently, I'm looking for a job in customer service, preferably retail.
retail.zh: 目前，我正在尋找客服工作，最好是零售業。

dictate.en: Gender norms should not dictate how individuals cope with and process their emotions.
dictate.zh: 性別規範不應該規定個人如何面對或處理自己的情緒。

disgust.en: I didn't mean to disgust anyone.

transition.en: The transition from hardware to software happened gradually.
transition.zh: 由硬體到軟體的轉變是緩慢的。

hardware.en: The transition from hardware to software happened gradually.
hardware.zh: 由硬體到軟體的轉變是緩慢的。

diverse.en: It's fertile land inhabited by diverse nations.
diverse.zh: 這是一片肥沃的土地，居住著不同的民族。

willow.en: The willow branches swayed gently in the breeze.
willow.zh: 柳枝在微风中轻轻荡悠。

exploit.en: The capitalists tend to exploit the working people.
exploit.zh: 资本家倾向于压榨工人。

thermal.en: The atomic reactor generates enormous amounts of thermal energy.
thermal.zh: 原子反应堆发出大量的热能。

perpetual.en: The idea of perpetual motion is an absurd hypothesis.
perpetual.zh: 永动机这个概念是个荒唐的假说。

infectious.zh: 汤姆的笑声很有感染力。

review.en: I'll keep the meeting notes to review them before the next session.
review.zh: 我會記會議筆記，下次會議前可以回顧一下。

fragile.en: He stomped on the fragile box, destroying its contents.
fragile.zh: 他踐踏那箱易碎品，毀壞了裡面的物品。

bully.en: The bully stomped on his schoolmate’s lunchbox out of spite.
bully.zh: 惡霸惡劣地踐踏同學的午餐便當。

trail.en: The frustrated artist stomped on his failed painting, leaving a trail of shattered colors.
trail.zh: 畫家失望地踐踏失敗之作，留下一片混亂的色彩。

category.en: A special feature of verbs in the Russian language is the presence of the category of aspect.
category.zh: 俄語動詞的一個特徵是存在體的範疇。

storage.en: My phone needs to have enough storage for my apps.
storage.zh: 我的手機需要足夠存儲空間來下載 App。

warranty.en: A good warranty would make me feel better.
warranty.zh: 優質的保固能讓我安心。

priority.en: Camera quality is a top priority for me.
priority.zh: 相機品質是我的優先考量。

engage.en: This app attracts over 10,000 users each day who engage with its features.
engage.zh: 這個應用程式每日吸引超過一萬位使用者使用其功能。

exclusively.en: Confidence and courage are not exclusively masculine traits—they are values that everyone can aspire to.
exclusively.zh: 自信與勇氣不僅是男性特質，也可以是所有人都能追求的價值。

aspire.en: Confidence and courage are not exclusively masculine traits—they are values that everyone can aspire to.
aspire.zh: 自信與勇氣不僅是男性特質，也可以是所有人都能追求的價值。

mundane.en: Sadako realized that, near death, even what was once mundane glows with an everlasting beauty.
mundane.zh: 貞子意識到，在生命將盡之際，曾經平凡無奇的事物，也會散發永恆的美。

everlasting.en: Sadako realized that, near death, even what was once mundane glows with an everlasting beauty.
everlasting.zh: 貞子意識到，在生命將盡之際，曾經平凡無奇的事物，也會散發永恆的美。

merge.en: Get into the left lane to make room for the guy who's trying to merge.
merge.zh: 移到左線，為想併入的那輛車騰出空間。

sewer.en: The sewer ran under the road.

premise.en: What's the premise of the TV show "The Bachelor"?
premise.zh: 《單身漢》這個電視節目的基本設定是什麼？

layer.en: Gently layer gold eyeshadow on the eyelids.
layer.zh: 在眼皮上輕輕疊加金色眼影。

manifest.en: Spirits of Heaven and Earth, heed my call; manifest swiftly by divine decree!
manifest.zh: 天靈靈，地靈靈；急急如律令！

decree.en: Spirits of Heaven and Earth, heed my call; manifest swiftly by divine decree!
decree.zh: 天靈靈，地靈靈；急急如律令！

symbolize.en: In literary works, night-blooming jasmine is often used to symbolize longing and tenderness.
symbolize.zh: 文學作品中常用夜來香來象徵思念與柔情。

utensils.en: While the rest of us work hard, the robber barons eat with gilded utensils.
utensils.zh: 當我們其他人辛苦工作時，強盜貴族卻用鍍金餐具吃飯。

notable.en: The trigonometric functions satisfy a wide array of notable algebraic identities.
notable.zh: 三角函數滿足各種代數恆等式。

identities.en: The trigonometric functions satisfy a wide array of notable algebraic identities.
identities.zh: 三角函數滿足各種代數恆等式。

sporadic.en: As a stranger in a strange land, the sporadic solicitude from friends can be especially heart-warming.
sporadic.zh: 在異鄉生活，偶爾收到朋友的關懷讓人倍感溫暖。

crevice.en: The crevice in the boulder on the ocean floor conceals an octopus.
crevice.zh: 海底的岩石缝里藏着一只章鱼。

dictation.en: Have you finished your homework? Have you memorized the dictation content?
dictation.zh: 這次作業做完了嗎？默寫背了嗎？

sophisticated.en: A vast and sophisticated system is usually based on a few simple rules.
sophisticated.zh: 庞大而精妙的体系往往建立在几个简单的规则之上。

haven.en: Damn, VS Code crashed and I haven’t saved the file yet.
haven.zh: 操，VS Code崩溃了，我还没保存文件。

linger.en: There are rumors that some evil spirits linger around here.
linger.zh: 传闻这附近有些脏东西。

buzz.en: I'm getting a bit of a nicotine buzz.

breakthrough.en: After many years of grueling training, she finally made a breakthrough and won the championship.
breakthrough.zh: 经过多年的刻苦训练，她终于破茧成蝶，赢得了冠军。

generalize.en: Don't generalize individual behavior to an entire group.
generalize.zh: 不要把个人行为上升到集体。

forfeit.en: You refuse a toast, only to be forced to drink a forfeit.

duplicate.en: This contract is made in duplicate.

aboriginal.en: The museum's new wing displays aboriginal rock art thousands of years old, with every label printed in two languages.
aboriginal.zh: 博物馆新展区陈列着有数千年历史的原住民岩画，每块展签都用两种语言印成。

abort.en: Mission control had to abort the launch with forty seconds left on the clock when a fuel sensor failed.
abort.zh: 倒计时还剩四十秒时一个燃料传感器失灵，任务控制中心只得中止发射。

abrasion.en: After a day on granite, his hands were raw from abrasion and every handhold stung.
abrasion.zh: 在花岗岩上攀了一天，他的双手磨得生疼，每次抓握都刺痛。

abridge.en: The publisher abridged the four-hundred-page memoir so that teenagers might actually finish it.
abridge.zh: 出版社把这本四百页的回忆录做了删节，好让青少年真能读完。

abrupt.en: His abrupt exit from the meeting left eight people staring at an empty chair.
abrupt.zh: 他中途突然离席，八个人只好盯着那把空椅子。

accessory.en: She matched the belt to her shoes and knotted a silk scarf as the finishing accessory.
accessory.zh: 她把腰带和鞋子配成一套，又系上一条丝巾作最后的点缀。

acclaim.en: Her first novel won critical acclaim in three countries before anyone had translated it.
acclaim.zh: 她的处女作小说还没被翻译，就在三个国家赢得了评论界的赞誉。

accountants.en: The accountants flagged three receipts that didn't match the invoices before signing off the quarter.
accountants.zh: 会计们在签核本季度账目前，标出了三张与发票对不上的收据。

accumulate.en: Dust had accumulated along the top of the bookcase for years, and no one volunteered to climb up.
accumulate.zh: 书架顶上积了多年的灰，却没人愿意爬上去擦。

accuser.en: The accuser described that night in calm, precise detail, and the courtroom grew quieter still.
accuser.zh: 指控者平静而精确地描述了那一晚，法庭变得更安静了。

acquaint.en: Give yourself a week to acquaint yourself with the lab equipment before running anything.
acquaint.zh: 先花一周熟悉实验室里的设备，再动手做实验。

acquisition.en: The company's acquisition of a small robotics firm doubled its engineering staff overnight.
acquisition.zh: 收购一家小型机器人公司之后，公司的工程团队一夜之间翻了一倍。

activate.en: Press and hold the red button for three seconds to activate the emergency alarm.
activate.zh: 按住红色按钮三秒即可启动紧急警报。

adhere.en: The tiles wouldn't adhere to the damp wall, so we waited two more days for the plaster to dry.
adhere.zh: 瓷砖粘不住潮湿的墙面，我们只好又等了两天让灰泥干透。

adjoin.en: Our garden adjoins the neighbour's orchard, and in autumn the smell of apples drifts over the fence.
adjoin.zh: 我家花园和邻居的果园相邻，秋天苹果的香气会飘过篱笆。

administer.en: A nurse administered the antidote within minutes of the snakebite, and the boy stayed conscious.
administer.zh: 被蛇咬后几分钟内护士就注射了解毒剂，男孩一直清醒。

administration.en: The university administration announced that the library would stay open until midnight during exams.
administration.zh: 校方宣布考试期间图书馆开放到午夜。

administrator.en: The hospital administrator spent the whole morning juggling bed shortages and a broken lift.
administrator.zh: 医院行政主管整个上午都在应付床位不足和一部坏掉的电梯。

adolescence.en: He barely spoke to his parents throughout adolescence, then called them every Sunday at thirty.
adolescence.zh: 整个青春期他几乎不跟父母说话，到了三十岁却每周日都打过去。

advent.en: The advent of cheap mobile data changed how the entire village shopped.
advent.zh: 廉价流量的出现改变了整个村子的购物方式。

adverse.en: The trial was halted after patients reported adverse reactions to the higher dose.
adverse.zh: 有患者报告对高剂量出现不良反应，试验随即被叫停。

aerial.en: Aerial photographs show the river has shifted half a kilometre west since the 1970s.
aerial.zh: 航拍照片显示，这条河自上世纪七十年代以来向西偏移了半公里。

aesthetic.en: The renovation kept the building's aesthetic while hiding every wire inside the walls.
aesthetic.zh: 这次翻新保住了建筑的美感，却把所有线路藏进了墙里。

affiliate.en: The local station is affiliated with a national network but still picks its own playlist.
affiliate.zh: 这家地方电台隶属于一家全国性联播网，但节目单仍由自己定。

affirm.en: The court affirmed the earlier ruling, and the family finally got their land back.
affirm.zh: 法院维持了原判，这家人终于拿回了自己的地。

affix.en: Affix the customs label to the outside of the parcel, not under the lid.
affix.zh: 把海关标签贴在包裹外面，不要塞在盖子底下。

afflict.en: Drought has afflicted the region for four straight summers, emptying wells and markets alike.
afflict.zh: 干旱连续四个夏天折磨着这一带，水井和集市都空了。

aggravate.en: Scratching the rash will only aggravate the itching, the pharmacist warned.
aggravate.zh: 药师提醒说，抓挠皮疹只会让瘙痒更加厉害。

aggregate.en: Her aggregate score across five events left her second by a single point.
aggregate.zh: 五个项目的总成绩让她以一分之差排在第二。

agitation.en: There was visible agitation in the crowd as the results were read out.
agitation.zh: 结果念出来时，人群里明显躁动起来。

agony.en: He waited in agony outside the operating theatre, checking the clock every few minutes.
agony.zh: 他在手术室外痛苦地等着，每隔几分钟看一次表。

alienate.en: Her blunt honesty alienated half the committee before the vote was even taken.
alienate.zh: 投票还没开始，她过于直率的坦率就已经让一半委员疏远了她。

allege.en: The report alleges that the factory dumped waste into the river for six years.
allege.zh: 报告指称这家工厂六年来一直往河里倾倒废料。

alliance.en: The two breweries formed an alliance to share delivery trucks and cut fuel costs.
alliance.zh: 两家啤酒厂结成联盟，共用送货车以降低油费。

allocate.en: The council allocated a quarter of its budget to repairing pavements.
allocate.zh: 市议会把四分之一的预算分配给了人行道维修。

allot.en: Each speaker was allotted eight minutes, and the chair cut off anyone who ran over.
allot.zh: 每位发言人分到八分钟，超时就被主席打断。

alloy.en: The wheels are a light magnesium alloy that shaves several kilos off the frame.
alloy.zh: 车轮用的是轻质镁合金，让车架轻了好几公斤。

alter.en: Moving the sofa to the other wall altered the feel of the room without costing a penny.
alter.zh: 把沙发挪到另一面墙，一分钱没花就改变了房间的感觉。

amaze.en: It still amazes me how quickly the twins learned to read each other's moods.
amaze.zh: 双胞胎这么快就能读懂彼此的情绪，我至今觉得惊讶。

ambiguity.en: The contract's ambiguity over overtime pay caused a year of arguments.
ambiguity.zh: 合同对加班费说得含糊，结果吵了整整一年。

amend.en: Parliament amended the law so that renters may keep pets by default.
amend.zh: 议会修订了法律，规定租客默认可以养宠物。

ammunition.en: The soldiers ran out of ammunition on the third day and had to pull back.
ammunition.zh: 士兵们第三天就打光了弹药，不得不后撤。

amphibian.en: Frogs are amphibians, so they breathe through their skin as well as their lungs.
amphibian.zh: 青蛙是两栖动物，既能用肺呼吸，也能靠皮肤呼吸。

amuse.en: A street performer amused the queue for an hour with juggling and terrible puns.
amuse.zh: 一位街头艺人用杂耍和糟透的双关语逗乐了排队的人一个小时。

analogy.en: She explained the immune system by analogy with a city's night watchmen.
analogy.zh: 她用城市守夜人来类比，解释了免疫系统是怎么回事。

analytical.en: His analytical mind caught a pattern in the sales data that everyone else had missed.
analytical.zh: 他的分析头脑在销售数据里发现了别人都漏掉的规律。

ancestor.en: Her ancestors left the village in the 1890s, and she only found the grave last spring.
ancestor.zh: 她的祖先在十九世纪九十年代离开了村子，她直到去年春天才找到那座坟。

anchor.en: The crew dropped anchor in the bay and waited out the storm.
anchor.zh: 船员们在海湾抛下锚，等暴风雨过去。

anecdote.en: He opened the lecture with an anecdote about losing his passport in Tokyo.
anecdote.zh: 他先讲了段自己在东京丢护照的趣事，作为讲座的开场。

annihilate.en: The flood annihilated the lower village; only the church tower stood above the water.
annihilate.zh: 洪水摧毁了地势低的村子，只剩教堂塔楼露在水面上。

annuity.en: After thirty years of payments, the annuity gives him a fixed monthly income in retirement.
annuity.zh: 缴满三十年之后，这份年金让他在退休后每月有固定收入。

antagonism.en: There was open antagonism between the two coaches, and neither would shake hands.
antagonism.zh: 两位教练之间的敌意毫不掩饰，谁都不肯握手。

antecedent.en: The historian traced the antecedents of the strike back to a wage cut in 1902.
antecedent.zh: 历史学家把这场罢工的源头追溯到1902年的一次减薪。

anthology.en: The anthology gathers poems written by nurses during the war, most of them never published.
anthology.zh: 这本选集收录了战争期间护士们写的诗，大多从未发表。

antibiotic.en: The doctor prescribed an antibiotic for the ear infection and told him to finish the whole course.
antibiotic.zh: 医生给耳部感染开了抗生素，并叮嘱他把疗程吃完。

antibiotics.en: A poster in the clinic warns that overusing antibiotics makes bacteria harder to kill.
antibiotics.zh: 诊所的海报提醒：滥用抗生素会让细菌更难被杀灭。

anticipation.en: The children sat by the window in anticipation, watching for the first flake of snow.
anticipation.zh: 孩子们满怀期待地坐在窗边，等着第一片雪花落下。

ape.en: The zoo's oldest ape learned to open the gate latch with a twig.
ape.zh: 动物园里最年长的那只猿学会用细树枝拨开门闩。

apes.en: Researchers found that these apes hold leaves over their heads as umbrellas in heavy rain.
apes.zh: 研究人员发现，这些猿在暴雨中会把叶子举在头顶当伞。

apparatus.en: The lab's breathing apparatus was checked twice before every dive.
apparatus.zh: 实验室的呼吸器每次潜水前都要检查两遍。

appendix.en: The full table of figures sits in the appendix, which runs to forty pages.
appendix.zh: 完整的图表放在附录里，足足有四十页。

appraisal.en: Her annual appraisal ended with a raise and a promise of more training.
appraisal.zh: 她的年度考核以加薪和增加培训的承诺收尾。

appreciable.en: There was an appreciable drop in noise once the new tarmac went down.
appreciable.zh: 新沥青铺好之后，噪音明显降低了。

apprehension.en: A knot of apprehension tightened in his chest as he stepped onto the stage.
apprehension.zh: 走上舞台时，一团不安在他胸口收紧。

aquatic.en: Aquatic plants filter the pond so well that the water stays clear all summer.
aquatic.zh: 水生植物把池塘滤得很干净，整个夏天水都是清的。

arc.en: The ball traced a high arc over the fence and dropped into the neighbour's pond.
arc.zh: 球划出一道高高的弧线越过篱笆，落进邻居家的池塘。

arch.en: We walked under the stone arch and came out into the old market square.
arch.zh: 我们从石拱门下穿过去，走进了旧市集广场。

archaeological.en: Archaeological digs along the route delayed the railway by two years.
archaeological.zh: 沿线的考古发掘让铁路工程推迟了两年。

archives.en: The newspaper's archives go back to 1889 and are being digitised a shelf at a time.
archives.zh: 这家报纸的档案可以追溯到1889年，正一排排地数字化。

ardent.en: He is an ardent supporter of the local club and hasn't missed a home game in twenty years.
ardent.zh: 他是本地球会的铁杆支持者，二十年没缺席过一场主场比赛。

arduous.en: The climb was arduous, but the ridge at dawn made the eight hours worth it.
arduous.zh: 攀登相当艰苦，但黎明时的山脊让这八小时很值。

armour.en: The knight's armour weighed over thirty kilos, and he needed two squires just to mount.
armour.zh: 那副盔甲重三十多公斤，上马还得两个侍从扶着。

artery.en: The surgeon cleared a blocked artery, and the patient's chest pain stopped that night.
artery.zh: 外科医生疏通了一根堵塞的动脉，当晚患者胸痛就停了。

artillery.en: Artillery fire could be heard from the hills all through the night.
artillery.zh: 整夜都能听见山里传来的炮声。

ascend.en: The balloon ascended slowly over the vineyards, and everyone below stopped to wave.
ascend.zh: 热气球缓缓升到葡萄园上空，下面的人都停下来挥手。

ascertain.en: Police are still trying to ascertain how the keys got into a locked office.
ascertain.zh: 警方仍在设法查明，钥匙是怎么进到一间上锁的办公室里的。

ascribe.en: She ascribes her recovery to long walks and her sister's cooking.
ascribe.zh: 她把自己的康复归功于长时间散步和姐姐做的饭。

assassination.en: The assassination of the archduke in 1914 set off a chain of events no one could contain.
assassination.zh: 1914年大公遇刺，引发了一连串无人能遏制的事件。

assault.en: He was charged with assault after the fight outside the pub.
assault.zh: 酒吧外那场打斗之后，他被控袭击。

assert.en: She asserted that the report had been altered and produced the original file to prove it.
assert.zh: 她断言报告被人改动过，并拿出原始文件作证。

assessment.en: The flood assessment concluded that four bridges needed rebuilding, not patching.
assessment.zh: 洪水评估的结论是，四座桥需要重建，而不是修补。

assign.en: The editor assigned the restaurant review to a freelancer who lives two streets away.
assign.zh: 编辑把餐厅评论的活交给了一位住在两条街外的自由撰稿人。

assignments.en: He finished two assignments on the train and still had time for a nap.
assignments.zh: 他在火车上写完两份作业，还剩下时间打了个盹。

assimilate.en: New arrivals assimilate faster when somebody shows them the bus routes in the first week.
assimilate.zh: 新来的人如果在第一周就有人带他们认公交线路，融入会快得多。

assorted.en: The tin held assorted screws, none of which fitted the bracket.
assorted.zh: 铁盒里是各式螺丝，没有一颗配得上那个支架。

assurance.en: The builder gave us a written assurance that the roof would last twenty years.
assurance.zh: 建筑商书面保证屋顶能用二十年。

astound.en: The choir's last note astounded the judges into complete silence.
astound.zh: 合唱团的最后一个音让评委惊讶得一句话都说不出。

atlas.en: He kept a road atlas in the glove box long after the satnav arrived.
atlas.zh: 即便早就用上了导航，他手套箱里仍放着一本公路地图册。

attentive.en: The waiter was attentive without hovering, refilling the water before anyone asked.
attentive.zh: 那位服务员周到却不扰人，总在客人开口前就把水添满。

audible.en: Her voice was barely audible over the generator humming outside.
audible.zh: 外面发电机嗡嗡响，她的声音几乎听不清。

audit.en: An independent audit found the charity had spent less than half its donations on projects.
audit.zh: 一次独立审计发现，这家慈善机构的捐款只有不到一半用在项目上。

augment.en: He augments his salary by repairing bicycles in the evenings.
augment.zh: 他晚上修自行车来补充收入。

authoritative.en: This is the most authoritative guide to the region's birds, and it weighs a kilo.
authoritative.zh: 这是关于这一地区鸟类最权威的指南，重量有一公斤。

authorize.en: Only the site manager can authorize weekend overtime.
authorize.zh: 只有现场经理才有权批准周末加班。

automatic.en: The doors are automatic, so keep your hands clear of the frame.
automatic.zh: 门是自动的，手别伸进门框里。

automation.en: Automation cut the packing line from twelve workers to three, and the town still argues about it.
automation.zh: 自动化把包装线从十二个人减到三个人，镇上至今还在为此争论。

autonomy.en: The branch was given autonomy over pricing, and sales rose within a quarter.
autonomy.zh: 分公司拿到了定价自主权，一个季度内销量就上去了。

avalanche.en: An avalanche closed the pass for three days, stranding lorries on both sides.
avalanche.zh: 一场雪崩封了山口三天，货车堵在两头。

avert.en: The driver swerved and averted a crash by the width of a hand.
avert.zh: 司机猛打一把方向，以一只手的距离躲过了一场车祸。

bacterium.en: A single bacterium can become millions in a warm dish left overnight.
bacterium.zh: 一个细菌在温热的培养皿里放一夜，就能变成几百万个。

baffle.en: The engineers were baffled by a fault that vanished whenever they ran the test.
baffle.zh: 工程师们被一个每次测试就消失的故障弄得百思不解。

baldness.en: His baldness began in his twenties, and by forty he was shaving his head on purpose.
baldness.zh: 他二十多岁开始脱发，到四十岁索性主动把头发剃光。

ballet.en: She danced ballet until a knee injury at nineteen put an end to it.
ballet.zh: 她一直跳芭蕾，直到十九岁膝伤让这一切结束。

ballot.en: Union members will decide on the strike by secret ballot next Thursday.
ballot.zh: 工会成员下周四以无记名投票决定是否罢工。

ballroom.en: The hotel's ballroom was taken for a wedding, so the conference moved downstairs.
ballroom.zh: 酒店的舞厅被婚礼包下了，会议只好挪到楼下。

bands.en: Two local bands played the fundraiser, and both donated their fee.
bands.zh: 两支本地乐队为募捐演出，都把酬劳捐了出来。

bang.en: The screen door banged shut behind him, and the dog started barking.
bang.zh: 纱门在他身后砰的一声关上，狗立刻叫了起来。

banish.en: The new head teacher banished phones from the playground entirely.
banish.zh: 新校长把手机彻底赶出了操场。

banner.en: A banner across the high street read 'Save Our Library'.
banner.zh: 大街上一幅横幅写着“救救我们的图书馆”。

banquet.en: The awards banquet ran so late that the kitchen staff had already gone home.
banquet.zh: 颁奖晚宴拖得太久，厨房的人都已经回家了。

barren.en: The hillside turned barren after years of overgrazing, and now nothing holds the soil.
barren.zh: 多年过度放牧之后山坡变得荒芜，如今没有东西能固住泥土。

barricade.en: Students built a barricade of desks across the corridor to keep the inspectors out.
barricade.zh: 学生们用课桌在走廊里堆起路障，不让检查人员进来。

barter.en: In the mountains people still barter cheese for firewood when cash is short.
barter.zh: 山里人现金紧张时，仍然用奶酪换柴火。

bead.en: A bead of sweat ran down his neck while he waited to be called.
bead.zh: 等叫到他的名字时，一滴汗顺着他的脖子流下来。

bedsit.en: For his first year in the city he lived in a bedsit with one window and a shared bathroom.
bedsit.zh: 到城里的第一年，他住在一间只有一扇窗、浴室共用的单间里。

berth.en: We booked a berth on the overnight train so we'd arrive rested.
berth.zh: 我们订了夜车的卧铺，好让到站时还有精神。

beset.en: The project was beset by delays from the very first week.
beset.zh: 这个项目从第一周起就麻烦不断。

bewilder.en: The tax form bewildered him so thoroughly that he paid an accountant to fill it in.
bewilder.zh: 那张税表把他彻底看晕了，只好花钱请会计师来填。

bilateral.en: The two countries signed a bilateral agreement on fishing rights last spring.
bilateral.zh: 去年春天两国签署了一项关于捕鱼权的双边协议。

bind.en: The contract binds both parties for five years, with no early exit.
bind.zh: 这份合同对双方都有五年约束力，不能提前解约。

biography.en: The biography spends forty pages on his childhood and barely ten on the work that made him famous.
biography.zh: 这本传记用四十页写他的童年，写那部让他成名的作品却不到十页。

biological.en: The lake's biological balance collapsed once carp were introduced.
biological.zh: 鲤鱼被引入之后，湖里的生态平衡就崩溃了。

bitumen.en: Workers poured hot bitumen into the cracks and rolled it flat before it cooled.
bitumen.zh: 工人把滚烫的沥青浇进裂缝，趁没凉就压平。

bleak.en: The forecast was bleak: a week of rain, and wind to match.
bleak.zh: 预报很不乐观：连下七天雨，还刮大风。

bloc.en: The smaller parties formed a bloc to block the budget.
bloc.zh: 几个小党结成集团，要卡住预算案。

blond.en: The blond boy behind the counter turned out to be the owner's son.
blond.zh: 柜台后那个金发男孩原来是老板的儿子。

blunder.en: Signing the letter without reading it was a blunder he regretted for years.
blunder.zh: 没读就签了那封信，是他后悔了好几年的失误。

blur.en: Tears blurred the words on the page, and she had to start the paragraph again.
blur.zh: 泪水模糊了纸上的字，她只好把那段重新读起。

blush.en: He blushed to the ears when the whole class sang to him.
blush.zh: 全班为他唱歌时，他红到了耳根。

boast.en: The hotel boasts a rooftop pool, though it is barely bigger than a bath.
boast.zh: 这家酒店号称有屋顶泳池，其实比浴缸大不了多少。

bold.en: Quitting a steady job at forty-two was a bold decision, and he would make it again.
bold.zh: 四十二岁辞掉稳定的工作是个大胆的决定，而他说还会再这么做一次。

bonus.en: The year-end bonus covered the new boiler and nothing else.
bonus.zh: 年终奖刚够换一台新锅炉，别的什么都干不了。

booking.en: I made a booking for six at seven, under the name Lin.
booking.zh: 我用林的名字订了七点、六个人的位子。

bookkeeper.en: The bookkeeper spotted a twenty-pound discrepancy that had gone unnoticed for months.
bookkeeper.zh: 记账员发现了一处二十英镑的差错，几个月都没人注意到。

booklist.en: The booklist for the course runs to thirty titles, half of them out of print.
booklist.zh: 这门课的书单列了三十本，其中一半已经绝版。

boost.en: A full night's sleep gave his immune system a real boost before the flight.
boost.zh: 上飞机前睡了个整觉，他的免疫力明显提振了不少。

boot.en: Mud caked his boots, so he left them outside the door.
boot.zh: 靴子上糊满泥，他只好把它们脱在门外。

bore.en: The lecture bored half the room to sleep within twenty minutes.
bore.zh: 讲座才二十分钟，半屋子人就被讲睡了。

bounce.en: The ball bounced off the post and back into play.
bounce.zh: 球打在门柱上弹回场内。

bowel.en: A change of diet settled his bowels within a week.
bowel.zh: 换了饮食之后，一周内他的肠道就恢复正常了。

boycott.en: Shoppers organised a boycott of the chain over its packaging waste.
boycott.zh: 消费者因包装浪费发起抵制这家连锁店。

brace.en: He braced himself against the rail as the ferry lurched sideways.
brace.zh: 渡轮猛地侧倾，他赶紧撑住栏杆稳住身体。

bracket.en: Put the total in brackets so it isn't confused with the subtotal.
bracket.zh: 把总计放在括号里，免得和小计搞混。

breach.en: A breach in the sea wall let the tide flood the lower street.
breach.zh: 海堤的一处缺口让潮水淹了地势低的那条街。

breed.en: These birds breed on the cliffs and return to the same ledge every spring.
breed.zh: 这些鸟在悬崖上繁殖，每年春天都回到同一处岩架。

brew.en: She brews her own ginger beer and hands out bottles at Christmas.
brew.zh: 她自己酿姜汁啤酒，圣诞节时一瓶瓶送人。

bristol.en: The train to Bristol leaves from platform four and is usually ten minutes late.
bristol.zh: 去布里斯托的火车从四号站台发车，通常晚十分钟。

brittle.en: The old plastic casing had gone brittle and cracked at the slightest pressure.
brittle.zh: 那个旧塑料外壳已经变脆，稍微一压就裂。

brochures.en: The travel agent's brochures promised white beaches; we got grey drizzle for a week.
brochures.zh: 旅行社的宣传册上写着白色沙滩，我们却遇上了一个星期的灰蒙蒙细雨。

brood.en: He sat by the window brooding over the email for the rest of the afternoon.
brood.zh: 他坐在窗边，余下的整个下午都在为那封邮件闷闷地琢磨。

browse.en: She browsed the market stalls for an hour and came away with just one jar of honey.
browse.zh: 她在集市摊位上逛了一个小时，最后只买了一罐蜂蜜。

bruise.en: A purple bruise spread across his forearm where the ladder had hit.
bruise.zh: 梯子撞到的地方，他小臂上散开一块紫青的瘀伤。

brutal.en: That winter was brutal: pipes froze and the road stayed closed for a month.
brutal.zh: 那年的冬天酷烈难熬，水管冻裂，道路封了一个月。

bulge.en: The bag bulged with oranges, and the zip finally gave way at the station.
bulge.zh: 袋子被橙子撑得鼓起，拉链最后在车站崩开了。

bulk.en: Buying rice in bulk is cheaper, but you need somewhere dry to keep it.
bulk.zh: 大米大批量买更便宜，但得有干燥的地方存。

bulletin.en: The hospital posts a daily bulletin listing which wards are closed to visitors.
bulletin.zh: 医院每天贴出公告，写明哪些病房谢绝探视。

bump.en: He bumped his head on the low beam and saw stars for a full minute.
bump.zh: 他一头撞上低矮的横梁，眼冒金星了整整一分钟。

bumper.en: Traffic was bumper to bumper for six kilometres out of the city.
bumper.zh: 出城六公里，车一辆挨着一辆。

bundle.en: She tied the old letters into a bundle with red string.
bundle.zh: 她用红绳把那些旧信捆成一捆。

bungalow.en: They swapped their city flat for a bungalow with a garden big enough for a dog.
bungalow.zh: 他们把城里的公寓换成了一栋平房，院子大得能养狗。

buoyant.en: The housing market stayed buoyant despite the rise in interest rates.
buoyant.zh: 尽管利率上升，房产市场依然景气。

burgeon.en: A small repair business burgeoned into a chain of twelve shops in five years.
burgeon.zh: 一家小修理铺五年间发展成十二家连锁店。

burial.en: The burial took place on the hillside where his parents had been buried.
burial.zh: 葬礼在他父母安葬的那片山坡上举行。

burrow.en: Rabbits had burrowed under the fence, and the vegetable patch was ruined.
burrow.zh: 兔子在篱笆底下打了洞，菜地全给毁了。

bust.en: The bakery went bust three months after the supermarket opened across the road.
bust.zh: 马路对面的超市开业三个月后，那家面包店就破产了。

bustle.en: She loves the bustle of the morning market, all shouting and crates and steam.
bustle.zh: 她喜欢早市的喧闹，到处是叫卖声、木箱和热气。

bypass.en: The new bypass took the lorries out of the village centre.
bypass.zh: 新建的绕行路把卡车引出了村子中心。

cable.en: A thick cable runs from the generator in the shed to the barn.
cable.zh: 一根粗电缆从棚里的发电机一路通到谷仓。

cages.en: The rescue centre keeps injured birds in cages only until they can fly again.
cages.zh: 救助中心只把受伤的鸟关在笼子里，直到它们能重新飞。

calamity.en: Losing the whole harvest was a calamity the family talked about for decades.
calamity.zh: 收成全没了，这场灾祸这家人讲了几十年。

calcium.en: After the scan showed thinning bones, she added calcium to her diet.
calcium.zh: 扫描显示骨质变薄后，她在饮食里加了钙。

canvas.en: He stretched a fresh canvas and worked on nothing but sky for three evenings.
canvas.zh: 他绷好一张新画布，连着三个晚上只画天空。

cape.en: The lighthouse stands on a cape that the wind never leaves alone.
cape.zh: 灯塔立在一处海角上，那里的风几乎没有停的时候。

caption.en: The photo's caption named the mayor as the gardener, and nobody noticed for a week.
caption.zh: 照片说明把市长写成了园丁，一个星期都没人发现。

carcase.en: The vet examined the carcase to work out why the herd was dying.
carcase.zh: 兽医检查了那具尸体，想弄清这群牲畜为何接连死亡。

cardinal.en: Patience is the cardinal rule of fly fishing; rush it and you scare everything away.
cardinal.zh: 耐心是飞蝇钓的第一要义，一急就把鱼全惊跑了。

carrot.en: He dangled the carrot of an extra week's holiday to get the team to finish early.
carrot.zh: 他拿多一周假期当诱饵，让团队提前完工。

carve.en: He carved a small boat out of driftwood for his daughter's birthday.
carve.zh: 他用浮木给女儿刻了一条小船当生日礼物。

carving.en: The museum's wooden carving of a lion has been worn smooth by centuries of hands.
carving.zh: 博物馆那件木雕狮子被几百年来的手摸得光滑。

casual.en: The dress code is casual, so jeans and trainers are perfectly fine.
casual.zh: 着装要求是便装，牛仔裤配运动鞋完全可以。

casualty.en: The first casualty of the storm was the old oak by the gate.
casualty.zh: 这场风暴的第一个牺牲品是门口那棵老橡树。

catalog.en: The seed catalog arrives in January, and every year I order far too much.
catalog.zh: 种子目录一月寄到，我每年都订得太多。

catalogue.en: She spent the evening leafing through the furniture catalogue, circling things she would never buy.
catalogue.zh: 她一晚上都在翻家具目录，圈出一堆永远不会买的东西。

catalyst.en: The documentary acted as a catalyst for the town's new waste policy.
catalyst.zh: 这部纪录片成了小镇推出新垃圾政策的催化剂。

catastrophe.en: The flood was a catastrophe for farmers who had planted only the week before.
catastrophe.zh: 对一周前才播完种的农民来说，这场洪水是场大灾。

cater.en: The hotel caters for large weddings and can seat three hundred at a push.
cater.zh: 这家酒店承办大型婚礼，挤一挤能坐三百人。

catering.en: The catering alone cost more than the band and the flowers put together.
catering.zh: 光餐饮一项就超过了乐队加鲜花的钱。

caustic.en: His caustic remark about her cooking ended the dinner half an hour early.
caustic.zh: 他关于她厨艺的那句刻薄话，让晚餐提前半小时散场。

caution.en: Drive with caution along the coast road; the fog comes down fast there.
caution.zh: 走沿海公路要当心，那里的雾来得很快。

cavity.en: The dentist found a small cavity and filled it the same afternoon.
cavity.zh: 牙医发现了一个小蛀洞，当天下午就补好了。

cd-rom.en: The manual came on a CD-ROM that none of the office laptops could read.
cd-rom.zh: 手册存在一张光盘里，办公室的笔记本没有一台读得了。

centenary.en: The village marked the centenary of its war memorial with a short service at dusk.
centenary.zh: 村子在黄昏举行了一场简短仪式，纪念战争纪念碑落成一百周年。

ceramic.en: The ceramic bowl survived the move but lost a chip off the rim.
ceramic.zh: 那只陶瓷碗搬家时保住了，碗沿却磕掉了一小块。

cereal.en: He eats the same cereal every morning and refuses to try anything else.
cereal.zh: 他每天早上吃同一种麦片，别的一概不肯试。

certificates.en: Bring your certificates to the interview; they will want to see the originals.
certificates.zh: 面试时带上证书，他们要核原件。

certify.en: A doctor must certify the cause of death before the funeral can be arranged.
certify.zh: 得由医生证明死因，才能安排葬礼。

chancellor.en: The chancellor announced a tax cut for small businesses in the autumn statement.
chancellor.zh: 财政大臣在秋季声明中宣布给小企业减税。

chant.en: The crowd chanted the team's name right up to the final whistle.
chant.zh: 人群一直高喊队名，直到终场哨响。

characterize.en: Critics characterize the novel as a love story, but it is really about grief.
characterize.zh: 评论家把这部小说归为爱情故事，其实它讲的是丧亲之痛。

charter.en: The club's charter requires two members to sign off on any spending over a thousand pounds.
charter.zh: 俱乐部章程规定，任何超过一千英镑的开支须由两名成员签字核准。

chasm.en: A chasm opened in the road after the earthquake, wide enough to swallow a car.
chasm.zh: 地震后路上裂开一道深渊，宽得能吞下一辆车。

chaste.en: The film keeps its romance chaste, all glances and one held hand.
chaste.zh: 这部电影把爱情拍得克制纯净，只有眼神和一次牵手。

chic.en: She wore a plain black dress that somehow looked effortlessly chic.
chic.zh: 她穿一条素黑连衣裙，却显得毫不费力地时髦。

childcare.en: Without affordable childcare she could not take the night shift.
childcare.zh: 没有价格合适的托儿服务，她就接不了夜班。

chisel.en: He chiselled his initials into the beam before the roof went on.
chisel.zh: 上屋顶之前，他把名字的首字母凿进了横梁。

choke.en: He choked on a piece of bread and needed a glass of water to clear it.
choke.zh: 他被一块面包噎住了，得喝口水才顺下去。

chore.en: Filling the wood store is the one winter chore nobody volunteers for.
chore.zh: 把柴房填满，是冬天谁都不愿主动干的活。

chorus.en: The whole pub joined the chorus, badly and with great enthusiasm.
chorus.zh: 整个酒吧的人都跟着唱副歌，跑调却热情十足。

chronic.en: Years of heavy lifting left him with chronic back pain.
chronic.zh: 多年搬重物让他落下了慢性背痛。

chronological.en: The archive is arranged in chronological order, so you can follow the case day by day.
chronological.zh: 档案按时间顺序排列，可以一天天追踪案情。

circulate.en: Rumours circulated for a week before anyone official said a word.
circulate.zh: 谣言传了一个星期，官方才有人出来说话。
