cite.en: She cited three studies to back the claim, all of them from the same lab.
cite.zh: 她引了三项研究支撑这个说法，全都出自同一间实验室。

civic.en: The old town hall has become a civic centre with a library and a clinic.
civic.zh: 老市政厅成了一座市民中心，里面有图书馆和诊所。

civilian.en: The bridge was reopened to civilian traffic once the exercise ended.
civilian.zh: 演习一结束，这座桥就重新对民用车辆开放。

clamp.en: Clamp the board to the bench before you cut it, or it will slip.
clamp.zh: 锯之前先把木板夹在工作台上，否则会打滑。

clarify.en: Could you clarify whether the fee includes delivery and installation?
clarify.zh: 能否说明一下这笔费用是否包含送货和安装？

clarity.en: The new glasses gave him such clarity that the first thing he noticed was the dust.
clarity.zh: 新眼镜让他看得格外清楚，最先注意到的竟是灰尘。

clause.en: A clause in the lease forbids subletting without written permission.
clause.zh: 租约里有一条：未经书面许可不得转租。

clearance.en: The lorry needs two metres of clearance to get through the gate.
clearance.zh: 卡车要有两米的净空才能穿过大门。

cliche.en: The ending is a cliche, but the acting more or less rescues the film.
cliche.zh: 结尾很老套，好在演技多少救回了这部片子。

cling.en: In this kind of humidity your shirt clings to your back by mid-morning.
cling.zh: 这种潮气里，到上午十点光景衬衫就贴在背上了。

clip.en: He clipped the receipt to the invoice and filed them together.
clip.zh: 他把收据夹在发票上，一起归档。

clockwise.en: Turn the valve clockwise until it stops, then leave it alone.
clockwise.zh: 把阀门顺时针拧到底，然后别再动它。

close-up.en: The final close-up shows only her hands, trembling on the table.
close-up.zh: 最后一个特写只拍了她的手，在桌面上轻轻发抖。

clumsy.en: His clumsy attempt at an apology only made things worse.
clumsy.zh: 他笨拙地试着道歉，反而把事弄得更糟。

cluster.en: A cluster of cottages sits where the two lanes meet.
cluster.zh: 两条小路交汇的地方聚着几栋村舍。

clutch.en: She clutched the ticket in her fist all the way to the gate.
clutch.zh: 她一路把票攥在拳头里走到检票口。

co-operative.en: The farm is a co-operative, so the profits are split between the members.
co-operative.zh: 这个农场是合作社，利润由成员们平分。

coalition.en: A coalition of residents and shopkeepers blocked the demolition plan.
coalition.zh: 居民和店主联合起来，拦下了拆迁计划。

cocaine.en: Customs officers found cocaine packed inside the legs of the chairs.
cocaine.zh: 海关人员发现可卡因被塞在椅子腿里。

coeducation.en: The school only adopted coeducation in 1975, and my mother was in the first mixed class.
coeducation.zh: 这所学校直到1975年才实行男女同校，我母亲就在第一个混合班里。

coerce.en: Nobody should be coerced into signing a contract they don't understand.
coerce.zh: 不该有人被迫签下自己看不懂的合同。

cognitive.en: Losing sleep damages cognitive performance long before you actually feel tired.
cognitive.zh: 睡眠不足在你感到疲倦之前，就已经在损害认知表现。

coil.en: A coil of rope hung by the door, ready for the boat.
coil.zh: 门边挂着一盘绳子，随时可以上船用。

collaboration.en: The album is a collaboration between a jazz pianist and a folk singer.
collaboration.zh: 这张专辑出自一位爵士钢琴家和一位民谣歌手的合作。

collide.en: Two cyclists collided at the blind corner, and both walked away merely shaken.
collide.zh: 两名骑车人在视线受阻的拐角撞上，两人都只是受了惊。

collision.en: The collision wrote off both cars, though nobody was seriously hurt.
collision.zh: 相撞让两辆车都报废了，不过没人受重伤。

colonial.en: The colonial buildings along the waterfront are now galleries and coffee shops.
colonial.zh: 滨水区那些殖民时期的建筑如今成了画廊和咖啡馆。

colossal.en: The cathedral swallowed a colossal quantity of stone, hauled in by boat and cart.
colossal.zh: 这座大教堂耗用了海量的石头，全靠船和马车运来。

combustible.en: Store combustible materials well away from the boiler room.
combustible.zh: 易燃材料要存放在远离锅炉房的地方。

commemorate.en: A plaque commemorates the fishermen lost in the storm of 1953.
commemorate.zh: 一块铭牌纪念1953年那场风暴中遇难的渔民。

commence.en: Work on the bridge will commence as soon as the river drops.
commence.zh: 河水一退，修桥工程就会开工。

commend.en: The judge commended the witness for staying calm under pressure.
commend.zh: 法官赞许证人在压力下保持冷静。

commentary.en: The match was on in the shop, with the commentary turned up loud.
commentary.zh: 店里在播比赛，解说的声音开得很大。

commercial.en: The building was converted from commercial use into flats last year.
commercial.zh: 这栋楼去年从商业用途改成了住宅。

commercials.en: We mute the commercials and talk until the film comes back on.
commercials.zh: 广告一开始我们就静音聊天，直到电影接着播。

commitment.en: Coaching the kids' team is a two-evening commitment every single week.
commitment.zh: 带孩子那支队每周要占掉两个晚上。

commodity.en: Clean water is turning into a scarce commodity in the region.
commodity.zh: 在这一带，干净的水正变成稀缺物资。

commonwealth.en: She spent two years teaching in a Commonwealth country before moving home.
commonwealth.zh: 她在一个英联邦国家教了两年书才搬回国。

commotion.en: There was a commotion at the back of the hall, and every head turned.
commotion.zh: 大厅后面一阵骚动，所有人都回过头去。

commuter.en: The 7:15 is full of commuters who know exactly where to stand.
commuter.zh: 七点一刻那班车全是通勤的人，他们清楚该站哪个位置。

comparable.en: The two flats are comparable in size, but only one has a garden.
comparable.zh: 两套公寓面积相当，但只有一套带花园。

compatible.en: This charger isn't compatible with the older model, so check the plug first.
compatible.zh: 这个充电器和旧款不兼容，先看清插头。

compel.en: The evidence compelled the jury to return a guilty verdict.
compel.zh: 证据迫使陪审团作出有罪裁决。

compensation.en: After six months of letters he finally received compensation for the cancelled flight.
compensation.zh: 写了半年信之后，他终于拿到了航班取消的赔偿。

competence.en: Nobody doubted her competence; they doubted she would ever be given the authority.
competence.zh: 没人怀疑她的能力，怀疑的是她会不会真拿到相应权力。

compile.en: She compiled a list of every shop that stocks the part, then rang them all.
compile.zh: 她列出所有卖这个零件的店，然后一家家打电话。

complexion.en: Years of sailing had left him with a weathered complexion.
complexion.zh: 多年航海让他的脸成了饱经风霜的颜色。

compliance.en: The factory was fined for non-compliance with the safety rules.
compliance.zh: 这家工厂因未遵守安全规定被罚款。

complication.en: The surgery went well, but a lung infection brought complications.
complication.zh: 手术很顺利，但一次肺部感染带来了并发症。

compose.en: She composed the piece in a single night, then revised it for months.
compose.zh: 她一夜写成了那支曲子，之后又改了几个月。

composite.en: The hull is a composite of wood and resin, light yet hard to split.
composite.zh: 船体是木材与树脂的复合材料，轻，而且不易开裂。

compress.en: Compress the file before you email it; it's forty megabytes as it stands.
compress.zh: 发邮件前先压缩，这个文件现在有四十兆。

comprise.en: The team comprises four engineers and a part-time translator.
comprise.zh: 团队由四名工程师和一名兼职译员组成。

concede.en: He conceded that the plan had been rushed, but insisted it could still work.
concede.zh: 他承认计划做得匆忙，但坚持说仍然行得通。

conception.en: My conception of the city changed completely after a week of walking it.
conception.zh: 步行转了七天之后，我对这座城市的想法彻底变了。

concerted.en: The litter problem needs a concerted effort from the council and residents alike.
concerted.zh: 垃圾问题需要市议会和居民一起使劲。

concession.en: The museum offers a concession for students and anyone over sixty-five.
concession.zh: 博物馆对学生和六十五岁以上人士有优惠票价。

concessions.en: The union won two concessions on overtime and one on sick pay.
concessions.zh: 工会在加班问题上争到两处让步，在病假工资上争到一处。

concoct.en: He concocted a story about a flat tyre, but the mud on his shoes said otherwise.
concoct.zh: 他编了个爆胎的故事，可鞋上的泥另说一套。

condense.en: Condense the report to two pages; nobody reads further than that.
condense.zh: 把报告压到两页，再长没人看。

condolence.en: She sent a card of condolence and a week's worth of cooked meals.
condolence.zh: 她寄去一张吊唁卡，还有够吃一周的做好的饭菜。

conducive.en: A quiet room is far more conducive to study than a café with music.
conducive.zh: 安静的房间比放着音乐的咖啡馆更有利于学习。

confer.en: The judges conferred for twenty minutes before naming the winner.
confer.zh: 评委商量了二十分钟才宣布获胜者。

confidential.en: Mark the file confidential and keep it off the shared drive.
confidential.zh: 把这份文件标为机密，别放在共享盘上。

configuration.en: The default configuration works fine, but you can move the panels around.
configuration.zh: 默认配置就够用，不过面板位置可以自己调。

confine.en: A fever confined him to bed for a week.
confine.zh: 一场发烧让他在床上躺了一周。

confirmation.en: I'm still waiting for confirmation that the room is actually booked.
confirmation.zh: 我还在等房间确实订上的确认。

congestion.en: The new bus lane cut congestion on the ring road by a third.
congestion.zh: 新设的公交专用道让环路的拥堵少了三分之一。

congruent.en: The two accounts of that night are congruent in every detail.
congruent.zh: 关于那一晚的两种说法，每个细节都吻合。

conjunction.en: The concert was staged in conjunction with the local school.
conjunction.zh: 这场音乐会是与当地学校联合举办的。

conqueror.en: The conquerors built their fortress on the hill and never left it.
conqueror.zh: 征服者把堡垒建在山上，此后再没离开。

conquest.en: The conquest of that mountain took three attempts and two lives.
conquest.zh: 征服那座山用了三次尝试和两条人命。

conscientious.en: She is a conscientious editor who checks every name twice.
conscientious.zh: 她是个很尽责的编辑，每个名字都要查两遍。

consensus.en: There was no consensus on where the bike racks should go.
consensus.zh: 自行车架装在哪儿，大家始终没有共识。

consequent.en: The heavy rain and consequent flooding closed the school for two days.
consequent.zh: 大雨以及随之而来的洪水让学校停课两天。

conservatory.en: They added a small conservatory so the lemon trees could survive the winter.
conservatory.zh: 他们加建了一间小温室，好让柠檬树过冬。

conserve.en: Turning off the lights is the easiest way to conserve energy at home.
conserve.zh: 随手关灯是家里最省电的办法。

consign.en: The old files were consigned to the basement and forgotten for a decade.
consign.zh: 那些旧文件被塞进地下室，十年没人想起。

consolidate.en: The two departments were consolidated onto one open-plan floor.
consolidate.zh: 两个部门合并成了一层开放式办公区。

constituent.en: Each constituent wrote to the MP about the hospital closure.
constituent.zh: 每位选民都为医院关闭的事写信给议员。

constrain.en: A tight budget constrained what the team could actually test.
constrain.zh: 预算紧张，限制了团队真正能测的东西。

constrict.en: The collar constricted his throat, so he loosened it before speaking.
constrict.zh: 衣领勒着喉咙，他开口前先松了松。

consultant.en: The consultant gave us three options and no recommendation at all.
consultant.zh: 顾问给了我们三个方案，却一条建议都没提。

contacts.en: He made most of his business contacts at a trade fair in Milan.
contacts.zh: 他的生意人脉大多是在米兰的一次展会上建立的。

container.en: Label the container with the date before you freeze the soup.
container.zh: 冻汤之前先在容器上写好日期。

contaminants.en: Tests found contaminants in the well, so the village switched to bottled water.
contaminants.zh: 检测发现井里有污染物，全村改喝瓶装水。

contaminate.en: One cracked jar contaminated the whole batch of jam.
contaminate.zh: 一个裂了的罐子污染了整批果酱。

contend.en: Three candidates will contend for the single seat on the school board this autumn.
contend.zh: 今年秋天将有三名候选人角逐学校董事会唯一的席位。

contention.en: Her contention that the delay came from the software never convinced the auditors.
contention.zh: 她说是软件造成了延误，这一说法始终没能让审计人员信服。

continuity.en: Keeping the same project manager gave the team continuity when it moved to a new office.
continuity.zh: 团队搬去新办公室时，留任同一位项目经理让大家的工作接得上。

contracts.en: Every spring the mill contracts with nearby growers before the harvest.
contracts.zh: 每年春天，磨坊都在收割前与附近的种植户签好合同。

contribution.en: Her quiet contribution — checking every figure twice — saved the report from a costly error.
contribution.zh: 她那份不起眼的贡献——把每个数字核对两遍——让报告免于一个代价高昂的错误。

contrive.en: Somehow the children contrived to finish their homework and build a fort before dinner.
contrive.zh: 孩子们不知怎么竟在晚饭前写完了作业，还搭好了一座堡垒。

controversy.en: The plan to widen the road stirred controversy among residents who feared losing their gardens.
controversy.zh: 拓宽道路的方案引起了居民争议，他们担心失去自家花园。

convene.en: The committee will convene at nine in the old library to vote on the proposal.
convene.zh: 委员会九点将在老图书馆开会，就这项提案投票。

convention.en: By convention, the youngest member speaks last at these family dinners.
convention.zh: 按惯例，这种家庭聚餐上最年轻的成员最后发言。

converge.en: Two hiking trails converge at the ridge, where a wooden sign points to the summit.
converge.zh: 两条登山步道在山脊汇合，那儿有块木牌指向山顶。

conversely.en: Solar panels work best in strong sun; conversely, they lose efficiency once shaded.
conversely.zh: 太阳能板在强光下效率最高；反过来，一被遮挡就掉效率。

convict.en: The jury took six hours to convict him of taking money from the charity.
convict.zh: 陪审团用了六个小时，才判定他盗用慈善款项罪名成立。

coordinate.en: She coordinates deliveries so that no truck reaches the warehouse before it opens.
coordinate.zh: 她协调送货时间，确保没有车在仓库开门前到达。

cordial.en: Though they disagreed over the budget, the two mayors parted on cordial terms.
cordial.zh: 尽管在预算上意见相左，两位市长分手时仍客客气气。

cork.en: He eased the cork out of the bottle and poured a little for everyone to taste.
cork.zh: 他轻轻拔出瓶塞，给每人倒了一点让大家尝。

corps.en: The medical corps had a field hospital standing within hours of the earthquake.
corps.zh: 地震发生后几小时，医疗队就支起了野战医院。

correlate.en: Researchers found that sleep quality correlates with how much time children spend outdoors.
correlate.zh: 研究人员发现，睡眠质量与孩子户外活动的时间相关。

correspondence.en: The archive holds fifty years of correspondence between the poet and her editor.
correspondence.zh: 档案馆保存着这位诗人与编辑之间五十年的通信。

correspondent.en: The paper's correspondent in Nairobi filed three reports before dawn.
correspondent.zh: 该报驻内罗毕的记者天亮前发回了三篇报道。

corresponding.en: Every form carries a number on the front and a corresponding box to tick on the back.
corresponding.zh: 每张表正面有个编号，背面有对应的方框要勾。

corrode.en: Salt spray had corroded the railings until they crumbled at a touch.
corrode.zh: 盐雾把栏杆锈蚀得轻轻一碰就掉渣。

cosmic.en: The lecture traced how cosmic rays reach the atmosphere and break into showers of particles.
cosmic.zh: 讲座讲了宇宙射线如何抵达大气层，又碎裂成粒子簇射。

cosmopolitan.en: The port feels surprisingly cosmopolitan: a dozen languages float around the fish market.
cosmopolitan.zh: 这个港口出人意料地国际化：鱼市上飘着十几种语言。

cosy.en: We spent the rainy afternoon in a cosy corner of the cafe with two pots of tea.
cosy.zh: 那个下雨的下午，我们窝在咖啡馆舒服的角落里，喝了两壶茶。

cot.en: The baby slept in a cot by the window while her mother unpacked.
cot.zh: 婴儿睡在窗边的小床上，她妈妈在旁边拆行李。

counsel.en: Before signing anything, she sought counsel from a lawyer who knew the trade.
counsel.zh: 签字之前，她向一位懂行的律师求了意见。

counterbalance.en: The heavy base counterbalances the tall lamp and keeps it from tipping over.
counterbalance.zh: 沉底座平衡了高高的灯身，使灯不会翻倒。

counterfeit.en: Customs officers seized a crate of counterfeit handbags headed for a street market.
counterfeit.zh: 海关人员查获了一箱准备运往街市的假名牌手袋。

counterpart.en: The minister met her German counterpart to talk about the new rail link.
counterpart.zh: 部长会见了德国的对等官员，谈新的铁路连线。

courier.en: A courier turned up at eight with the signed papers, still warm from the printer.
courier.zh: 八点来了个快递员，送来签好的文件，纸还带着打印机的热乎劲儿。

courtesy.en: The hotel runs a free shuttle to the airport as a courtesy to guests.
courtesy.zh: 酒店给客人免费提供去机场的班车，算是一份礼数。

coverage.en: The storm knocked out mobile coverage across three valleys for two days.
coverage.zh: 暴风雨使三个山谷的手机信号断了两天。

crease.en: He ironed the shirt twice and still could not press the crease out of the collar.
crease.zh: 衬衫他熨了两遍，领子上的褶还是压不平。

credentials.en: The clinic asks every new doctor for credentials before the first shift.
credentials.zh: 诊所要每位新医生在头一个班前交齐资质材料。

cripple.en: A port strike could cripple the country's export trade for months.
cripple.zh: 港口罢工可能让该国出口贸易瘫痪数月。

crisp.en: The morning was crisp and cold, and frost had outlined every fence post.
crisp.zh: 早晨又冷又清爽，霜把每根栅栏柱都描了边。

crude.en: They built a crude shelter out of branches and a sheet of plastic.
crude.zh: 他们用树枝加一块塑料布搭了个简陋的窝棚。

crumb.en: She swept the crumbs off the card table before the guests sat down.
crumb.zh: 客人落座之前，她把牌桌上的碎屑扫干净了。

crumple.en: He crumpled the rejection letter into a ball and threw it at the bin.
crumple.zh: 他把拒信揉成一团，朝垃圾桶扔过去。

crystal.en: The cave floor was rough with crystals that glittered under the torch.
crystal.zh: 洞底满是水晶，在手电光下闪闪发亮。

cue.en: When the orchestra leader lifted his bow, that was our cue to stop talking.
cue.zh: 乐团首席一举弓，那就是我们该闭嘴的信号。

culminate.en: Four years of rehearsals culminated in one evening at the town hall.
culminate.zh: 四年的排练最终落在市政厅的一个晚上。

cultivate.en: She cultivates tomatoes on the roof and hands the surplus to neighbours.
cultivate.zh: 她在屋顶种番茄，多出来的送给邻居。

cultivation.en: Rice cultivation has shaped the look of this valley for centuries.
cultivation.zh: 几个世纪以来，水稻种植塑造了这条山谷的样子。

cumbersome.en: The old camera is cumbersome to carry, but its pictures are worth the weight.
cumbersome.zh: 那台老相机带着累赘，可拍出来的照片对得起这份分量。

cumulative.en: The cumulative effect of small repairs kept the bridge in use for another decade.
cumulative.zh: 一次次小修小补累积起来，让这座桥又撑了十年。

curb.en: The council put up barriers to curb speeding outside the primary school.
curb.zh: 市里竖了护栏，遏制小学门口的超速。

curl.en: The cat curled up on the warm laptop and would not budge.
curl.zh: 猫蜷在温热的笔记本上，怎么也不肯挪。

curriculum.en: The new curriculum gives pupils an hour a week for their own projects.
curriculum.zh: 新课程每周给学生一小时做自己的项目。

curtail.en: He curtailed his holiday by two days to attend the funeral.
curtail.zh: 他把假期砍掉两天，赶去参加葬礼。

curve.en: The road curves sharply just past the mill, so ease off there.
curve.zh: 过了磨坊路就急弯，那儿得减速。

cushion.en: She tucked a cushion behind her back and settled in for the long ride.
cushion.zh: 她在背后塞了个靠垫，安顿下来准备长途坐车。

custodian.en: The custodian unlocks the gym at six and checks the boiler every morning.
custodian.zh: 管理员早上六点开体育馆门，每天还要查一遍锅炉。

dairy.en: Their dairy supplies milk to three villages and a cheese shop in town.
dairy.zh: 他们的奶牛场给三个村子送货，还供镇上的一家奶酪店。

dart.en: A lizard darted across the path and vanished into the dry grass.
dart.zh: 一只蜥蜴窜过小路，钻进干草里不见了。

dazzle.en: The low sun dazzled drivers on the bridge and traffic crawled.
dazzle.zh: 低太阳晃得桥上司机眼花，车流只能慢慢挪。

dearth.en: There is a dearth of qualified nurses in the mountain districts.

decimal.en: Round the answer to two decimal places and write it in the box.
decimal.zh: 答案保留两位小数，写进方框里。

decipher.en: It took her an hour to decipher her grandfather's handwriting on the postcard.
decipher.zh: 她花了一个钟头，才认出明信片上爷爷的字迹。

declaration.en: The declaration was read aloud on the steps of the town hall.
declaration.zh: 那份宣言在市政厅台阶上被当众宣读。

decompose.en: Bacteria decompose the fallen leaves and give the nutrients back to the soil.
decompose.zh: 细菌分解落叶，把养分还给土壤。

decorations.en: They strung paper decorations across the kitchen for the birthday party.
decorations.zh: 为了生日会，他们在厨房里拉满了纸彩饰。

decrepit.en: The decrepit pier has been fenced off since the last storm.
decrepit.zh: 上次风暴过后，那段破败的栈桥就围了起来。

dedicate.en: He dedicated the book to the teacher who first showed him a telescope.
dedicate.zh: 他把这本书题献给那位第一次带他看望远镜的老师。

deduce.en: From the wet footprints she deduced that someone had come in from the garden.
deduce.zh: 她看着湿脚印推断，有人从花园那边进来过。

deduct.en: The company deducts tax from your pay before it reaches your account.
deduct.zh: 公司会在钱到你账户之前先把税扣掉。

deem.en: The council deemed the building unsafe and shut it the same week.
deem.zh: 议会认定这栋楼不安全，同一周就关了。

default.en: Miss the deadline and the system will default to the original schedule.
default.zh: 错过截止时间，系统就默认按原定日程走。

defence.en: The village raised money for flood defences after the river broke its banks.
defence.zh: 河水决口之后，村里凑钱修了防洪设施。

defer.en: She deferred her university place for a year to work on a farm.
defer.zh: 她把大学入学推迟一年，先去农场干活。

deficiency.en: The blood test showed an iron deficiency, which explained the tiredness.
deficiency.zh: 血检显示缺铁，这也解释了她为什么老是累。

deficit.en: The library ran a deficit for three years before the town raised its grant.
deficit.zh: 图书馆连亏三年，镇里才提高了拨款。

defile.en: Litter had defiled the shrine, so volunteers came at dawn to clear it.
defile.zh: 垃圾弄脏了这座神庙，志愿者天不亮就来收拾。

definitive.en: The definitive study of the species appeared only after her death.
definitive.zh: 关于这个物种最权威的研究，是她去世之后才发表的。

deflate.en: A slow puncture deflated the tyre halfway to the coast.
deflate.zh: 轮胎慢漏气，开到离海一半路就瘪了。

deflect.en: The keeper deflected the shot with the tips of her gloves.
deflect.zh: 守门员用指尖把球挡了出去。

defraud.en: He was jailed for defrauding elderly clients of their savings.
defraud.zh: 他骗走老年客户的存款，因此入狱。

deft.en: With a few deft strokes she sketched the whole harbour.
deft.zh: 她几笔利落的线条就画出了整个港口。

degenerate.en: Left unmanaged, the discussion degenerated into a shouting match.
degenerate.zh: 不加管束，讨论就变成了互相吼。

degrade.en: Plastic bags degrade slowly and can choke animals at sea.
degrade.zh: 塑料袋降解得慢，还可能把海里的动物噎死。

delectable.en: The bakery sells delectable almond tarts that are gone by noon.
delectable.zh: 那家店的杏仁挞好吃得很，中午之前就卖完。

delegate.en: A good manager delegates the small calls and keeps the big ones.
delegate.zh: 好的管理者把小事交出去，大事自己拿主意。

delinquency.en: The youth club was started to cut delinquency on the estate.
delinquency.zh: 这个青少年俱乐部是为了减少小区里的少年犯事而办起来的。

delirium.en: The fever kept him in a delirium for two nights.
delirium.zh: 高烧让他连着两夜神志昏乱。

delude.en: Don't delude yourself into thinking the exam will be easy.
delude.zh: 别自己骗自己，以为考试会简单。

deluge.en: A sudden deluge turned the street into a shallow river.
deluge.zh: 一场骤雨把街道变成了浅浅的河。

demolish.en: Crews will demolish the old cinema to make way for flats.
demolish.zh: 施工队要拆掉旧电影院，给公寓楼腾地。

denial.en: His denial sounded learned by heart, and nobody at the table believed it.
denial.zh: 他的否认像背下来的台词，桌上没一个人信。

denomination.en: After dark the shop accepts only notes of the smallest denomination.
denomination.zh: 天黑以后，这家店只收面额最小的纸币。

denote.en: On this map a red triangle denotes a campsite with running water.
denote.zh: 在这张图上，红三角代表有自来水的营地。

denounce.en: The bishop denounced the plan to sell the old churchyard.
denounce.zh: 主教公开谴责出售老教堂墓地的计划。

dense.en: The wood is so dense that sunlight barely gets down to the path.
dense.zh: 林子太密，阳光几乎落不到小路上。

departmental.en: The departmental meeting moved to Thursday because of the audit.
departmental.zh: 因为审计，部门会改到了周四。

deplete.en: Overfishing has depleted the cod stocks along this coast.
deplete.zh: 过度捕捞把头鳕资源耗得差不多了。

deplore.en: Residents deplore the noise from the new freight depot.
deplore.zh: 居民对新货运站的噪音很不满。

depress.en: The grey news reports depressed everyone at the dinner table.
depress.zh: 那些灰暗的新闻让饭桌上的人都闷了下来。

derelict.en: A derelict warehouse now holds a climbing gym.
derelict.zh: 一座废掉的仓库现在成了攀岩馆。

descend.en: We descended into the valley as the light began to go.
descend.zh: 光线开始暗下去时，我们下到了山谷里。

descent.en: The descent took three hours over loose stones.
descent.zh: 沿碎石下撤花了三个小时。

designate.en: The council designated the meadow a nature reserve last spring.
designate.zh: 去年春天，议会把这片草甸划成了自然保护区。

desolate.en: The lighthouse stands on a desolate stretch of coast, miles from any house.
desolate.zh: 灯塔立在一片荒凉的海岸上，离最近的房子也有好几英里。

despatch.en: The office will despatch your order within two working days.
despatch.zh: 办公室会在两个工作日内把你的订单发出去。

destine.en: Those letters were destined for a museum, not a rubbish bin.
destine.zh: 那些信件本该进博物馆，而不是垃圾桶。

detach.en: Detach the form from the booklet and keep the stub.
detach.zh: 把表格从本子上撕下来，存根留着。

detain.en: Police detained two men for questioning after the break-in.
detain.zh: 入室案发生后，警方留了两名男子问话。

deter.en: Bright lights and a barking dog deter most intruders.
deter.zh: 亮灯加上一条会叫的狗，能吓退多数想闯进来的人。

detriment.en: He worked nights for years, to the detriment of his health.
detriment.zh: 他上了多年夜班，身体也跟着垮了。

detrimental.en: Too much screen time is detrimental to a child's sleep.
detrimental.zh: 盯屏幕太久对孩子睡眠有害。

devastate.en: One flood can devastate a farm that took a lifetime to build.
devastate.zh: 一场洪水就能毁掉一个人一辈子攒起来的农场。

deviate.en: The pilot deviated from the flight plan to skirt the storm.
deviate.zh: 飞行员偏离航线，绕开风暴。

devise.en: The engineers devised a pulley rig to get the boat over the wall.
devise.zh: 工程师设计了一套滑轮，把船吊过了墙。

devour.en: The children devoured the whole cake before anyone noticed.
devour.zh: 还没人反应过来，孩子们就把整块蛋糕吃光了。

diagnose.en: The vet diagnosed a cracked hoof and ordered two weeks' rest.
diagnose.zh: 兽医诊断是蹄子裂了，要求歇两周。

differentiate.en: Can you differentiate the twins by their handwriting?
differentiate.zh: 你能靠字迹分出这对双胞胎吗？

diffuse.en: By mid-morning the smell of coffee had diffused through the office.
diffuse.zh: 到上午十点来钟，咖啡香已经漫遍了办公室。

dilapidated.en: They bought a dilapidated cottage and spent two summers putting it right.
dilapidated.zh: 他们买下一座破败的小屋，花了两个夏天修好。

dilate.en: The doctor put drops in my eyes to dilate the pupils.
dilate.zh: 医生给我滴了眼药水，把瞳孔放大。

dilute.en: Dilute the syrup with three parts water before pouring it over the fruit.
dilute.zh: 糖浆兑三份水稀释，再浇到水果上。

dimension.en: The room's narrow dimension rules out a long table.
dimension.zh: 房间进深太窄，长桌放不下。

din.en: We had to shout over the din of the machines.
din.zh: 机器的轰鸣太吵，我们只能喊着说话。

dingy.en: The stairwell was dingy and half the bulbs had gone.
dingy.zh: 楼梯间又暗又脏，一半灯泡都不亮了。

dip.en: She dipped her brush in the paint and started on the fence.
dip.zh: 她把刷子蘸进漆桶，动手刷栅栏。

diplomas.en: Two diplomas hang above his desk, both slightly crooked.
diplomas.zh: 他书桌上方挂着两张文凭，都有点歪。

disarray.en: Files lay in disarray across the floor after the move.
disarray.zh: 搬完家，文件乱七八糟摊了一地。

discard.en: Discard any bulbs that feel soft before you plant them.
discard.zh: 种之前把摸着发软的球茎挑出去。

discern.en: In the fog I could barely discern the outline of the pier.
discern.zh: 雾里我勉强能看出码头的轮廓。

disclose.en: The company would not disclose what it paid for the land.
disclose.zh: 公司不肯透露这块地花了多少钱。

discrepancy.en: Auditors spotted a discrepancy between the invoice and the delivery note.
discrepancy.zh: 审计人员发现发票和送货单之间有一处不符。

discrete.en: The course splits into six discrete units, each with its own exam.
discrete.zh: 这门课分成六个独立单元，各有各的考试。

discriminate.en: The law forbids employers to discriminate on grounds of age.
discriminate.zh: 法律禁止雇主以年龄为由区别对待员工。

disdain.en: She looked at the instant noodles with disdain and ordered a proper meal.
disdain.zh: 她嫌弃地瞄了眼方便面，点了顿正经饭。

dispatch.en: The paper dispatched a reporter to the flood zone that night.
dispatch.zh: 报社当晚派记者去了洪区。

disperse.en: The crowd dispersed quietly once the music stopped.
disperse.zh: 音乐一停，人群就静静散了。

displace.en: The new dam displaced four hundred families from the valley.
displace.zh: 新水坝让四百户人家搬离了山谷。

dispose.en: Please dispose of batteries at the collection point by the door.
dispose.zh: 电池请丢到门口的回收点。

disposition.en: Her cheerful disposition made her the obvious one to greet visitors.
disposition.zh: 她性子开朗，自然就成了接待访客的人选。

dispute.en: The two neighbours are in dispute over a strip of land three metres wide.
dispute.zh: 两家邻居为一条三米宽的地界吵个不停。

disregard.en: He disregarded the warning signs and swam out past the rocks.
disregard.zh: 他没理警示牌，游到了礁石外头。

dissipate.en: The morning mist dissipated as soon as the sun cleared the hill.
dissipate.zh: 太阳一过山头，晨雾就散了。

dissolve.en: Stir until the sugar dissolves completely in the warm milk.
dissolve.zh: 搅到糖在温牛奶里完全化开。

distend.en: The balloon distended until the rubber went thin and shiny.
distend.zh: 气球越鼓越大，橡皮都绷得又薄又亮。

distil.en: They distil the fruit into a strong clear spirit.
distil.zh: 他们把那果子蒸馏成一种清亮的烈酒。

distort.en: The cheap lens distorts faces near the edge of the photo.
distort.zh: 便宜镜头会让照片边上的人脸变形。

distraction.en: Working by the window is a constant distraction for me.
distraction.zh: 靠窗干活，对我来说一直是种分心。

distress.en: The ship sent a distress signal just after midnight.
distress.zh: 刚过午夜，那艘船发出了求救信号。

distribute.en: Volunteers distributed blankets to everyone in the shelter.
distribute.zh: 志愿者给收容所里的人挨个发了毯子。

disturbance.en: The roadworks caused a disturbance that went on all night.
disturbance.zh: 道路施工闹出的动静整整一夜。

diversion.en: A diversion sent traffic round the closed bridge for a week.
diversion.zh: 因为桥封了，车流绕行绕了整整一周。

divert.en: The parade was diverted around the square because of the repairs.
divert.zh: 因为施工，游行队伍改道绕开了广场。

dividend.en: The cooperative pays a dividend to every member at the end of the year.
dividend.zh: 合作社年底给每位成员分红。

doctrine.en: The doctrine of fair use permits limited copying for teaching.
doctrine.zh: 合理使用这一原则允许为教学做有限的复制。

domain.en: Wildlife photography is her domain; she knows every hide in the county.
domain.zh: 野生动物摄影是她的地盘，县里每个隐藏观察点她都门儿清。

dominant.en: Oak is the dominant tree on this slope, with birch down in the hollows.
dominant.zh: 这片坡上以橡树为主，洼地里则是桦树。

dominate.en: One tall crane dominates the skyline of the new harbour.
dominate.zh: 一台高吊车压住了新港的天际线。

doom.en: Bad drainage doomed the crop long before the rains ended.
doom.zh: 排水不良，雨季还没完这季庄稼就注定没戏了。

dose.en: The label says one dose every six hours, never more than four a day.
dose.zh: 标签上写着六小时一剂，一天最多四次。

doubtless.en: Doubtless she has heard by now, given how fast gossip travels here.
doubtless.zh: 这儿闲话传得那叫一个快，她这会儿准听说了。

doze.en: He dozed in the armchair with the newspaper still open on his knees.
doze.zh: 他在扶手椅上打盹，报纸还摊在膝头。

drain.en: The sink drains slowly, so somebody needs to clear the trap.
drain.zh: 水槽下水慢，得有人把存水弯清一下。

drainage.en: The bottom field floods every spring because the drainage is blocked.
drainage.zh: 最下面那块地年年春天积水，排水沟堵了。

dramatic.en: Complaints fell away in a dramatic fashion after the new manager arrived.
dramatic.zh: 新经理来了以后，投诉量掉得很猛。

dreary.en: The waiting room was dreary: grey walls, one dead plant, a stopped clock.
dreary.zh: 候诊室死气沉沉：灰墙、一盆蔫死的植物、一只停了的钟。

drench.en: The sprinkler drenched the path and we had to jump across.
drench.zh: 洒水器把小路浇得透湿，我们只能跳过去。

drop-off.en: The drop-off point for recycling sits behind the supermarket.
drop-off.zh: 回收物的交投点在超市后面。

dropout.en: The evening class has a high dropout rate because of the long commute.
dropout.zh: 因为通勤太远，晚课的退课率很高。

drowse.en: Cats drowse in the shade all afternoon and hunt at dusk.
drowse.zh: 猫一整个下午都在阴凉里打盹，黄昏才出去捕食。

drowsiness.en: The medicine can bring on drowsiness, so don't drive after a dose.
drowsiness.zh: 这药会让人犯困，吃完别开车。

dub.en: Critics dubbed the bridge 'the coat hanger' because of its shape.
dub.zh: 因为造型，评论者把那座桥叫作“晾衣架”。

duly.en: She duly noted the complaint and promised to look into it.
duly.zh: 她照规矩记下了投诉，答应去查。

durable.en: Canvas is durable enough for a bag that gets dragged onto buses.
durable.zh: 帆布够结实，做成天天被拖上公交的包也撑得住。

duration.en: For the duration of the repair, the pool stays closed.
duration.zh: 维修期间，泳池一直关着。

dwell.en: He still dwells on that mistake, long after everyone else has forgotten it.
dwell.zh: 那件事他到现在还反复琢磨，别人早忘了。

dwindle.en: Attendance dwindled once the evenings turned cold and dark.
dwindle.zh: 天一冷、天黑得早，来的人就一点点少了。

dynamic.en: The market is dynamic, so the plan needs reworking every quarter.
dynamic.zh: 市场变得快，计划每季度都得重做。

eddy.en: Leaves spun in an eddy below the weir for a good minute.
eddy.zh: 树叶在堰下的回水里转了足有一分钟。

effectively.en: The two routes are effectively the same length, so take the prettier one.
effectively.zh: 两条路其实一样长，那就挑好看的那条走。

eject.en: The machine ejects the finished part onto a tray at the side.
eject.zh: 机器把加工好的零件弹到侧面的托盘里。

elapse.en: Ten years had elapsed since the two sisters last stood in the same room.
elapse.zh: 姐妹俩上次同处一室，已是十年前的事了。

elastic.en: The waistband is elastic, so the trousers see him through the winter.
elastic.zh: 裤腰有松紧，整个冬天他都穿这条。

electronics.en: The electronics in the old radio gave up after thirty years.
electronics.zh: 那台老收音机的电子元件撑了三十年，终于坏了。

elevate.en: Prop the bed up to elevate the leg above the level of the heart.
elevate.zh: 把床垫高，让腿抬到高过心脏。

elicit.en: The question elicited a long silence and then a very honest answer.
elicit.zh: 这个问题先换来一阵沉默，然后是很坦诚的回答。

elite.en: Only a small elite can afford flats in that part of the city.
elite.zh: 城里那一带，只有少数有钱有势的人买得起房。

elsewhere.en: If the library is shut, try elsewhere in town; the museum has a reading room.
elsewhere.zh: 图书馆关了就去镇上别处，博物馆有个阅览室。

embargo.en: An embargo on grain exports pushed prices up across the region.
embargo.zh: 谷物出口禁令把整个地区的粮价推高了。

embark.en: They embarked on the renovation with more enthusiasm than money.
embark.zh: 他们着手翻修，热情远多过钱。

embed.en: A splinter of glass was embedded in the tyre tread.
embed.zh: 轮胎花纹里嵌着一小块玻璃。

emerge.en: The sun emerged from behind the clouds just as the ceremony began.
emerge.zh: 仪式刚开始，太阳就从云后露了出来。

emergencies.en: Keep a torch and a first-aid kit in the car for emergencies.
emergencies.zh: 车里放把手电和一个急救包，以备急用。

emigrate.en: Her grandparents emigrated in 1952 with two suitcases and a sewing machine.
emigrate.zh: 1952年，她的祖父母带着两个行李箱和一台缝纫机移居海外。

eminent.en: An eminent historian will open the exhibition on Friday.
eminent.zh: 一位著名历史学家周五来为展览揭幕。

emit.en: The old fridge emits a low hum that keeps the kitchen company.
emit.zh: 那台旧冰箱发出低低的嗡声，像在陪着厨房。

empirical.en: There is little empirical evidence that the method actually works.
empirical.zh: 几乎没有实证证据说明这个法子真管用。

employer.en: Her employer pays for the training and lets her study on Fridays.
employer.zh: 她老板出钱让她培训，还准她周五去上课。

enclose.en: Please enclose a stamped envelope with your application.
enclose.zh: 随申请材料附一个贴好邮票的信封。

enclosure.en: The goats graze inside a wire enclosure at night.
enclosure.zh: 夜里山羊在铁网围栏里吃草。

endorse.en: Three former coaches endorsed the plan to rebuild the stadium.
endorse.zh: 三位前任教练都支持重建体育场的方案。

endow.en: A local family endowed the school with a small library in 1908.
endow.zh: 1908年，当地一户人家捐资给学校建了一座小图书馆。

endurance.en: The race tests endurance far more than speed.
endurance.zh: 这场比赛比的是耐力，速度倒在其次。

enforce.en: Inspectors enforce the smoke-free rule with spot checks.
enforce.zh: 检查员靠突击抽查来执行禁烟规定。

engrave.en: They engraved the date on the inside of the ring.
engrave.zh: 他们把日期刻在了戒指内侧。

engross.en: The chess match engrossed him so completely that he missed his stop.
engross.zh: 那盘棋让他全神投入，结果坐过了站。

enhance.en: A coat of wax enhances the colour of the wood.
enhance.zh: 打一层蜡，木头的颜色更亮眼。

enlighten.en: The guide enlightened us about why the tower leans.
enlighten.zh: 导游讲明白了这座塔为什么会歪。

enquiry.en: The office had an enquiry about opening times from a school group.
enquiry.zh: 办公室接到一个学校团体的咨询，问开放时间。

enrolment.en: Enrolment for the autumn term closes on the twentieth.
enrolment.zh: 秋季学期报名二十号截止。

ensemble.en: The string ensemble rehearses in the church on Tuesdays.
ensemble.zh: 弦乐小组每周二在教堂排练。

ensue.en: A heated argument ensued after the referee's decision.
ensue.zh: 裁判一判，争执就爆发了。

entail.en: Running a guesthouse entails far more paperwork than people imagine.
entail.zh: 开民宿要应付的单据，比外人想的多得多。

entangle.en: A gull got entangled in fishing line and had to be cut free.
entangle.zh: 一只海鸥被鱼线缠住，只好剪开救出来。

enterprise.en: The bakery is a small family enterprise with four employees.
enterprise.zh: 这家面包店是家只有四个人的小家族企业。

entitle.en: The ticket entitles you to one free drink at the bar.
entitle.zh: 凭这张票可以在吧台免费换一杯饮料。

entity.en: After the merger the two firms became a single legal entity.
entity.zh: 合并之后，两家公司成了一个法律实体。

entreat.en: She entreated the landlord to give them one more month.
entreat.zh: 她求房东再宽限一个月。

envisage.en: Nobody envisaged that the shop would outgrow its first room within a year.
envisage.zh: 谁也没料到这店一年就装不下头一间铺面了。

enzyme.en: This enzyme breaks starch down into sugar at room temperature.
enzyme.zh: 这种酶在室温下就能把淀粉分解成糖。

ephemeral.en: Fame on the internet can be ephemeral, gone within a week.
ephemeral.zh: 网上红起来可能转眼就散，一周就没人提了。

epoch.en: The printing press opened a new epoch in how people shared ideas.
epoch.zh: 印刷机开辟了人们交流思想的新纪元。

equitable.en: The agreement aims at an equitable share of the water for both villages.
equitable.zh: 这份协议是为了让两个村子公平分水。

equity.en: They sold the house and split the equity between them.
equity.zh: 他们把房子卖了，房产净值两人平分。

equivocal.en: His answer was equivocal: he neither agreed nor refused.
equivocal.zh: 他答得含糊，既没答应也没拒绝。

eradicate.en: The campaign aims to eradicate the weed from the whole valley.
eradicate.zh: 这项行动是要把这种杂草从整个山谷里根除。

erect.en: Workers erected a scaffold tower beside the chimney.
erect.zh: 工人们在烟囱旁立起了一座脚手架塔。

erosion.en: Coastal erosion has taken ten metres of cliff in twenty years.
erosion.zh: 海岸侵蚀二十年里吞掉了十米悬崖。

erratic.en: The bus has been erratic all week, sometimes skipping the stop entirely.
erratic.zh: 这周公交一直没准头，有时干脆不停站。

erroneous.en: The report rested on an erroneous figure for the population.
erroneous.zh: 那份报告建立在一个错误的人口数字上。

erupt.en: The argument erupted again the moment the inheritance was mentioned.
erupt.zh: 一提到遗产，争吵又炸开了。

escalate.en: What began as a complaint about noise escalated into a court case.
escalate.zh: 起初只是噪音投诉，最后闹上了法庭。

escort.en: Two officers escorted the visitors through the restricted area.
escort.zh: 两名警官把访客护送着穿过禁区。

estate.en: The estate has belonged to the family since the 1800s.
estate.zh: 这片庄园从十九世纪起就归这个家族所有。

esteem.en: He was held in high esteem by everyone who worked under him.
esteem.zh: 在他手下干过的人都很敬重他。

evade.en: The driver evaded the toll by taking the old coast road.
evade.zh: 司机走老海岸公路，绕开了收费站。

evaluate.en: The panel will evaluate the bids next month.
evaluate.zh: 评审小组下个月评估各家投标。

evaporate.en: The puddles evaporated before the children came out to play.
evaporate.zh: 孩子们出来玩之前，水洼就晒干了。

evict.en: The family was evicted after six months of unpaid rent.
evict.zh: 欠了六个月房租后，这家人被赶了出去。

evoke.en: The smell of woodsmoke evokes the winters of my childhood.
evoke.zh: 柴火烟的味道让我想起童年的冬天。

exacerbate.en: Cutting the budget would exacerbate the shortage of staff.
exacerbate.zh: 削减预算只会让人手更紧缺。

exasperate.en: The endless forms exasperated even the patient clerk.
exasperate.zh: 没完没了的表格，连性子最好的职员都被惹毛了。

excavate.en: Archaeologists excavated the site for three summers before they found the gate.
excavate.zh: 考古队在这个遗址挖了三个夏天，才找到城门。

exceedingly.en: The path is exceedingly steep near the top, so take your time.
exceedingly.zh: 快到顶上那段路极陡，慢慢走。

exceptional.en: Her memory for names is exceptional; she recalls every pupil in the school.
exceptional.zh: 她记名字的本事非比寻常，全校每个学生都叫得出来。

excerpt.en: The magazine printed an excerpt from her new novel.
excerpt.zh: 杂志刊登了她新小说的节选。

exclaim.en: 'It's snowing!' the boy exclaimed, nose pressed to the glass.
exclaim.zh: “下雪了！”男孩把鼻子贴在玻璃上喊。

exclude.en: The rule excludes anyone under sixteen from competing.
exclude.zh: 按规定，十六岁以下的人不能参赛。

exclusive.en: The club has an exclusive membership of forty households.
exclusive.zh: 这个俱乐部只有四十户人家有资格加入。

excrement.en: Seabird excrement on the cliffs feeds a whole community of plants.
excrement.zh: 崖上的海鸟粪养起了一整片植物群落。

exert.en: Tides exert a strong pull on the sandbanks at the river mouth.
exert.zh: 潮水对河口沙洲的拉扯很强。

exhilarate.en: The cold swim exhilarated her for the rest of the day.
exhilarate.zh: 那次冷水游泳让她一整天都神清气爽。

exhort.en: The coach exhorted the team to keep pressing for the last ten minutes.
exhort.zh: 教练激励队员在最后十分钟继续压上去。

exile.en: The poet spent twenty years in exile in Paris.
exile.zh: 那位诗人在巴黎流亡了二十年。

existent.en: The building is the oldest existent example of its kind in the county.
existent.zh: 这栋楼是该郡现存同类建筑中最老的一座。

exorbitant.en: They charge exorbitant prices for a cup of coffee at the summit.
exorbitant.zh: 山顶上一杯咖啡要价离谱。

exotic.en: The garden is full of exotic plants that need a heated greenhouse.
exotic.zh: 园子里尽是些要暖房过冬的外来植物。

expectancy.en: Life expectancy in the district has risen by six years since 1990.
expectancy.zh: 自1990年以来，该区人均预期寿命提高了六年。

expedient.en: Closing the road was the expedient choice, though hardly the fairest.
expedient.zh: 封路是个图省事的办法，但谈不上公平。

expel.en: The school expelled two boys for setting off fireworks in the hall.
expel.zh: 学校开除了两个在大厅里放烟花的男生。

expend.en: They expended most of the grant on new windows.
expend.zh: 他们把大半拨款花在了新窗户上。

expenditure.en: Public expenditure on libraries fell for the fourth year running.
expenditure.zh: 图书馆的公共开支连续第四年下降。

expertise.en: The job needs somebody with expertise in old stonework.
expertise.zh: 这活儿得找个懂古石作的人。

expire.en: My passport expires next March, so I should renew it now.
expire.zh: 我的护照明年三月到期，现在该去换了。

explicit.en: The instructions were explicit: no fires above the treeline.
explicit.zh: 规定说得明明白白：林线以上不许生火。

explosive.en: Gas in the old cellar had formed an explosive mixture.
explosive.zh: 老地窖里的气体已经形成了可爆炸的混合气。

export.en: The region exports most of its olive oil to the north.
export.zh: 这个地区把大部分橄榄油出口到北方。

exposure.en: Long exposure to wind and salt had worn the paint off the sign.
exposure.zh: 长期的风吹盐蚀，把牌子上的漆磨没了。

expulsion.en: His expulsion from the club followed a single angry letter.
expulsion.zh: 就因为一封骂人的信，他被俱乐部除了名。

exterior.en: The exterior of the church was cleaned last summer.
exterior.zh: 去年夏天，教堂外墙清洗过一遍。

exterminate.en: The campaign to exterminate rats in the granary took a month.
exterminate.zh: 清剿粮仓老鼠的行动花了一个月。

extort.en: He tried to extort money from his old partner by threatening to publish the letters.
extort.zh: 他拿公开那些信件要挟老搭档，想敲一笔钱。

extract.en: The dentist extracted two wisdom teeth on Friday.
extract.zh: 牙医周五拔了两颗智齿。

exuberant.en: The team gave an exuberant performance that had the crowd on its feet.
exuberant.zh: 全队演得生龙活虎，观众都站起来了。

fabricate.en: He fabricated an alibi that fell apart under the first question.
fabricate.zh: 他编了个不在场证明，一问就散了。

facet.en: Few tourists see the quieter facet of the city, the courtyards behind the walls.
facet.zh: 很少有游客看到这座城市安静的那一面——高墙后的院落。

facilitate.en: The new ferry facilitates travel between the two islands.
facilitate.zh: 新渡轮让两岛之间往来方便多了。

facilities.en: The campsite has basic facilities: water, toilets and a washing-up sink.
facilities.zh: 营地设施简单：有水、厕所和一个洗碗池。

facility.en: She has a real facility for languages and picked up Turkish in a year.
facility.zh: 她语言天赋很好，一年就学会了土耳其语。

falcons.en: Two falcons nest on the cathedral tower every spring.
falcons.zh: 每年春天都有两只隼在大教堂塔上筑巢。

fallacy.en: It is a fallacy that you lose most of your body heat through your head.
fallacy.zh: 认为人体热量大多从头部散失，这是种谬见。

fallible.en: Doctors are fallible, which is exactly why second opinions matter.
fallible.zh: 医生也会出错，所以才需要第二意见。

falter.en: Her voice faltered as she read the last paragraph aloud.
falter.zh: 她读最后一段时，声音抖了一下。

famine.en: The famine of 1846 drove thousands of families into the cities.
famine.zh: 1846年的饥荒把成千上万户人家赶进了城里。

fanatic.en: A football fanatic, he has not missed a home game in twenty years.
fanatic.zh: 他是个球痴，二十年没落过一场主场比赛。

fascinating.en: The museum's map collection is fascinating, especially the ones with sea monsters.
fascinating.zh: 博物馆的地图收藏很有意思，尤其是那些画着海怪的。

fastidious.en: She is fastidious about her pens and refuses anything that smudges.
fastidious.zh: 她对笔特别讲究，一写就洇的一概不要。

fatuous.en: The article was full of fatuous advice like 'just stay positive'.
fatuous.zh: 那篇文章满是“保持乐观就好”这类空洞建议。

feast.en: The village holds a feast every August to mark the harvest.
feast.zh: 村里每年八月办一场宴席庆祝丰收。

feat.en: Carrying the piano up four flights was a feat in itself.
feat.zh: 把钢琴抬上四层楼，本身就是件了不起的事。

federation.en: The clubs formed a federation so they could share a training ground.
federation.zh: 几家俱乐部结成联合会，好共用一块训练场。

feeble.en: The torch gave a feeble light, barely enough to read by.
feeble.zh: 手电光很微弱，勉强够看清字。

fend.en: She has had to fend for herself since she was fifteen.
fend.zh: 她十五岁起就得自己养活自己。

ferries.en: Two ferries cross the strait every hour in summer.
ferries.zh: 夏天每小时有两班渡轮过海峡。

fervent.en: He is a fervent supporter of the local orchestra.
fervent.zh: 他是本地管弦乐团的铁杆支持者。

fester.en: The wound festered because it was never cleaned properly.
fester.zh: 伤口化了脓，因为一直没好好清洗。

fetter.en: Debt fettered the young couple for a decade.
fetter.zh: 债务把这对年轻夫妻捆了十年。

feud.en: The feud between the two families goes back three generations.
feud.zh: 两家结的仇，得从三代以前说起。

fidelity.en: For its age, the recording has remarkable fidelity.
fidelity.zh: 就年代而言，这段录音的保真度高得出奇。

fierce.en: Competition for places at that school is fierce.
fierce.zh: 那所学校的入学竞争非常激烈。

filmed.en: Because the studio lights kept tripping the fuse, the interview was filmed at her kitchen table.
filmed.zh: 演播室的灯老是跳闸，采访只好改在她的餐桌上拍摄。

filth.en: After the floodwater went down, neighbours spent two days clearing filth off the ground floor.
filth.zh: 洪水退去后，邻居们花了两天时间清理一楼满地的污秽。

finite.en: We only have a finite supply of test tubes, so stop wasting them on guesses.
finite.zh: 试管数量有限，别再把它们浪费在瞎猜上了。

fitness.en: She joined the running club mainly to improve her fitness, not to enter races.
fitness.zh: 她加入跑步俱乐部主要是想增强体质，并不是为了参加比赛。

fixture.en: Nobody is allowed to move the brass lamp above the counter; it has been a fixture there since 1974.
fixture.zh: 柜台上面那盏黄铜灯谁都不许挪，从 1974 年起它就固定在那儿了。

flabby.en: Two months without training had left his arms noticeably flabby.
flabby.zh: 两个月没训练，他的手臂明显松软了下来。

flake.en: A flake of paint dropped into the sink while he scrubbed the wall.
flake.zh: 他刷墙的时候，一片油漆落进了水槽。

flank.en: Two officers flanked the doorway while the guests filed in.
flank.zh: 两位警官守在门口两侧，客人们依次进场。

flap.en: He licked the flap of the envelope and pressed it shut.
flap.zh: 他舔了舔信封的封口，把它按紧粘好。

flare.en: A flare of temper crossed her face when the waiter spilled the wine.
flare.zh: 服务员把酒洒了，她脸上瞬间闪过一丝火气。

flats.en: They rented one of the small flats above a bakery, where the smell of fresh bread woke them at five.
flats.zh: 他们租了面包店楼上的一间小公寓，每天五点就被新出炉的面包香叫醒。

flatter.en: You flatter me, but half of that design was her idea.
flatter.zh: 你太抬举我了，那设计有一半是她的主意。

flaunt.en: He rented the sports car mostly to flaunt it at the reunion.
flaunt.zh: 他租那辆跑车，主要是想在同学会上显摆一下。

fleet.en: By last spring, half of the bakery's delivery fleet ran on electricity.
fleet.zh: 到去年春天，这家面包店一半的送货车都换成了电动的。

fleeting.en: They exchanged a fleeting glance across the platform before the doors closed.
fleeting.zh: 车门关上前，他们在站台两端匆匆对望了一眼。

flexible.en: My manager keeps the schedule flexible so parents can swap shifts.
flexible.zh: 我们经理排班很灵活，方便有孩子的同事换班。

flicker.en: The corridor lights flickered twice, then went out altogether.
flicker.zh: 走廊的灯闪了两下，然后彻底灭了。

flourishment.en: Planners were startled by the flourishment of small carpentry workshops in the district.
flourishment.zh: 这一带小木工作坊的迅速兴隆，让规划部门也觉得意外。

fluctuate.en: Egg prices fluctuate wildly in the weeks before a big holiday.
fluctuate.zh: 每逢大节前几周，鸡蛋价格就大起大落。

flutter.en: A moth fluttered against the lampshade until he finally switched the light off.
flutter.zh: 一只飞蛾绕着灯罩扑腾，直到他把灯关掉。

flux.en: Staff numbers are in flux while the merger is still being negotiated.
flux.zh: 并购还在谈，员工人数一直处在变动中。

flyover.en: The new flyover cut twenty minutes off his drive to the hospital.
flyover.zh: 新建的高架桥让他去医院的车程少了二十分钟。

foam.en: The barista spooned foam onto the latte and slid it across the counter.
foam.zh: 咖啡师把奶泡舀到拿铁上，推过柜台递了过去。

foil.en: She wrapped the leftover fish in foil and put it in the bottom drawer.
foil.zh: 她用锡纸把剩鱼包好，放进了最下层的抽屉。

forbes.en: Forbes put the young founder on its rich list, which her old classmates found hilarious.
forbes.zh: 《福布斯》把这位年轻创始人列进了富豪榜，她的老同学都觉得好笑。

foremost.en: First and foremost, turn the gas off before you touch any of the wiring.
foremost.zh: 最要紧的是，动任何线路之前先把煤气关掉。

forerunner.en: That chunky handheld radio was a forerunner of the phone in your pocket.
forerunner.zh: 那种笨重的手持对讲机，就是你口袋里手机的前身。

forestry.en: He studied forestry and now manages a pine plantation up north.
forestry.zh: 他学的是林学，现在在北方管理一片松树林场。

forge.en: Someone had forged his signature on the delivery note.
forge.zh: 有人在送货单上伪造了他的签名。

format.en: The report has to reach the ministry as a PDF, in the format they specified on page two.
format.zh: 报告要以 PDF 交到部里，格式按他们第二页写明的要求。

formidable.en: On their own court, the defending champions look formidable.
formidable.zh: 卫冕冠军在自己主场看着相当难对付。

formulate.en: It took the committee weeks to formulate a rule both departments could live with.
formulate.zh: 委员会花了好几周，才拟出一条两个部门都能接受的规则。

fort.en: The old fort on the hill now holds a small museum of local history.
fort.zh: 山上的老要塞如今成了一座小型地方史博物馆。

forthcoming.en: She went oddly quiet when someone mentioned the forthcoming changes.
forthcoming.zh: 有人提到即将到来的变动时，她忽然不说话了。

forum.en: Residents now air their complaints about late-night noise on an online forum the city set up.
forum.zh: 居民现在都在市里开的网络论坛上抱怨深夜噪音。

fossils.en: The children dug fossils out of the cliff face and argued for an hour about what they were.
fossils.zh: 孩子们从崖壁上挖出几块化石，为那是什么争了一个小时。

foyer.en: He waited in the hotel foyer, watching the rain run down the glass doors.
foyer.zh: 他在酒店大堂等着，看雨水顺着玻璃门往下流。

fraction.en: Only a fraction of the budget went into training, which the staff noticed.
fraction.zh: 预算里只有一小部分用在培训上，员工们都看在眼里。

fracture.en: She fractured her wrist catching herself on the icy steps.
fracture.zh: 她在结冰的台阶上撑了一下，把手腕弄骨折了。

fragment.en: A fragment of glass was still wedged in the tyre when he pulled over.
fragment.zh: 他把车靠边停下时，轮胎里还卡着一块玻璃碴。

frantic.en: There was a frantic search for the missing passport an hour before boarding.
frantic.zh: 登机前一小时，大家手忙脚乱地找那本不见了的护照。

fraught.en: The conversation about money was fraught with tension from the first sentence.
fraught.zh: 关于钱的那场谈话，从第一句起就充满了紧张。

freak.en: A freak wave knocked him clean off the paddleboard.
freak.zh: 一道异常的巨浪直接把他从桨板上掀了下去。

freight.en: The freight train rumbled past the station at three in the morning.
freight.zh: 凌晨三点，货运列车轰隆隆地从车站驶过。

fret.en: Don't fret about the presentation; you've rehearsed it six times.
fret.zh: 别为汇报发愁了，你都排练六遍了。

friction.en: There is real friction between the kitchen and the front desk over shift changes.
friction.zh: 后厨和前厅为了换班的事，摩擦挺大。

fringe.en: Where the door kept rubbing it, the fringe of the carpet had frayed.
fringe.zh: 门老是蹭着的那片地方，地毯的流苏磨散了。

frontier.en: Her lab works at the frontier of battery research, where results are still unpredictable.
frontier.zh: 她的实验室做的是电池研究的最前沿，结果还很难预料。

frown.en: Asked who had changed the dosage, the head nurse frowned at the chart.
frown.zh: 有人问是谁改了剂量，护士长对着病历皱起了眉。

fruition.en: The orchard project finally came to fruition after seven years of grafting.
fruition.zh: 经过七年的嫁接，那片果园计划终于有了成果。

frustrate.en: Slow customs checks frustrated everyone on the bus.
frustrate.zh: 海关检查太慢，车上所有人都被磨得没了脾气。

fulfil.en: He fulfilled a childhood promise by taking his mother to see the sea.
fulfil.zh: 他带着母亲去看海，兑现了小时候的一个承诺。

fume.en: She fumed silently in the back seat all the way home.
fume.zh: 回家的路上，她在后座一路闷着生气没说话。

fund-raising.en: The choir's fund-raising dinner raised enough for a new piano.
fund-raising.zh: 合唱团的募款晚宴凑够了一架新钢琴的钱。

funnel.en: Rainwater funnelled off the broken gutter and soaked the porch.
funnel.zh: 雨水从断裂的檐槽里冲下来，把门廊泡湿了。

furnace.en: Nobody in the building slept well while the old furnace clanked all night.
furnace.zh: 老锅炉整晚哐当作响，楼里没人睡好。

furnish.en: The students were promised a furnished flat, but three months on there is still no bed.
furnish.zh: 说好给学生们一套配好家具的房子，可三个月过去连床都没有。

fury.en: He slammed the door in fury when the referee blew the whistle.
fury.zh: 裁判一吹哨，他气得把门狠狠摔上。

fuss.en: Don't make such a fuss about a little spilled coffee.
fuss.zh: 洒了点咖啡，别这么大惊小怪。

gaily.en: Flags hung gaily across the square for the harvest festival.
gaily.zh: 为庆祝丰收节，广场上挂满了鲜艳的旗子。

gale.en: A gale tore the tarpaulin off the roof before dawn.
gale.zh: 天没亮，一阵狂风就把屋顶的防水布掀掉了。

gallery.en: We spent the afternoon in a small gallery that shows only local printmakers.
gallery.zh: 我们在一个小画廊里待了一下午，那里只展本地版画家的作品。

gaol.en: For repeated theft, the magistrate sent him to gaol for six months.
gaol.zh: 因多次盗窃，治安法官判他入狱六个月。

gape.en: The tourists gaped at the size of the cathedral door.
gape.zh: 游客们看着大教堂那扇门的大小，张着嘴说不出话。

gasp.en: She gasped when the cold water hit her shoulders.
gasp.zh: 冷水一浇到肩上，她倒抽了一口气。

gaudy.en: With gold paint and plastic chandeliers, the hotel lobby managed to look gaudy and cheap at once.
gaudy.zh: 满眼金漆配塑料吊灯，酒店大堂既俗气又廉价。

generic.en: At half the price, the pharmacy sold him a generic version of the drug.
generic.zh: 药房半价卖给他同成分的仿制药。

genial.en: Behind the counter stood a genial old bookseller with a chair ready for browsers.
genial.zh: 柜台后站着位和气的旧书商，还替翻书的人备着椅子。

geographic.en: Rather than by city, the report maps the damage by geographic region.
geographic.zh: 报告不是按城市，而是按地理区域标注受灾情况。

geology.en: Her interest in geology started with a box of pebbles from a beach.
geology.zh: 她对地质学的兴趣，源于一盒从海滩捡来的小石子。

germ.en: A germ got into the jam jar because nobody put the lid back.
germ.zh: 没人把盖子盖回去，细菌进了果酱罐。

ghastly.en: The paint they chose turned out to be a ghastly shade of green.
ghastly.zh: 他们挑的漆刷上去是一种难看得要命的绿色。

gigantic.en: A gigantic crane lifted the bridge section into place overnight.
gigantic.zh: 一台巨型吊车连夜把桥段吊装到位。

giggle.en: Behind their hands, the girls giggled until the teacher looked up.
giggle.zh: 女孩们捂着嘴偷笑，直到老师抬起头。

gist.en: I missed the first ten minutes, so tell me the gist of his talk.
gist.zh: 前十分钟我没听到，你给我讲讲他讲话的要点吧。

glacier.en: So far has the glacier retreated that the old trail now ends on bare rock.
glacier.zh: 冰川退缩得厉害，老路线如今走到尽头只剩光秃秃的岩石。

glamour.en: Once she saw the night shifts, the job lost its glamour.
glamour.zh: 一看要上夜班，这份工作的光鲜就没了。

gland.en: According to the doctor, the swelling came from a blocked gland rather than an infection.
gland.zh: 按医生的说法，肿胀是腺体堵塞造成的，不是感染。

glare.en: He turned the visor down to block the glare off the wet road.
glare.zh: 他放下遮阳板，挡住湿路面上晃眼的反光。

glide.en: Without a sound, the canoe glided past the reeds.
glide.zh: 独木舟悄无声息地滑过芦苇丛。

glimmer.en: There was still a glimmer of light under the workshop door at midnight.
glimmer.zh: 半夜了，车间门下还透出一线灯光。

gloss.en: Within a month of daily use, the gloss on the new table had worn off.
gloss.zh: 日常用了一个月，新桌子表面的光泽就没了。

glossary.en: The translator added a glossary for the dialect words in the novel.
glossary.zh: 译者给小说里的方言词加了一份词汇表。

glow.en: When he came down for breakfast, embers still glowed in the stove.
glow.zh: 他下楼吃早饭时，炉里的炭还泛着红光。

goad.en: The deadline goaded the team into finishing the wiring in one night.
goad.zh: 截止日期逼得这帮人一夜之间把线路装完了。

granary.en: Enough wheat sat in the village granary to see everyone through the winter.
granary.zh: 村里的粮仓存的麦子，够所有人过冬。

grants.en: Every spring, the council grants small sums to community gardens.
grants.zh: 每年春天，市议会都给社区花园拨一点小钱。

granular.en: The professor wanted granular data, not a single average for the whole district.
granular.zh: 教授要的是细分到细处的数据，不是全区一个平均数。

graph.en: The graph climbs sharply in March, which is when the ad campaign started.
graph.zh: 曲线在三月陡然上升，那正是广告投放开始的时候。

grate.en: The knife grated against the steel sharpener and set his teeth on edge.
grate.zh: 刀在磨刀棒上刮出刺耳的声音，听得他牙根发酸。

gratuity.en: The bill already includes a gratuity, so you needn't add anything.
gratuity.zh: 账单里已经含了服务费，你不用再另外加钱。

gravel.en: The path to the shed is loose gravel, so watch your step.
gravel.zh: 通往棚屋的小路是松散的碎石，走路当心点。

graze.en: The sheep grazed along the fence line until the grass was down to stubble.
graze.zh: 羊群沿着篱笆一路啃草，吃到只剩草茬。

grid.en: The village was taken off the grid after the storm tore down the lines.
grid.zh: 风暴刮断了电线，村子断了电。

grieve.en: She still grieves for the dog she lost three winters ago.
grieve.zh: 三个冬天前走失的那条狗，她到现在还难过。

grill.en: He grilled the peppers until the skins blistered and blackened.
grill.zh: 他把辣椒烤到外皮起泡发黑。

grind.en: Slowly, so that the flour stays cool, the mill grinds the wheat.
grind.zh: 磨坊磨得很慢，好让面粉不发热。

groan.en: Every time someone ran the hot water, the old pipes groaned.
groan.zh: 每次有人开热水，老水管就咯吱作响。

grope.en: He groped along the wall for the light switch.

growl.en: When the postman reached the gate, the dog growled low in its throat.
growl.zh: 邮递员走到门口时，狗从喉咙里低吼了一声。

grudge.en: She bears him no grudge, even after he took the credit for her idea.
grudge.zh: 尽管他抢了她的点子去邀功，她也没记恨他。

grumble.en: The passengers grumbled about the delay until the conductor explained the signal failure.
grumble.zh: 乘客们一直抱怨晚点，直到乘务员解释了信号故障。

guideline.en: The new guideline says staff must log every complaint within a day.
guideline.zh: 新准则要求员工必须在一天内登记每起投诉。

guild.en: The weavers' guild sets the prices for wool in this valley.
guild.zh: 在这个山谷里，织工行会定羊毛的价钱。

gush.en: Water gushed from the broken main and flooded the pavement.
gush.zh: 水从爆裂的主管道里喷出来，淹了人行道。

gymnasium.en: The school gymnasium doubles as an exam hall every June.
gymnasium.zh: 学校体育馆每年六月都兼作考场。

hamper.en: Heavy fog hampered the rescue effort for most of the morning.
hamper.zh: 大雾让整个上午的救援都进展艰难。

handbook.en: Every new hire gets a handbook that explains the shift system.
handbook.zh: 每位新员工都会拿到一本手册，讲解排班制度。

handout.en: The lecturer put the handout online so nobody had to copy the diagrams.
handout.zh: 讲师把讲义传到网上，省得大家抄图。

haphazard.en: Books were stacked in a haphazard pile beside the bed.
haphazard.zh: 床边堆着一摞乱七八糟的书。

harass.en: Two men were fined for harassing the stallholders every weekend.
harass.zh: 两名男子因每周末骚扰摊主被罚款。

hardy.en: These hardy shrubs survive on the roof with almost no watering.
hardy.zh: 这些耐寒灌木种在屋顶上，几乎不用浇水也能活。

harness.en: The farm now harnesses the stream to run a small mill.
harness.zh: 农场现在利用这条小溪带动一台小磨。

hatch.en: The ducklings hatched overnight in the shed behind the barn.
hatch.zh: 小鸭一夜之间在谷仓后的棚子里孵出来了。

haul.en: They hauled the fallen branch off the road before the school bus came.
haul.zh: 校车来之前，他们把断树枝拖离了路面。

haunt.en: The smell of diesel still haunts him whenever he passes a bus depot.
haunt.zh: 每次经过公交车场，柴油味还是会让他想起往事。

havoc.en: In the basement archive, the burst pipe caused havoc.
havoc.zh: 爆裂的水管把地下档案室弄得一团糟。

hazard.en: Wet leaves on the steps are a hazard for anyone carrying boxes.
hazard.zh: 台阶上的湿叶子，对搬箱子的人来说很危险。

hazardous.en: The label warns that the solvent is hazardous if inhaled.
hazardous.zh: 标签上写着，这种溶剂吸入有害。

headstrong.en: As a headstrong teenager, he refused every piece of advice his uncle gave.
headstrong.zh: 他年轻时性子犟，叔叔给的建议一条都不听。

healthcare.en: Rural clinics still struggle to attract healthcare workers.
healthcare.zh: 乡村诊所依然很难招到医护人员。

heap.en: A heap of unopened mail had piled up behind the shop door.
heap.zh: 店门后堆了一大摞没拆的信。

heartbeat.en: A steady heartbeat showed on the monitor, and the nurse finally relaxed.
heartbeat.zh: 监护仪上是平稳的心跳，护士这才放松下来。

heave.en: They heaved the crate onto the truck bed and wiped their hands.
heave.zh: 他们把箱子使劲抬上车斗，拍了拍手。

hectic.en: The week before the opening was hectic, with deliveries arriving at midnight.
hectic.zh: 开业前那周忙得团团转，货都是半夜到的。

heighten.en: Painting the walls white heightened the contrast with the dark floor.
heighten.zh: 墙刷成白色后，和深色地板的反差更强了。

heir.en: The heir to the estate turned out to be a cousin nobody had met.
heir.zh: 这份产业的继承人，竟是个谁都没见过的表亲。

henceforth.en: Henceforth, all requests must go through the office manager.
henceforth.zh: 从今以后，所有申请都要经办公室经理。

hereditary.en: The condition is hereditary, so both sisters were tested early.
hereditary.zh: 这种病有遗传性，所以姐妹俩很早就做了检查。

hierarchy.en: She ignored the hierarchy and emailed the director directly.
hierarchy.zh: 她没管层级，直接给总监发了邮件。

high-rise.en: The high-rise opposite blocks the morning sun from our kitchen.
high-rise.zh: 对面那栋高楼挡住了我们厨房早上的阳光。

highlight.en: The report highlights two gaps: staffing and cold storage.
highlight.zh: 报告重点指出了两个缺口：人手和冷藏。

hijack.en: Four men hijacked a delivery van outside the depot.
hijack.zh: 四名男子在仓库外劫走了一辆送货车。

hinge.en: The cupboard door hangs on a single rusty hinge and squeals.
hinge.zh: 柜门只剩一个锈铰链挂着，开合直响。

hints.en: He dropped hints about the surprise party and then pretended he hadn't.
hints.zh: 他暗示了惊喜派对的事，转头又装作没说过。

historian.en: A local historian traced the mill's ownership back to 1780.
historian.zh: 一位地方史学者把这磨坊的产权追溯到了 1780 年。

hitchhike.en: They hitchhiked to the coast and got a lift from a fish lorry.
hitchhike.zh: 他们搭便车去海边，搭上了一辆运鱼车。

hoist.en: Two men hoisted the sail while the third held the tiller.
hoist.zh: 两个人升起帆，第三个人把着舵柄。

holocaust.en: The exhibition documents the holocaust that followed the invasion and the years of silence after it.
holocaust.zh: 展览记录了入侵之后的那场浩劫，以及此后多年的沉默。

homogeneous.en: The suburb felt oddly homogeneous, with the same hedge along every drive.
homogeneous.zh: 那郊区整齐得有些古怪，每家门前的车道旁都是一样的树篱。

horticulture.en: She studied horticulture and now runs a nursery behind the church.
horticulture.zh: 她学的是园艺，现在在教堂后面经营一家苗圃。

hose.en: He left the hose running and the flowerbed turned into a pond.
hose.zh: 他忘关水管，花坛里积成了个小水池。

housekeeping.en: Housekeeping changes the towels on Mondays and Thursdays.
housekeeping.zh: 客房服务每周一和周四更换毛巾。

hover.en: A police helicopter hovered over the car park for twenty minutes.
hover.zh: 一架警用直升机在停车场上空盘旋了二十分钟。

howl.en: The wind howled through the gap under the balcony door all night.
howl.zh: 风整夜从阳台门底下的缝里呼啸而过。

hubbub.en: When the manager walked in, the hubbub in the staff room died down.
hubbub.zh: 经理一进门，休息室里的嘈杂声就低了下去。

huddle.en: Around the coach, the players huddled, breathing hard in the cold.
huddle.zh: 球员们围在教练身边挤成一团，在冷风里喘着粗气。

humdrum.en: After years of humdrum office work, she took a job on a ferry.
humdrum.zh: 做了多年枯燥的办公室工作后，她去渡轮上找了份活儿。

humidity.en: In the greenhouse, humidity ruined the labels long before it bothered the plants.
humidity.zh: 温室里的湿气先把标签毁了，植物倒还没受影响。

hurl.en: Someone hurled a snowball at the bus window and the driver stopped.
hurl.zh: 有人朝公交车窗扔了个雪球，司机把车停下了。

hygiene.en: Because the food hygiene was appalling, the inspector shut the stall.
hygiene.zh: 因为食品卫生太差，检查员封了那个摊位。

hysterical.en: She got hysterical when she couldn't find her son in the crowd.
hysterical.zh: 在人群里找不到儿子，她一下子就慌了神。

ignite.en: A spark from the grinder ignited the sawdust on the floor.
ignite.zh: 角磨机溅出的火星点燃了地上的锯末。

illuminate.en: Lanterns illuminated the courtyard for the wedding.
illuminate.zh: 婚礼那天，灯笼把院子照得通亮。

immerse.en: He immersed himself in the archive for three weeks and came out with a timeline.
immerse.zh: 他泡在档案馆里三个星期，最后理出了一条时间线。

immigrant.en: Her grandmother arrived as an immigrant with two suitcases and no English.
immigrant.zh: 她奶奶当年作为移民来到这里，只带着两个箱子，一句英语也不会。

imminent.en: The weather service warned that a storm was imminent.
imminent.zh: 气象部门警告说风暴即将来临。

impair.en: Years of machinery noise had impaired his hearing, mostly on the left.
impair.zh: 常年在机器噪音里，他的听力受了损，左侧尤其明显。

impart.en: Good teachers impart more than facts; they teach you how to check them.
impart.zh: 好老师教的不只是事实，还教你怎么去核实。

impede.en: Fallen trees impeded the ambulance for nearly an hour.
impede.zh: 倒下的树让救护车堵了将近一小时。

impetus.en: Getting the grant gave the project the impetus to hire two technicians.
impetus.zh: 拿到这笔经费，项目才有动力招了两名技术员。

implicit.en: There was an implicit agreement that nobody would mention the argument.
implicit.zh: 大家心照不宣，谁都不提那场争吵。

impose.en: After the dry summer, the council imposed a ban on fireworks.
impose.zh: 干旱的夏天过后，市议会下令禁止燃放烟花。

impromptu.en: He gave an impromptu speech at the farewell when the microphone failed.
impromptu.zh: 欢送会上话筒坏了，他就即兴讲了几句。

improvise.en: When the power cut out, the band improvised by candlelight.
improvise.zh: 停电以后，乐队借着烛光即兴演奏。

inaccurate.en: On the last two miles of the coastal road, the map is simply inaccurate.
inaccurate.zh: 滨海路最后两英里，这张地图标得根本不靠谱。

inadequate.en: Once the temperature dropped below zero, the heating proved inadequate.
inadequate.zh: 气温一降到零下，那套供暖就明显不够用了。

inapt.en: Calling the flooding a "minor inconvenience" was an inapt choice of words.
inapt.zh: 把这场水灾说成“一点小不便”，用词实在不妥。

inaugurate.en: The mayor inaugurated the footbridge on a grey Saturday morning.
inaugurate.zh: 一个阴沉沉的周六早上，市长为这座人行桥剪了彩。

incentive.en: Return your old bottles and the shop offers a small incentive.
incentive.zh: 把旧瓶子退回来，店里会给点小奖励。

incidence.en: The clinic reported a falling incidence of flu this winter.
incidence.zh: 诊所报告说，今年冬天流感发病率在下降。

incipient.en: He caught the incipient rust on the frame before it spread.
incipient.zh: 趁锈迹还没扩开，他先把车架上刚起的锈处理了。

inclination.en: She had no inclination to argue once the rain started.
inclination.zh: 雨一下起来，她就懒得再争了。

incline.en: I incline towards the later train, since the first one is always packed.
incline.zh: 我更想坐后一班车，头一班总是挤得不行。

inclusive.en: At that price, breakfast and the airport shuttle are inclusive.
inclusive.zh: 按这个价钱，早餐和机场接送都算在里面。

incoming.en: In his first week, the incoming manager did nothing but listen.
incoming.zh: 新上任的经理头一周什么也没干，光在听人说话。

incongruous.en: A plastic flamingo looked incongruous on the formal lawn.
incongruous.zh: 那只塑料火烈鸟立在规整的草坪上，显得格格不入。

incorporate.en: The final design incorporates a fold-out table that the carpenter suggested.
incorporate.zh: 最终设计把木匠建议的可折叠小桌做了进去。

increment.en: Staff get a small annual increment for every year they stay.
increment.zh: 员工每多做一年，年薪就涨一点。

incur.en: Moving the workshop upstairs incurred extra costs nobody had budgeted for.
incur.zh: 把工坊搬到楼上，花了一笔谁都没预算到的钱。

indefinite.en: For an indefinite period, all repairs on the bridge have been postponed.
indefinite.zh: 桥上的维修被无限期推迟了。

indelible.en: On the tabletop the ink left an indelible mark.
indelible.zh: 墨水在桌面上留下了一处洗不掉的印子。

indemnity.en: The contract includes an indemnity clause covering damage to the site.
indemnity.zh: 合同里有一条赔偿条款，涵盖对场地的损坏。

indicative.en: A rise in late orders is indicative of a problem further upstream.
indicative.zh: 迟到订单增多，说明上游环节出了问题。

indicator.en: Grey smoke is a reliable indicator that the fire is starved of air.
indicator.zh: 冒灰烟是炉火缺氧的可靠信号。

indignant.en: He was indignant at being asked to prove he lived there.
indignant.zh: 被要求证明自己住在那儿，他觉得很受冒犯。

induce.en: Nothing could induce him to sell the boat his father built.
induce.zh: 无论怎么劝，他都不肯卖那条他父亲造的小船。

indulge.en: On Sundays she indulges in a long bath and the crossword.
indulge.zh: 一到星期天，她就痛痛快快泡个澡、做做填字游戏。

inept.en: His inept handling of the complaint turned a small problem into a feud.
inept.zh: 他处理投诉的方式太笨拙，把小事闹成了积怨。

inert.en: Being inert, the gas can be stored in ordinary steel cylinders.
inert.zh: 这种气体惰性很强，普通钢瓶就能储存。

inertia.en: Bureaucratic inertia kept the old form in use for another decade.
inertia.zh: 官僚惯性强，那张旧表格又用了十年。

infect.en: A cut on his thumb got infected after a day in the mud.
infect.zh: 他在泥里干了一天活，拇指上的伤口感染了。

inference.en: From the wet footprints he drew a cautious inference about who had been in the shed.
inference.zh: 凭那串湿脚印，他谨慎地推断出谁进过棚屋。

infest.en: Rats infested the grain store within a month of the roof leaking.
infest.zh: 屋顶漏水不到一个月，粮库就闹起了老鼠。

inflict.en: Along the coast, the storm inflicted damage that will take a year to repair.
inflict.zh: 沿海一带，这场风暴造成的破坏得修上一年。

influx.en: Once the new trail opened, an influx of cyclists reached the village.
influx.zh: 新步道一开通，大批骑行者涌进了村子。

infringe.en: By fencing the path, the new owner infringes on a right of way villagers have used for a century.
infringe.zh: 新主人把小路围起来，等于侵占了村民用了一百年的通行权。

inhabit.en: Otters inhabit the quieter stretches of the river below the weir.
inhabit.zh: 水獭栖息在堰下游比较安静的那几段河道里。

inhabitant.en: Running the lighthouse and a tiny post office keeps the island's only inhabitant busy.
inhabitant.zh: 管灯塔又管一间小邮局，岛上唯一的居民忙得很。

inhibit.en: Cold weather inhibits the growth of the seedlings on the north side.
inhibit.zh: 天冷抑制了北侧幼苗的生长。

initiate.en: She initiated the repair by writing to every tenant in the block.
initiate.zh: 她给楼里每户租客都写了信，把这次修缮张罗起来。

inject.en: Holding his sleeve up, the nurse injected the vaccine and told him to wait ten minutes.
inject.zh: 护士卷起他的袖子打了疫苗，让他在那儿等十分钟。

innovation.en: A clasp that opens with one hand was the workshop's real innovation.
innovation.zh: 这家工坊真正的创新，是一个单手就能打开的搭扣。

insert.en: Insert the card chip-first and wait for the green light.
insert.zh: 把卡片芯片朝里插进去，等绿灯亮。

insight.en: Talking to the night porter gave me an insight into how the place really runs.
insight.zh: 跟夜班门房聊了聊，我才看出这地方实际是怎么运转的。

insipid.en: Until someone added a spoonful of vinegar, the soup tasted insipid.
insipid.zh: 在有人加了一勺醋之前，那汤喝着没什么味道。

insolent.en: One insolent reply cost him a week of extra shifts.
insolent.zh: 就一句顶撞的话，他被罚多上一周班。

insolvent.en: Halfway through the extension, the builder went insolvent.
insolvent.zh: 扩建做到一半，施工方就破产了。

insomnia.en: His insomnia got worse after he started checking work emails in bed.
insomnia.zh: 自从他开始在床上查工作邮件，失眠就更严重了。

inspire.en: A trip to the salt flats inspired her whole series of paintings.
inspire.zh: 一趟盐滩之行，催生了她的整组画作。

instalment.en: They paid for the piano in twelve monthly instalments.
instalment.zh: 这架钢琴他们分十二个月付清了款。

instantaneous.en: Press the switch and the response is almost instantaneous.
instantaneous.zh: 一按开关，反应几乎是瞬时的。

institutes.en: Several research institutes share the same cold store on the campus.
institutes.zh: 园区里好几家研究所共用同一个冷库。

institution.en: In this neighbourhood, the free clinic has become an institution.
institution.zh: 在这一带，那家免费诊所已经成了老招牌。

institutions.en: Public institutions were slow to move their services online.
institutions.zh: 公共机构把服务搬到网上，动作一直很慢。

instructors.en: Two instructors took the beginners' group out on the lake.
instructors.zh: 两位教练带着初学者那组下了湖。

insulate.en: They insulated the loft before the first cold snap.
insulate.zh: 第一次寒潮来之前，他们把阁楼做了保温。

insure.en: Against water damage the cargo was insured, but not against delay.
insure.zh: 这批货保了水损险，但没保延误。

integral.en: Not a bolt-on extra, the handle is integral to the design.
integral.zh: 这个把手不是后加的配件，而是设计里不可缺的一部分。

intellect.en: She dismisses the rumour that athletes lack intellect.
intellect.zh: 她根本不认同运动员缺少头脑这种说法。

intelligible.en: His notes were barely intelligible after the rain smudged the ink.
intelligible.zh: 雨把墨迹洇开以后，他的笔记几乎认不出来了。

intensive.en: He needed two weeks of intensive physiotherapy after the fall.
intensive.zh: 摔了这一跤，他做了两周密集的理疗。

interim.en: An interim manager will run the branch until the new one arrives.
interim.zh: 在新经理到任前，由一位临时负责人管这个分店。

intermittent.en: Intermittent rain kept us moving the chairs in and out all afternoon.
intermittent.zh: 雨时停时下，我们整个下午把椅子搬进搬出。

interrogate.en: For an hour the customs officer interrogated him about the box of seeds.
interrogate.zh: 海关人员为那箱种子盘问了他一个小时。

intervene.en: A neighbour intervened before the argument turned into a fight.
intervene.zh: 争吵快变成动手时，一位邻居插手拦住了。

intervention.en: Without the lifeguard's quick intervention, the boy would have drowned.
intervention.zh: 要不是救生员及时出手，那男孩就淹死了。

interviewee.en: For a long moment the interviewee paused before answering the last question.
interviewee.zh: 被面试的人停了好一会儿，才回答最后一个问题。

interviews.en: She scheduled three interviews for the same afternoon and lost her voice by six.
interviews.zh: 她把三场面试排在一个下午，到六点嗓子都说不出话了。

intimate.en: They had an intimate dinner for six in the back room.
intimate.zh: 他们在里间吃了顿六个人的私密晚饭。

intrinsic.en: No stain can copy the intrinsic warmth of the wood.
intrinsic.zh: 什么着色剂都做不出这种木头本身的温润感。

inundate.en: After the number leaked online, the office was inundated with calls.
inundate.zh: 号码在网上泄露后，办公室的电话就接不过来了。

invariably.en: He invariably arrives ten minutes early and waits in the car.
invariably.zh: 他总提前十分钟到，然后在车里等着。

inventory.en: We counted the inventory twice before ordering anything new.
inventory.zh: 下新订单之前，我们把库存数了两遍。

invert.en: Invert the mould onto a rack and tap the base gently.
invert.zh: 把模具倒扣在架子上，轻轻磕一下底部。

investigators.en: Investigators found the fault in a junction box behind the counter.
investigators.zh: 调查人员在柜台后面的接线盒里找到了故障点。

invincible.en: The team looked invincible until they lost their goalkeeper to injury.
invincible.zh: 那支队伍看着无懈可击，直到守门员受伤下场。

invoice.en: Because the invoice never arrived, the account sat unpaid for two months.
invoice.zh: 发票一直没寄到，这笔账就拖了两个月没付。

irony.en: The irony is that the fire station burned down while its alarm was being repaired.
irony.zh: 讽刺的是，消防站着火时，警报器正送去检修。

irrigation.en: Dug in the last century, the canal still supplies irrigation to these fields.
irrigation.zh: 这条上世纪挖的水渠至今仍在灌溉这些田。

irritate.en: All evening the smoke from the grill irritated his eyes.
irritate.zh: 烤架的烟整晚熏得他眼睛难受。

isolate.en: Tests isolated the fault to a single valve in the basement.
isolate.zh: 检测把故障锁定在地下室的一个阀门上。

isolation.en: What kept the valley's dialect alive was its isolation.
isolation.zh: 让这山谷的方言活下来的，正是它与外界的隔绝。

ivory.en: From ivory to butter, the keys of the old piano had yellowed.
ivory.zh: 老钢琴的琴键从象牙白一点点变成了黄油色。

jagged.en: A jagged edge on the broken glass tore through the cloth.
jagged.zh: 碎玻璃的锯齿利边把布划破了。

jeer.en: When the substitute missed an open goal, the crowd jeered.
jeer.zh: 替补球员面对空门打飞，看台上一片嘲笑声。

jolt.en: Hitting a pothole, the bus jolted everyone out of their seats.
jolt.zh: 公交车轧过一个坑，把所有人都颠离了座位。

judicial.en: Held up by judicial review since March, the case has left the ministry with nothing to say.
judicial.zh: 案子从三月起卡在司法审查里，部里因此不便表态。

jumble.en: Ribbons, receipts and old photos lay in a jumble on the desk.
jumble.zh: 缎带、收据和旧照片乱糟糟地摊在桌上。

justification.en: There is no justification for turning the heating off in November.
justification.zh: 十一月就停暖气，没有任何站得住的理由。

kangaroo.en: A kangaroo hopped across the track and stopped the race for ten minutes.
kangaroo.zh: 一只袋鼠跳过跑道，比赛因此中断了十分钟。

keywords.en: Tag each photo with the keywords a search would actually use.
keywords.zh: 给每张照片打上搜索时真会用的关键词。

kidnap.en: Two men tried to kidnap the banker outside his own gate.
kidnap.zh: 两个男人试图在银行家自家门口绑架他。

kidney.en: He donated a kidney to his brother and was back at work in six weeks.
kidney.zh: 他把一个肾捐给了弟弟，六周后就回去上班了。

kin.en: She has no close kin in the country, so the neighbours handle her affairs.
kin.zh: 她在这个国家没有近亲，事情都由邻居帮着料理。

kindle.en: A single match kindled the dry grass along the fence.
kindle.zh: 一根火柴就点着了篱笆边的干草。

kits.en: First-aid kits were handed out to every van driver.
kits.zh: 急救包发到了每位货车司机手里。

laborious.en: Copying the ledgers by hand was laborious, but it caught three errors.
laborious.zh: 手工抄账簿很费劲，不过也因此查出三处错。

laden.en: Laden with fruit that nobody came to pick, the branches bent almost to the ground.
laden.zh: 树枝挂满没人来摘的果子，压得快垂到地上。

lament.en: Old fishermen lament the days when the harbour held twice as many boats.
lament.zh: 老渔民常感叹，从前港里的船有现在的两倍。

landlady.en: Every Friday the landlady knocked for the rent, always with a plate of biscuits.
landlady.zh: 房东太太每周五来收房租，每次还带一盘点心。

languid.en: So languid was the afternoon that even the dogs gave up chasing flies.
languid.zh: 下午懒洋洋的，连狗都不追苍蝇了。

lap.en: For the whole train journey the cat slept in her lap.
lap.zh: 整趟火车，猫都睡在她腿上。

lapse.en: A lapse in the rota meant nobody locked the back door on Sunday.
lapse.zh: 排班出了个疏漏，周日没人锁后门。

lash.en: Rain lashed the windows while the ferry waited for the tide.
lash.zh: 渡轮等潮的时候，雨狠狠地抽打着舷窗。

latent.en: For years the crack lay latent until the frost opened it up.
latent.zh: 那道裂缝潜伏了好几年，直到结霜才裂开。

lateral.en: He took a lateral move into logistics because it suited his family better.
lateral.zh: 他平级调去了物流，因为那样对家里更方便。

latitude.en: Given the weather, the crew were allowed latitude to reroute.
latitude.zh: 考虑到天气，船员获准自行改道。

laudable.en: Their attempt to restore the fountain was laudable, if a little over-ambitious.
laudable.zh: 他们想修复喷泉的心意值得称赞，只是目标定得有点大。

lava.en: Lava from the eruption reached the road and cooled into black rock.
lava.zh: 喷发出来的岩浆漫到公路，冷却后成了黑石头。

lavish.en: They threw a lavish party that ran until the bread ran out at dawn.
lavish.zh: 他们办了场铺张的派对，一直闹到天亮面包吃完。

lax.en: Security was lax enough that a visitor wandered into the lab unnoticed.
lax.zh: 安保松得离谱，一名访客走进了实验室都没人发现。

layman.en: Written for the layman, the guide contains no equations at all.
layman.zh: 这本指南是写给外行看的，通篇没有一个公式。

layoff.en: Hit hardest by the layoff was the night shift.
layoff.zh: 这轮裁员里受影响最大的是夜班组。

leaflet.en: Volunteers pushed a leaflet through every door on the street.
leaflet.zh: 志愿者把传单塞进了这条街每家的门缝。

leap.en: Sales leapt by a third after the shop started opening on Sundays.
leap.zh: 这家店开始周日营业后，销售额涨了三分之一。

legislate.en: Parliament legislated against single-use plastics in 2019.
legislate.zh: 议会在 2019 年立法限制一次性塑料制品。

legitimate.en: She had a legitimate reason to be annoyed: nobody had told her about the change.
legitimate.zh: 她生气完全有道理，没人通知她这项变更。

lender.en: Before releasing the funds, the lender demanded a second guarantor.
lender.zh: 放款之前，放贷方要求再加一位担保人。

lenient.en: Because the damage had already been paid for, the judge was lenient.
lenient.zh: 因为损失已经赔偿了，法官从轻发落。

leprosy.en: Built to treat leprosy, the mission hospital still runs a clinic.
leprosy.zh: 这家教会医院当初为治麻风病而建，如今仍开着门诊。

lethal.en: A lethal dose of the gas can build up in a sealed room within minutes.
lethal.zh: 在密闭房间里，这种气体几分钟内就能积到致命浓度。

lever.en: He pulled the lever and the whole platform sank a metre.
lever.zh: 他一拉操纵杆，整个平台下沉了一米。

liability.en: Ignored for years by the landlord, the broken step is a liability.
liability.zh: 那级坏台阶房东多年不管，成了个隐患。

liaison.en: She acts as liaison between the lab and the hospital's ethics board.
liaison.zh: 她在实验室和医院伦理委员会之间做联络。

liberal.en: He is liberal with advice but stingy with actual help.
liberal.zh: 他给建议很大方，真帮忙却抠得很。

lick.en: In one go the dog licked the plate clean and looked up for more.
lick.zh: 狗一口气把盘子舔得干干净净，抬头还想要。

limb.en: He fell off the ladder and couldn't feel one limb for a minute.
limb.zh: 他从梯子上摔下来，有一分钟一条腿完全没知觉。

limp.en: After the walk the dog came back limping on its front paw.
limp.zh: 散步回来，狗前爪一瘸一拐的。

liner.en: When the bin liner split, coffee grounds went everywhere.
liner.zh: 垃圾袋一破，咖啡渣撒了一地。

literacy.en: On Tuesday nights the adult literacy class meets in the library.
literacy.zh: 每周二晚上，成人识字班在图书馆上课。

livestock.en: With the fodder killed by frost, the livestock had to be moved down the valley.
livestock.zh: 霜冻毁了饲草，牲畜只能往山谷下面赶。

loath.en: He was loath to admit that the old pump worked better than the new one.
loath.zh: 他不愿承认那台旧泵比新的还好使。

locality.en: Serving a locality of about four thousand people, the clinic is always short-staffed.
locality.zh: 这家诊所服务周边大约四千人，人手永远不够。

locations.en: The film crew scouted three locations along the coast before settling on the lighthouse at the head of the bay.
locations.zh: 剧组沿整条海岸踩了三个取景地，最后定下湾口那座灯塔。

locomotive.en: The old steam locomotive still hauls tourist carriages up the valley every summer.
locomotive.zh: 那台老蒸汽机车每年夏天还拖着观光车厢进山谷。

lodge.en: We lodged a complaint with the airline after our bags spent two days sitting in Madrid.
lodge.zh: 行李在马德里搁了两天，我们向航空公司提了投诉。

loll.en: He lolled against the harbour wall, watching gulls fight over a dropped sandwich.
loll.zh: 他懒懒地靠在码头墙上，看海鸥为一块掉在地上的三明治打架。

loom.en: A container ship loomed out of the fog with its horn blaring.
loom.zh: 一艘集装箱船鸣着汽笛，从雾里冒了出来。

loop.en: The path climbs past the waterfall and then loops back to the car park.
loop.zh: 小路绕过瀑布往上，最后又绕回停车场。

loth.en: She was loth to sell the piano, even though nobody had played it in years.
loth.zh: 她舍不得卖掉那架钢琴，尽管已经好些年没人弹过了。

lubricate.en: A drop of oil will lubricate the hinge and stop the door squeaking.
lubricate.zh: 滴一滴油润滑一下合页，门就不会吱呀响了。

lucid.en: Her explanation of the new tax rules was so lucid that even I followed it.
lucid.zh: 她把新税规讲得很清楚，连我都听明白了。

lucrative.en: Translating contracts turned out to be far more lucrative than waiting tables.
lucrative.zh: 翻译合同比端盘子挣得多得多。

ludicrous.en: It is ludicrous to expect a five-year-old to sit still for two hours.
ludicrous.zh: 指望五岁的孩子安安静静坐两个钟头，实在荒唐。

lull.en: The wind lulled around midnight and the whole street went quiet.
lull.zh: 午夜前后风停了，整条街安静下来。

luminous.en: The dial is painted with luminous material so you can read it in the dark.
luminous.zh: 表盘涂了夜光材料，关了灯也看得清。

lurk.en: A fox lurked at the edge of the chicken run, waiting for the gate to swing open.
lurk.zh: 一只狐狸蹲在鸡舍边上，等着门被风吹开。

mackintosh.en: He folded his wet mackintosh over the back of the chair and dripped all over the floor.
mackintosh.zh: 他把湿雨衣搭在椅背上，水顺着流了一地。

madden.en: The ticking of the clock maddened him until he finally took out the battery.
madden.zh: 钟的滴答声把他逼得发疯，最后他把电池抠了出来。

magistrate.en: The magistrate fined him two hundred pounds and told him to stay off the road for a year.
magistrate.zh: 治安法官罚了他两百镑，还判他一年内不许开车。

magnanimous.en: After winning the case she was magnanimous enough to send her rival a note of thanks.
magnanimous.zh: 打赢官司后她颇为大度，还给对手写了张便条道谢。

magnate.en: A shipping magnate quietly bought the whole row of warehouses along the dock.
magnate.zh: 一位航运大亨悄悄买下了码头边整排仓库。

mails.en: She mails a postcard to her grandmother every time she moves to a new city.
mails.zh: 她每搬到一个新城市，就给奶奶寄一张明信片。

maim.en: The blast maimed two workers and shut the plant for the rest of the year.
maim.zh: 爆炸让两名工人落下了残疾，工厂当年余下的时间都在停产。

maintenance.en: The bridge stays closed for maintenance until the end of the month.
maintenance.zh: 这座桥因维修关闭到月底。

maize.en: Behind the house they grow maize tall enough to hide a grown man.
maize.zh: 屋后种的玉米高得能藏住一个大人。

majestic.en: The cathedral's west front looks majestic from the square but cluttered up close.
majestic.zh: 大教堂的西立面在广场上看很雄伟，走近了却显得杂乱。

malignant.en: The biopsy found a small malignant tumour, caught early enough to be treated.
malignant.zh: 活检发现一个小恶性肿瘤，发现得早，还能治。

malleable.en: Gold is malleable enough to be beaten into sheets thinner than paper.
malleable.zh: 金子延展性好，能锤成比纸还薄的片。

maltreat.en: The inspector found that the horses had been maltreated for months without water.
maltreat.zh: 检查员发现这些马几个月来一直被虐待，连水都喝不上。

manacle.en: The guard manacled the prisoner's wrists to an iron ring set in the wall.
manacle.zh: 狱警把犯人的手腕铐在墙上嵌着的铁环上。

mandate.en: The new law mandates a smoke alarm in every rented flat.
mandate.zh: 新法律强制每套出租房都必须装烟感器。

mania.en: The tulip mania of the 1630s ruined more than a few Amsterdam merchants.
mania.zh: 十七世纪三十年代的郁金香狂热坑了不少阿姆斯特丹商人。

maniac.en: Some maniac overtook us on the bridge with no lights on at all.
maniac.zh: 有个疯子在大桥上一盏灯都不开就超了我们。

manifold.en: The reasons for the delay were manifold, but the deciding one was money.
