manifold.zh: 拖延的原因有很多，起决定作用的是钱。

mannerism.en: He has a mannerism of tapping his pen twice before he answers a question.
mannerism.zh: 他有个习惯，回答问题前总要把笔敲两下。

mantle.en: She took on the mantle of editor when he retired in the spring.
mantle.zh: 他春天退休后，她接下了主编这副担子。

manure.en: The field smelled of manure for a week after the tractor went through.
manure.zh: 拖拉机碾过之后，那片田的粪味散了整整一星期。

mar.en: A deep scratch marred the paintwork on the driver's side of the car.
mar.zh: 车驾驶座一侧的漆面被划了一道深痕。

margin.en: The bookshop survived last year on a margin of about three per cent.
margin.zh: 去年书店就靠三个点左右的利润率撑着。

maritime.en: The town's maritime museum is squeezed into an old sail loft near the quay.
maritime.zh: 镇上的海事博物馆挤在码头边一间旧帆布作坊里。

marrow.en: My grandmother simmered the bones for hours just to get at the marrow.
marrow.zh: 奶奶把骨头炖了好几个钟头，就为取里面的骨髓。

martyr.en: The old union man became a martyr to the cause, whether he wanted the role or not.
martyr.zh: 那位老工会干部成了这项事业的殉道者，由不由他自己都无所谓了。

marvel.en: We marvelled at how quickly the tide covered the causeway.
marvel.zh: 我们惊叹潮水漫过那条堤道之快。

massacre.en: The village still marks the anniversary of the 1915 massacre every spring.
massacre.zh: 村里每年春天仍纪念一九一五年那场屠杀。

matching.en: They turned up in matching red scarves, which neither of them had planned.
matching.zh: 两人戴着同款红围巾出现，谁都没事先安排。

matrimony.en: After thirty years of matrimony they still argue about who makes the better coffee.
matrimony.zh: 结婚三十年了，他俩还在争谁煮的咖啡更好喝。

meagre.en: He left home with a meagre bundle of clothes and forty pounds in his pocket.
meagre.zh: 他离家时只带了一小包衣服，兜里四十镑。

measurement.en: The tailor took a careful measurement of each sleeve before cutting the cloth.
measurement.zh: 裁缝下剪之前，仔细量了每只袖子的尺寸。

measurements.en: Your measurements do not match the drawing by more than two millimetres.
measurements.zh: 你的测量数据和图纸相差不超过两毫米。

mechanism.en: There is a locking mechanism inside the handle that jams whenever the weather turns cold.
mechanism.zh: 手柄里有套锁扣机构，天一冷就卡住。

mediate.en: A retired judge agreed to mediate between the two families over the boundary wall.
mediate.zh: 一位退休法官同意就界墙一事在两家之间调停。

medieval.en: Medieval walls still ring the old town, though the gates came down centuries ago.
medieval.zh: 中世纪城墙还围着老城，城门几百年前就拆了。

mediocre.en: The food was mediocre and we waited forty minutes for the bill.
mediocre.zh: 菜很一般，账单还等了四十分钟。

meek.en: He gave a meek nod and said nothing for the rest of the meeting.
meek.zh: 他温顺地点了下头，会议剩下的时间一句话没说。

melancholy.en: There is a melancholy beauty to the harbour in November, all grey water and empty moorings.
melancholy.zh: 十一月的港口有种忧郁的美，灰扑扑的水面，空荡荡的泊位。

memento.en: She still keeps the ticket stub as a memento of the night they first met.
memento.zh: 她还留着那张票根，当作初次相识那晚的纪念。

menace.en: Loose dogs have become a menace to the sheep grazing on the hill.
menace.zh: 没拴绳的狗已经成了山上吃草羊群的威胁。

mercantile.en: The city's mercantile class paid for the library, the fountain and most of the school.
mercantile.zh: 城里的商人阶层出资建了图书馆、喷泉，还有大半所学校。

mercenary.en: He married her for mercenary reasons and everyone at the wedding could see it.
mercenary.zh: 他娶她图的是钱，婚礼上人人都看得出来。

mesh.en: The mesh on the window is fine enough to keep out midges.
mesh.zh: 纱窗的网眼够细，小飞虫钻不进来。

metabolism.en: Her metabolism slowed after the operation and she put on weight in a matter of weeks.
metabolism.zh: 手术后她新陈代谢变慢，几周内体重就上去了。

metallic.en: The paint has a metallic finish that shows up every fingerprint.
metallic.zh: 这漆是金属质感，留一个指纹都看得见。

metaphor.en: Calling the internet a highway worked as a metaphor for about ten years.
metaphor.zh: 把互联网叫作高速公路，这个比喻撑了大概十年。

meteoric.en: His meteoric rise from intern to director took only four years.
meteoric.zh: 他从实习生升到总监只用了四年，快得惊人。

meteorology.en: She took up meteorology because she wanted to know why the coast fog forms where it does.
meteorology.zh: 她学气象学，是想弄明白海岸的雾为什么总在那几个地方生成。

meticulous.en: He keeps meticulous records of every repair, down to the size of the screws.
meticulous.zh: 他每一次维修都记得极细，连螺丝型号都不落。

metropolitan.en: Housing in the metropolitan area now costs twice what it does in the surrounding counties.
metropolitan.zh: 大都市区的房价已经是周边各县的两倍。

microbe.en: A single microbe can double in number every twenty minutes in a warm jug of milk.
microbe.zh: 在温热的牛奶里，一个微生物每二十分钟就能翻一倍。

microbiology.en: The microbiology lab smells faintly of agar and bleach all year round.
microbiology.zh: 微生物实验室一年到头都有股淡淡的琼脂和漂白水味。

microcosm.en: The Saturday market is a microcosm of the city's whole politics.
microcosm.zh: 周六的集市就是这座城市政治的一个缩影。

microfilm.en: The parish records are on microfilm now; the originals are too brittle to handle.
microfilm.zh: 教区档案现在都缩微成胶卷了，原件太脆没法翻。

mid.en: The scaffolding came down in mid September, a week before the festival opened.
mid.zh: 脚手架在九月中旬拆掉了，赶在节庆开幕前一周。

midmorning.en: By midmorning the queue outside the bakery stretched past the bank.
midmorning.zh: 到上午十点来钟，面包店外的队已经排过了银行。

migratory.en: The lake is a resting point for migratory birds heading south along the coast.
migratory.zh: 这个湖是候鸟沿海岸南迁途中的歇脚点。

mildew.en: The tent smelled of mildew after a week folded up in the rain.
mildew.zh: 帐篷淋着雨叠了一周，打开一股霉味。

mileage.en: The car's low mileage was the only reason we went back for a second look.
mileage.zh: 我们肯再去看那辆车一眼，唯一的原因就是里程数低。

militant.en: A militant wing of the union rejected the offer without even putting it to a vote.
militant.zh: 工会里激进的一派直接否决了方案，连表决都没走。

mills.en: The old mills along the river now hold studios, a bakery and one very good café.
mills.zh: 河边那些旧磨坊现在开了工作室、一家面包房和一家很不错的咖啡馆。

mingle.en: Guests mingled on the terrace with glasses of something cold in their hands.
mingle.zh: 客人们在露台上端着冷饮彼此寒暄。

minimal.en: We made minimal changes to the kitchen: a coat of paint and a new tap.
minimal.zh: 厨房我们只动了很少，刷了层漆，换了个水龙头。

mining.en: Coal mining kept half the valley in work until the pits closed in the eighties.
mining.zh: 八十年代矿井关停之前，山谷里一半人靠采煤吃饭。

mint.en: He collects coins and keeps the mint-condition ones in individual plastic sleeves.
mint.zh: 他收藏硬币，品相完好的都一只只套进塑料封套。

mirage.en: The road ahead shimmered like a mirage of water, though it had not rained for weeks.
mirage.zh: 前方的路面晃动着，像一片水的幻影，可已经好几周没下雨了。

mire.en: The tractor sank in the mire up to its axles and had to be pulled out by two others.
mire.zh: 拖拉机陷进泥沼，泥没到车轴，最后靠另外两台才拉出来。

mischance.en: By some mischance the letter went to the wrong address and reached her a month late.
mischance.zh: 不知哪个环节出了错，信寄到了错的地址，一个月后才到她手上。

mischief.en: The twins went quiet for ten minutes, which in this house usually means mischief.
mischief.zh: 双胞胎安静了十分钟，在这个家里这通常意味着在捣鬼。

misconceive.en: Critics misconceived the plan as a tax rise, which it never was.
misconceive.zh: 批评者把方案误解成加税，其实根本不是这么回事。

misdeed.en: The report lists a string of minor misdeeds going back more than a decade.
misdeed.zh: 报告列了一串小过失，最早能追溯到十多年前。

misgiving.en: I had misgivings about the deal, but I signed anyway and regretted it by Friday.
misgiving.zh: 我对这笔交易心里有疑虑，还是签了，到周五就后悔了。

mishap.en: Apart from a minor mishap with the boat trailer, the whole trip went smoothly.
mishap.zh: 除了拖船架出了点小状况，整趟行程都还顺利。

misrepresent.en: The advert misrepresents the size of the flat by shooting it with a wide lens.
misrepresent.zh: 广告用广角镜头拍摄，把公寓面积拍得比实际大。

missile.en: The missile tests drew condemnation from every neighbouring country.
missile.zh: 导弹试射招来了所有邻国的谴责。

misuse.en: Misuse of the equipment voids the warranty, as the label on the box says.
misuse.zh: 不当使用设备会让保修失效，包装盒上就这么写着。

mitigate.en: Planting willows along the bank helps mitigate flooding further downstream.
mitigate.zh: 沿河岸种柳树有助于减轻下游的洪水。

mobilize.en: The council mobilized volunteers to clear the fallen trees after the storm.
mobilize.zh: 风暴过后，议会动员志愿者清理倒下的树。

module.en: The course runs in six modules, each one lasting a fortnight.
module.zh: 这门课分六个模块，每个模块上两周。

molest.en: He was charged with molesting a child and barred from working with young people.
molest.zh: 他被控猥亵儿童，并被禁止从事与青少年相关的工作。

momentous.en: Signing the lease was a momentous day for a couple who had rented for twenty years.
momentous.zh: 对一对租了二十年房的夫妻来说，签下租约是件大事。

momentum.en: The campaign lost momentum the moment the weather turned.

monarchy.en: The monarchy survives here largely as a tourist attraction.
monarchy.zh: 这里的君主制主要是靠旅游业撑着。

monetary.en: The quarrel is really about monetary policy, not about personalities.
monetary.zh: 这场争吵实质上是货币政策之争，不是人身之争。

monologue.en: He delivered a twenty-minute monologue about his knee operation before anyone could get a word in.
monologue.zh: 他一个人讲了二十分钟膝盖手术，谁也插不上话。

monstrous.en: It is monstrous that a family of four should be living in one room.
monstrous.zh: 一家四口挤在一间屋里住，太不像话了。

morbid.en: He has a morbid fascination with old newspaper obituaries.
morbid.zh: 他对旧报纸上的讣告有一种病态的兴趣。

mortgage.en: They took out a thirty-year mortgage to buy the flat above the shop.
mortgage.zh: 他们办了三十年房贷，买下店面上头那套公寓。

mosaic.en: The floor is a Roman mosaic of fish, grapes and one rather surprised-looking bird.
mosaic.zh: 地面是罗马时期的马赛克，画着鱼、葡萄，还有一只表情相当惊讶的鸟。

motif.en: The leaf motif repeats along the border of the carpet every few inches.
motif.zh: 地毯边饰上每隔几寸就重复一次叶子图案。

motivate.en: What motivated you to give up a steady job and buy a food truck?
motivate.zh: 是什么让你辞掉稳定工作去买一辆流动餐车？

motto.en: Their motto is measure twice, cut once, and they really do mean it.
motto.zh: 他们的信条是“量两遍再下刀”，而且是真照做的。

mould.en: She scraped the mould off the top of the jam and hoped for the best.
mould.zh: 她把果酱表层长的霉刮掉，然后听天由命。

mourn.en: The village mourned the loss of its last shop for the better part of a year.
mourn.zh: 村里为最后一家小店关门惋惜了大半年。

mucous.en: A mucous membrane lines the inside of the nose and traps most of the dust.
mucous.zh: 鼻腔内壁覆着黏膜，把大部分灰尘挡在外面。

muddle.en: I muddled the two bookings and we turned up at the hotel a day early.
muddle.zh: 我把两个预订搞混了，结果提前一天到了酒店。

multilateral.en: Cleaning up the river needs a multilateral agreement between the four countries that share it.
multilateral.zh: 治这条河需要沿河四国达成多边协议。

multiply.en: Bacteria multiply fastest in warm, moist conditions like a forgotten sponge.
multiply.zh: 细菌在温暖潮湿的地方繁殖最快，比如一块被忘掉的洗碗海绵。

municipal.en: The municipal swimming pool closes for two weeks every August for cleaning.
municipal.zh: 市立游泳池每年八月闭馆两周做清洁。

muster.en: He could barely muster the energy to get up and answer the door.
muster.zh: 他几乎提不起劲起身去开门。

mutation.en: A single mutation in the gene makes the plant resistant to frost.
mutation.zh: 这个基因上的一处突变，让这种植物能抗霜。

mutter.en: She muttered something about the traffic and went back inside.
mutter.zh: 她嘟囔了两句交通的事，又回屋去了。

myriad.en: The stall sells a myriad of spices, most of them unlabelled and all of them cheap.
myriad.zh: 那个摊子卖各种各样的香料，大多没标签，样样都便宜。

namely.en: One ingredient is missing from the list, namely the salt.
namely.zh: 清单上少了一样东西，就是盐。

narrative.en: The film's narrative jumps between three decades without so much as a caption.
narrative.zh: 影片的叙事在三个十年之间来回跳，连个字幕提示都没有。

narrator.en: The narrator of the novel is a dog who misunderstands almost everything he sees.
narrator.zh: 这部小说的叙述者是一条狗，它几乎把看到的一切都理解错了。

natal.en: She went back to her natal village for the first time in forty years.
natal.zh: 她四十年来第一次回到自己出生的村子。

nationalities.en: The class includes children of eleven different nationalities and about twenty languages.
nationalities.zh: 这个班的孩子来自十一个国籍，说着大约二十种语言。

nausea.en: The crossing left him with a wave of nausea that lasted most of the afternoon.
nausea.zh: 过海之后他一阵恶心，难受了大半个下午。

nautical.en: Nautical charts mark the sandbank in pale blue, a shade easy to miss in poor light.
nautical.zh: 航海图上用淡蓝色标出那片沙洲，光线不好时很容易看漏。

naval.en: The naval base closed its gates to visitors after the incident in the spring.
naval.zh: 春天那次事件之后，海军基地对访客关上了大门。

navigable.en: The river is navigable only as far as the old mill, and only in a small boat.
navigable.zh: 这条河只有到旧磨坊那一段能通航，而且只限小船。

necessitate.en: Changing the date would necessitate rebooking the hall and refunding forty tickets.
necessitate.zh: 改期就意味着要重新订礼堂，还要退四十张票。

negation.en: The last chapter is a negation of everything the hero spent the book building.
negation.zh: 最后一章否定了主人公整本书里辛苦建立起来的一切。

negligence.en: The court found the landlord guilty of negligence over the faulty wiring.
negligence.zh: 法院认定房东对线路故障负有疏忽责任。

negligible.en: The difference in price is negligible once you add the delivery charge.
negligible.zh: 把运费算进去，这点价差可以忽略不计。

negotiable.en: The salary is negotiable, but the start date in March is not.
negotiable.zh: 薪水可以谈，但三月到岗这条不能谈。

nets.en: The fishermen were mending their nets on the quay long before it got light.
nets.zh: 天还没亮，渔民就在码头上补网了。

neurosis.en: His neurosis about germs is so bad that he will not use a public lift.
neurosis.zh: 他对细菌的神经过敏严重到不敢坐公共电梯。

neurotic.en: Our neurotic cat hides under the bed whenever the doorbell rings.
neurotic.zh: 我们那只神经质的猫一听见门铃就往床底下钻。

neutralize.en: A pinch of baking soda will neutralize the acid in the tomato sauce.
neutralize.zh: 捏一小撮小苏打就能中和番茄酱里的酸。

nibble.en: She nibbled at a biscuit while the kettle came slowly to the boil.
nibble.zh: 水壶慢慢烧着的工夫，她小口小口地啃着一块饼干。

nickel.en: The coin is made of nickel and goes dull grey after a few years in a pocket.
nickel.zh: 这枚硬币是镍做的，在口袋里放几年就变得灰扑扑的。

nil.en: Their chances of a comeback were close to nil after the second injury.
nil.zh: 第二次受伤之后，他们翻盘的机会几乎为零。

nobility.en: The old nobility still owns half the vineyards on the sunny side of the valley.
nobility.zh: 旧贵族至今仍拥有山谷向阳面一半的葡萄园。

nominal.en: He charges a nominal fee, just enough to cover the cost of the clay.
nominal.zh: 他只收一点象征性的费用，够买陶土就行。

nominate.en: She was nominated for the prize by a colleague she had never actually met.
nominate.zh: 提名她参评的是一位她其实从未见过面的同事。

nominee.en: The party's nominee spent the summer visiting every village in the district.
nominee.zh: 该党提名的候选人整个夏天跑遍了选区里每一个村子。

non-drinker.en: As the only non-drinker in the group, he is usually the one driving everyone home.
non-drinker.zh: 作为这群人里唯一不喝酒的，他通常是负责开车把大家送回去的那个。

nostalgia.en: There is a lot of nostalgia in town for the years before the motorway arrived.
nostalgia.zh: 镇上的人很怀念高速公路修来之前的那些年。

notary.en: The contract has to be signed in front of a notary, so bring your passport.
notary.zh: 这份合同得当着公证人的面签，记得带护照。

notation.en: The score uses a notation I have never seen, with numbers instead of notes.
notation.zh: 这份乐谱用的记谱法我没见过，记的是数字而不是音符。

notch.en: He cut a notch in the gatepost for every sheep that passed through.
notch.zh: 每过一只羊，他就在门柱上刻一道缺口。

notion.en: I have no notion of what a plumber charges these days.
notion.zh: 现在请个水管工多少钱，我完全没概念。

nought.en: The score was two nought at half time, and the visitors never recovered.
nought.zh: 半场比分二比零，客队再没翻过身来。

nourishment.en: The soil gives the vines very little nourishment, which is why the wine tastes so sharp.
nourishment.zh: 土里养分很少，酒才这么酸冽。

novice.en: As a novice he spent the whole first month carrying other people's tools.
novice.zh: 他还是新手，头一个月净给别人递工具。

noxious.en: The plant released a noxious cloud that turned the washing on the line grey.
noxious.zh: 厂里排出有毒的气体，把晾着的衣服都熏成了灰色。

nuance.en: Something of the nuance in her joke gets lost in translation.
nuance.zh: 她那个笑话里的微妙之处，翻过去就丢了一些。

nuisance.en: The pigeons are a nuisance, but the council says there is no budget to deal with them.
nuisance.zh: 鸽子很烦人，可市政说没有预算处理。

numerical.en: Please put the case files in numerical order by reference number.
numerical.zh: 请按案卷参考编号的数字顺序把文件排好。

nursing.en: She went into nursing after her mother spent a year on a ward.
nursing.zh: 母亲在病房住了一年之后，她去做了护理。

nurture.en: Good teachers nurture curiosity instead of testing it out of children.
nurture.zh: 好老师培养好奇心，而不是用考试把它磨掉。

oar.en: One oar slipped out of the rowlock and we spun in slow circles for ten minutes.
oar.zh: 一支桨从桨架上滑脱，我们的船原地慢慢转了十分钟。

oblige.en: The rules oblige landlords to fit a smoke alarm on every floor of the building.
oblige.zh: 规定要求房东在楼里每一层都装烟感器。

obliging.en: An obliging neighbour watered our plants for a fortnight while we were away.
obliging.zh: 一位热心的邻居在我们外出那两周帮我们浇花。

oblique.en: He made an oblique reference to the missing money, then changed the subject.
oblique.zh: 他绕着弯提了一句不见的钱，随即换了话题。

oblivious.en: She walked on, oblivious to the fact that her scarf was trailing in a puddle.
oblivious.zh: 她继续往前走，完全没注意围巾拖在水洼里。

oblong.en: The garden is a narrow oblong, walled on three sides and open to the lane.
oblong.zh: 花园是个狭长的长方形，三面有墙，一面通小路。

obnoxious.en: The obnoxious man at the bar kept shouting at the television all evening.
obnoxious.zh: 酒吧里那个讨厌的家伙整晚冲着电视大喊大叫。

observance.en: Observance of the parking rules is patchy at weekends, when the wardens go home.
observance.zh: 周末管理员回家后，停车规定就没什么人遵守了。

obsess.en: He is obsessed with getting the bathroom tiles perfectly level.
obsess.zh: 他一门心思想把浴室的瓷砖铺得绝对水平。

obsession.en: Her obsession with tidiness makes the flat feel more like a showroom than a home.
obsession.zh: 她太在意整洁，家里更像展厅，不像住处。

obsolete.en: The software became obsolete two upgrades ago and no longer opens the old files.
obsolete.zh: 这软件两个版本前就过时了，现在打不开旧文件。

obstruct.en: A fallen branch obstructed the lane for most of the morning.
obstruct.zh: 一根断落的树枝把小路堵了大半个上午。

occupants.en: The occupants of the flat above have been hammering since seven o'clock.
occupants.zh: 楼上那家的住户从七点就开始敲敲打打。

odyssey.en: Getting the visa turned into a six-month odyssey of forms, queues and phone calls.
odyssey.zh: 办签证变成了一场六个月的折腾：填表、排队、打电话。

offset.en: The grant offsets part of the cost of replacing the roof.
offset.zh: 这笔补助抵掉了换屋顶的一部分费用。

offshore.en: On clear days you can see the offshore wind farm from the beach.
offshore.zh: 天气好的时候，从沙滩上能看见海上风电场。

ohp.en: The lecture theatre still has an OHP in the cupboard, though nobody can find transparencies for it.
ohp.zh: 阶梯教室柜子里还留着一台投影仪，可谁也找不到配套的胶片了。

ominous.en: There was an ominous silence from the engine room, then a single loud knock.
ominous.zh: 机舱里先是一片不祥的安静，接着传来一声闷响。

onset.en: The onset of winter catches the road crews out every single year.
onset.zh: 每年入冬都让养路队措手不及。

opaque.en: The bathroom window is opaque, so the neighbours cannot see in.
opaque.zh: 浴室窗是磨砂的，邻居看不进来。

open-book.en: His exam was an open-book one, so he carried in three textbooks and a flask.
open-book.zh: 他那门考试是开卷，于是带了三本教材和一个保温杯进去。

oppress.en: The heat oppressed us long after the sun had gone down behind the hills.
oppress.zh: 太阳落到山后很久了，热气还是压得人喘不上气。

opt.en: We opted for the slower train because it runs along the coast.
opt.zh: 我们选了慢车，因为它沿着海岸走。

optic.en: The optic nerve carries signals from the eye to the back of the brain.
optic.zh: 视神经把眼睛的信号传到大脑后部。

optical.en: An optical illusion makes the corridor look twice as long as it really is.
optical.zh: 一种视错觉让走廊看起来有实际的两倍长。

optimum.en: Seedlings grow best at the optimum temperature of about twenty degrees.
optimum.zh: 幼苗在二十度左右的最适温度下长得最好。

orderly.en: The evacuation was orderly, though nobody had rehearsed it beforehand.
orderly.zh: 疏散很有秩序，尽管事先没人演练过。

ore.en: The ore is crushed on site and then trucked down to the coast for shipping.
ore.zh: 矿石在矿区就地粉碎，再用卡车运到海边装船。

organism.en: A single-celled organism can survive years of drought as a spore.
organism.zh: 单细胞生物能以孢子形态熬过多年干旱。

organizer.en: The organizer of the fair apologised to everyone who had paid in advance.
organizer.zh: 集市的主办方给所有预先付款的人道了歉。

originate.en: The recipe originated in a fishing village on the north coast, or so the menu claims.
originate.zh: 这道菜源自北岸一个渔村——至少菜单上是这么写的。

ornament.en: A brass ornament shaped like a fish hangs above the door and turns green each winter.
ornament.zh: 门上方挂着一件鱼形铜饰，每年冬天都泛出绿锈。

orthodox.en: Orthodox medicine had nothing left to offer, so she tried acupuncture.
orthodox.zh: 正规医学已经没别的办法，她便去试了针灸。

oscillate.en: The needle oscillates between twenty and thirty whenever the pump kicks in.
oscillate.zh: 泵一启动，指针就在二十和三十之间来回摆。

ostensible.en: The ostensible reason for his visit was a delivery, but nobody at the door believed it.
ostensible.zh: 他来的表面理由是送货，门口没人信。

ostentation.en: The wedding was criticised for its ostentation in a year when half the town was out of work.
ostentation.zh: 在小镇一半人失业的年份办那么讲排场的婚礼，招了不少批评。

oust.en: The board ousted the chief executive after two quarters of heavy losses.
oust.zh: 连亏两个季度后，董事会把这位首席执行官赶下了台。

outcast.en: After the scandal he lived like an outcast in his own town.
outcast.zh: 丑闻之后，他在自己镇上活得像个被驱逐的人。

outcry.en: The plan to close the library provoked a public outcry and two petitions.
outcry.zh: 关闭图书馆的计划引发了公众抗议，还收了两次请愿。

outdated.en: The map is outdated: the bridge it shows was demolished in 2009.
outdated.zh: 这张地图过时了，上面画的桥二〇〇九年就拆了。

outdo.en: She tried to outdo her sister by baking three cakes for the school fete.
outdo.zh: 为了压过姐姐一头，她给学校义卖会烤了三个蛋糕。

outlaw.en: The city outlawed smoking in parks last spring and put up signs within a week.
outlaw.zh: 去年春天市里禁止在公园吸烟，一周内就竖起了牌子。

outlying.en: The bus only reaches the outlying farms twice a week in winter.
outlying.zh: 冬天公交每周只到偏远农场两趟。

output.en: The factory doubled its output without hiring a single extra pair of hands.
output.zh: 工厂产量翻了一番，一个额外人手都没招。

outrageous.en: It is outrageous that they charge two pounds for a glass of tap water.
outrageous.zh: 一杯自来水收两镑，太离谱了。

outright.en: He denied outright that he had ever seen the document before the hearing.
outright.zh: 他一口否认在听证会之前见过那份文件。

outset.en: From the outset she made it clear she would not move abroad for the job.
outset.zh: 从一开始她就说清楚，不会为这份工作搬到国外。

outspoken.en: The outspoken vicar has annoyed half the parish and delighted the other half.
outspoken.zh: 这位直言不讳的牧师惹恼了半个教区，也逗乐了另一半。

outstrip.en: Demand for the course has outstripped the number of tutors willing to teach it.
outstrip.zh: 这门课的需求已经超过了愿意任教的老师人数。

outweigh.en: The advantages of living next door to the school outweigh the noise at break time.
outweigh.zh: 住在学校隔壁的好处，盖过了课间的吵闹。

ovation.en: The audience gave the pianist a standing ovation that lasted a full three minutes.
ovation.zh: 观众为钢琴家起立鼓掌，足足三分钟。

overdue.en: The book is two weeks overdue and the fine is mounting by the day.
overdue.zh: 书超期两周了，罚款一天天往上涨。

overflow.en: The river overflowed its banks after two days of steady rain.
overflow.zh: 连下了两天雨，河水漫过了堤岸。

overhaul.en: The engine needs a complete overhaul before the spring race at the earliest.
overhaul.zh: 要赶最早的春季比赛，发动机得彻底大修一次。

overhear.en: I overheard the two of them planning a surprise for Friday and had to pretend I had not.
overhear.zh: 我无意中听见他俩在商量周五的惊喜，只好装没听见。

override.en: The manager can override the system's refusal and issue the refund manually.
override.zh: 经理可以推翻系统的拒绝，手工办这笔退款。

overrule.en: The judge overruled the objection and let the witness go on.
overrule.zh: 法官驳回异议，让证人继续往下说。

oversee.en: She oversees the night shift at the packaging plant three nights a week.
oversee.zh: 她每周三个晚上负责监管包装厂的夜班。

overt.en: There was no overt hostility, just a great deal of cold politeness.
overt.zh: 没有明显的敌意，只有一片冷淡的客套。

overture.en: He made a clumsy overture of friendship by offering her half of his sandwich.
overture.zh: 他笨拙地示好，把三明治分了她一半。

overwrought.en: She was overwrought after the hospital visit and fell asleep on the sofa in her coat.
overwrought.zh: 从医院回来她情绪绷得太紧，穿着外套就在沙发上睡着了。

oxide.en: The white oxide on the battery terminals is why the car will not start on cold mornings.
oxide.zh: 电瓶接头上那层白色氧化物，就是冷天早晨打不着火的原因。

pacify.en: He tried to pacify the baby with a plastic spoon and a lot of shushing.
pacify.zh: 他拿个塑料勺子，一边使劲哄，想把孩子安抚下来。

paddle.en: We paddled the canoe across the lake before the wind got up.
paddle.zh: 起风之前，我们把独木舟划过了湖。

palatable.en: The medicine is bitter, so they mix it with honey to make it palatable for children.
palatable.zh: 这药很苦，他们掺上蜂蜜，好让孩子愿意喝。

palpitate.en: My heart palpitated every time the phone rang that week.
palpitate.zh: 那一周只要电话一响，我心跳就乱一拍。

pamper.en: They spent the weekend pampering themselves at a spa up in the hills.
pamper.zh: 他们周末去山里的温泉好好犒劳了自己。

panorama.en: From the ridge there is a panorama of the whole estuary and both lighthouses.
panorama.zh: 站在山脊上能望见整个河口和两座灯塔的全景。

paralyse.en: The strike paralysed the port for eleven days and left ships waiting outside.
paralyse.zh: 罢工让港口瘫痪了十一天，船都堵在外面。

paramount.en: Safety is paramount, so the ride stays shut until every bolt has been checked.
paramount.zh: 安全最重要，螺栓全部检查完之前，这个游乐设施一直关着。

paranoia.en: A little paranoia is no bad thing when you are selling a second-hand car.
paranoia.zh: 卖二手车的时候，有点疑心不是坏事。

paraphernalia.en: The attic is full of camping paraphernalia that nobody has touched in years.
paraphernalia.zh: 阁楼里塞满了露营的家什，好些年没人动过。

paraphrase.en: Let me paraphrase what she said, because I cannot remember the exact words.
paraphrase.zh: 我复述一下她的意思吧，原话我记不住了。

parental.en: Parental consent is needed before a child can join the trip.
parental.zh: 孩子参加这次活动需要家长签字同意。

parody.en: The sketch is a parody of those property shows where every kitchen is stunning.
parody.zh: 这个小品讽刺的是那些房产节目，里面每个厨房都惊艳得不像话。

particle.en: A speck of dust is a particle big enough to catch the light in a sunbeam.
particle.zh: 一粒灰尘就是一颗足够大、能被阳光照亮的微粒。

partisan.en: The report was dismissed as too partisan to be of any use to the committee.
partisan.zh: 那份报告被指党派色彩太重，委员会用不上。

partition.en: A glass partition separates the kitchen from what is laughingly called the office.
partition.zh: 一道玻璃隔断把厨房和所谓的办公室分开。

patent.en: The design is protected by a patent taken out in 2018 and renewed twice since.
patent.zh: 这个设计受二〇一八年申请的一项专利保护，之后续了两次。

paternity.en: He was granted six weeks of paternity leave, which he spent mostly asleep.
paternity.zh: 他获准休六周陪产假，大半时间都在补觉。

pathetic.en: The team's performance was pathetic; they lost to a side two divisions below them.
pathetic.zh: 球队踢得实在糟糕，输给了低两个级别的对手。

pathos.en: There is real pathos in the letters he sent home from the trenches.
pathos.zh: 他从战壕寄回家的信里，有一种真切的悲怆。

patrol.en: Two officers patrol the market on foot every evening after the stalls close.
patrol.zh: 每天傍晚收摊后，两名警员会在市场上步行巡逻。

patron.en: The gallery's patron paid for the new wing out of her own pocket.
patron.zh: 画廊的赞助人自掏腰包建了新侧厅。

pave.en: The council paved the lane last summer and now it floods faster than ever.
pave.zh: 去年夏天议会把小巷铺了路面，现在积水反而更快了。

payable.en: The deposit is payable within seven days of signing the contract.
payable.zh: 定金须在合同签署后七天内支付。

pedal.en: The pedal on the left is the clutch, not the brake, as I found out at the junction.
pedal.zh: 左边那个踏板是离合，不是刹车——我在路口才弄明白。

peer.en: She peered through the letterbox, but the hall beyond was completely dark.
peer.zh: 她凑着信箱缝往里看，里面的门厅一片漆黑。

pendulum.en: The clock's pendulum swings once a second, loud enough to hear from the bedroom.
pendulum.zh: 座钟的摆锤一秒一下，在卧室都听得见。

penetrate.en: Damp had penetrated the wall and blistered the plaster above the skirting.
penetrate.zh: 潮气渗进了墙里，把踢脚线上方的灰泥顶起了泡。

penicillin.en: The wound cleared up within days once they put him on penicillin.
penicillin.zh: 用上青霉素之后，伤口几天就消了。

perceptible.en: There was a perceptible drop in temperature as soon as we stepped into the cave.
perceptible.zh: 一进洞，温度就明显降了下来。

perception.en: Public perception of the police shifted sharply after the inquiry was published.
perception.zh: 调查报告公布后，公众对警察的看法明显变了。

percussion.en: The band has three guitarists, a fiddle and no percussion at all.
percussion.zh: 这支乐队有三个吉他手、一把小提琴，完全没有打击乐。

perennial.en: Drainage is a perennial problem in the low fields beside the river.
perennial.zh: 河边那片低洼地的排水是个老问题。

peril.en: The sign warns of peril from falling rock for a hundred yards after rain.
peril.zh: 牌子上提醒，雨后一百码内当心落石。

perimeter.en: A wire fence runs right around the perimeter of the airfield.
perimeter.zh: 一道铁丝网围着机场整整一圈。

periodical.en: The reading room keeps its periodicals on the top shelf, out of reach of the children.
periodical.zh: 阅览室的期刊放在最上层，孩子们够不着。

periodically.en: The boiler is serviced periodically, roughly once every eighteen months.
periodically.zh: 锅炉定期保养，大约一年半一次。

periphery.en: Shops have drifted from the centre of town out to the periphery, where parking is free.
periphery.zh: 商铺渐渐从市中心搬到了停车免费的城郊。

periscope.en: The submarine raised its periscope just above the swell and turned a slow circle.
periscope.zh: 潜艇把潜望镜升到浪头之上，缓缓转了一圈。

perishable.en: Perishable goods go at the front of the van, right by the doors.
perishable.zh: 易腐的东西放在车厢前部，就靠着车门。

perks.en: Free parking is one of the few perks left in the job.
perks.zh: 免费停车是这份工作剩下不多的福利之一。

permeate.en: The smell of woodsmoke permeated the whole house by the end of the evening.
permeate.zh: 到晚上，柴火烟味已经渗遍了整栋房子。

permissible.en: It is permissible to park there after six, though hardly anybody does.
permissible.zh: 六点以后在那儿停车是允许的，不过几乎没人这么干。

perpendicular.en: The shelf is not quite perpendicular to the wall, which is why the books slide.
perpendicular.zh: 架子跟墙不太垂直，书才老往下滑。

perplex.en: The wiring instructions perplexed everyone, including the electrician who wrote them.
perplex.zh: 接线说明把所有人都搞糊涂了，连写说明的电工自己也是。

perplexity.en: She stared at the bill in perplexity, then rang the restaurant to ask about it.
perplexity.zh: 她困惑地盯着账单，然后给餐厅打了电话问。

persecute.en: His family was persecuted for their religion throughout the 1930s.
persecute.zh: 他一家在整个三十年代因宗教信仰受到迫害。

persevere.en: She persevered with the violin even after her teacher moved to another county.
persevere.zh: 老师搬去别的郡之后，她还是坚持练小提琴。

persist.en: The cough persisted for a month after the fever had gone.
persist.zh: 烧退了以后，咳嗽还持续了一个月。

personnel.en: Only authorized personnel may go beyond this point, as the sign says.
personnel.zh: 牌子上写着，只有获授权人员才能进入此区域。

perspective.en: From the top of the hill the whole harbour suddenly comes into perspective.
perspective.zh: 从山顶望下去，整个港口忽然有了纵深感。

perspire.en: He perspires heavily in nylon shirts, so he sticks to cotton all summer.
perspire.zh: 他穿尼龙衬衫出汗特别厉害，整个夏天只穿棉的。

pertain.en: These rules pertain to rented property only, not to owner-occupied flats.
pertain.zh: 这些规定只涉及出租房产，不适用于自住房。

pertinent.en: She asked the pertinent question that nobody else had dared to raise: who pays?
pertinent.zh: 她问了个切中要害、别人都不敢提的问题：钱谁出？

perturb.en: The news did not perturb her at all; she had been expecting it for weeks.
perturb.zh: 这消息一点没让她不安，她几周前就有预感。

pervade.en: A faint smell of fish pervaded the stairwell every afternoon around four.
pervade.zh: 每天下午四点左右，楼梯间里就飘着淡淡的鱼腥味。

perverse.en: It seems perverse to close the swimming pool during the hottest month of the year.
perverse.zh: 一年里最热的时候关掉游泳池，实在违背常理。

pervert.en: He was accused of perverting the course of justice by hiding the documents.
pervert.zh: 他因藏匿文件被控妨碍司法公正。

pester.en: The children pestered me for ice cream the whole way to the beach.
pester.zh: 去海滩的一路上，孩子们都缠着我要冰淇淋。

pesticide.en: Runoff from the fields carries pesticide into the stream behind the village.
pesticide.zh: 田里的径流把农药带进了村后的小溪。

petal.en: One petal dropped onto the table and she pressed it between two pages of her book.
petal.zh: 一片花瓣落在桌上，她把它夹进了书页里。

petition.en: Residents have started a petition against the new car park on the green.
petition.zh: 居民发起了请愿，反对在草地上新建停车场。

petroleum.en: Petroleum jelly is the cheapest thing in the first-aid box and the most used.
petroleum.zh: 凡士林是急救箱里最便宜、也用得最多的一样东西。

petty.en: They fell out over something petty, like whose turn it was to buy the milk.
petty.zh: 他们为点小事闹翻，比如轮到谁去买牛奶。

pharmaceutical.en: The pharmaceutical company moved its labs out to the industrial estate last year.
pharmaceutical.zh: 这家制药公司去年把实验室搬到了工业区。

phd.en: She finished her PhD at thirty-two and swore she would never write another footnote.
phd.zh: 她三十二岁读完博士，发誓再也不写脚注。

phenomenal.en: The response to the appeal was phenomenal; the target was met within two days.
phenomenal.zh: 募捐的反响惊人，两天就达到了目标。

phone-in.en: The station runs a phone-in every Friday morning about local transport.
phone-in.zh: 电台每周五上午办一档关于本地交通的热线节目。

phonetic.en: Children here learn to read by phonetic methods before they tackle whole words.
phonetic.zh: 这里的孩子先学拼读法，再认整词。

photocopies.en: She made photocopies of the letter and posted one to each of her aunts.
photocopies.zh: 她把信复印了几份，给每位姑妈各寄了一份。

photocopy.en: Could you photocopy the form and put the original back in the file?
photocopy.zh: 你能把表格复印一下，然后原件放回档案里吗？

photojournalism.en: He moved from wedding photography into photojournalism during the war.
photojournalism.zh: 战争期间他从婚礼摄影转行做了新闻摄影。

physiological.en: The reaction is physiological rather than psychological; it comes down to oxygen.
physiological.zh: 这反应是生理性的，不是心理性的，说到底跟氧气有关。

physique.en: His physique suits rowing, which is why the coach picked him out in his first term.
physique.zh: 他的体格适合划船，所以教练第一学期就看中了他。

piecemeal.en: Money for the fresco came in dribs and drabs, so the work went on piecemeal, one small patch a month.
piecemeal.zh: 修复壁画的经费断断续续，只能一块一块地修，一个月补一小块。

pier.en: We walked out to the end of the pier to watch the fishing boats unload.
pier.zh: 我们走到栈桥尽头，看渔船卸货。

pierce.en: The nurse warned me the needle would pierce the skin once, and that was all.
pierce.zh: 护士提醒我，针只会刺破皮肤一次，一下就好。

pigment.en: She ground the blue pigment with oil until it reached the shade she had in mind.
pigment.zh: 她把蓝色颜料和油一起研磨，直到调出心里想要的那个色调。

pilgrim.en: Every spring a few thousand pilgrims walk the last thirty miles to the shrine on foot.
pilgrim.zh: 每年春天，都有几千名朝圣者徒步走完最后三十英里，去山上的圣殿。

pinnacle.en: Winning the championship at twenty-three was the pinnacle of his career, and he never came close again.
pinnacle.zh: 二十三岁拿下冠军是他职业生涯的顶点，之后再也没有接近过。

pivot.en: When the shop lost its lease, the family pivoted within a month to selling online.
pivot.zh: 店铺租约到期后，这家人一个月内就把生意转向了网店。

placard.en: A protester stood outside the council office holding a placard that read “Save Our Library”.
placard.zh: 一名抗议者站在市政厅外，举着写着“救救我们的图书馆”的标语牌。

placement.en: The course includes a nine-month work placement with a firm in Leeds.
placement.zh: 这门课包含在利兹一家公司为期九个月的实习。

placid.en: Not a breath of wind troubled the placid lake, and the hills looked painted onto it.
placid.zh: 一丝风也没有，湖面平静得让山影像画上去的一样。

plagiarize.en: He was suspended for a term after he plagiarized two paragraphs from a journal article.
plagiarize.zh: 他从一篇期刊论文里抄了两段，被停学一学期。

plaintive.en: A plaintive cry came from the alley, and we found a kitten under an upturned crate.
plaintive.zh: 巷子里传来一声哀怨的叫声，我们在一只翻倒的木箱下发现了一只小猫。

planetarium.en: We spent the whole rainy afternoon in the planetarium, watching the stars wheel slowly across the dome.
planetarium.zh: 那个下雨的下午我们全泡在天文馆里，看星空在穹顶上缓缓转动。

plank.en: One floorboard had rotted right through, so he nailed a fresh plank over the gap.
plank.zh: 有块地板彻底烂穿了，他就钉了一块新木板盖住那个洞。

plankton.en: Whales filter tonnes of plankton out of the water during the summer feeding season.
plankton.zh: 夏季进食季，鲸鱼要从水里滤食成吨的浮游生物。

planner.en: As a city planner she spends most of her day arguing about bus lanes.
planner.zh: 作为城市规划师，她一天大半时间都在为公交专用道跟人争论。

planners.en: The wedding planners turned up at six to lay out the chairs before the guests arrived.
planners.zh: 婚礼策划团队六点就到了，趁客人来之前把椅子摆好。

plantation.en: Her grandfather worked on a rubber plantation in Malaysia for twenty years.
plantation.zh: 她祖父在马来西亚的橡胶园干了二十年。

plaster.en: The builder slapped plaster onto the wall and smoothed it flat with a wide trowel.
plaster.zh: 工人把灰浆甩上墙，再用宽抹刀抹平。

plateau.en: Work on the thesis hit a plateau in March, when the data simply stopped making sense.
plateau.zh: 论文三月份就停滞了，数据怎么也讲不通。

platitude.en: The manager's speech was all platitudes about teamwork and never once mentioned the pay cut.
platitude.zh: 经理的讲话全是关于团队合作的老生常谈，对降薪只字未提。

plausible.en: Her explanation sounded plausible until we checked the timestamps on the emails.
plausible.zh: 她的解释听着挺像回事，直到我们核对了邮件的时间戳。

plea.en: The family made a public plea for information about the dog, which had been missing for a week.
plea.zh: 那只狗已经丢了一周，一家人公开呼吁知情者提供线索。

plead.en: He pleaded with the landlord for one more week to pay the rent.
plead.zh: 他求房东再宽限一个星期交房租。

plight.en: The documentary drew attention to the plight of farmers whose wells had run dry.
plight.zh: 这部纪录片让人们关注到那些水井干涸的农民的困境。

plough.en: The tractor ploughs the lower field every October, before the winter wheat goes in.
plough.zh: 每年十月，拖拉机都会把下面那块地翻一遍，然后才种冬小麦。

plumb.en: The memoir plumbs the depths of a childhood spent in and out of care homes.
plumb.zh: 这本回忆录深挖了在福利院进进出出的童年。

plummet.en: Sales plummeted by forty percent the week after the free delivery ended.
plummet.zh: 免运费一停，第二周销量就暴跌了四成。

plunder.en: Vandals plundered the empty house, taking even the brass door handles.
plunder.zh: 破坏者把空房子洗劫一空，连黄铜门把手都拆走了。

plunge.en: She plunged into the cold sea, came up gasping, and laughed at her own scream.
plunge.zh: 她一头扎进冰凉的海水，冒出头来直喘气，然后笑自己的尖叫。

poise.en: She answered the hostile questions with the poise of someone twice her age.
poise.zh: 面对那些刁难的提问，她的从容像是个年纪大她一倍的人。

politic.en: He decided it was more politic to agree than to correct the director in front of the board.
politic.zh: 他觉得在董事会面前顺着总监说，比指出他的错误更明智。

pompous.en: The pompous professor lectured for an hour without once asking whether anyone had understood.
pompous.zh: 那位自命不凡的教授讲了一个小时，一次都没问过大家听懂没有。

ponder.en: She pondered the offer for two days and then turned it down without explanation.
ponder.zh: 那个提议她琢磨了两天，然后没给理由就谢绝了。

porcelain.en: We washed the thin porcelain cups by hand, purely out of fear.
porcelain.zh: 那些薄胎瓷杯我们全都手洗，纯粹是怕打碎。

pore.en: He pored over the old maps for hours, looking for a path down to the coast.
pore.zh: 他对着旧地图研究了好几个小时，想找一条通往海边的路。

porous.en: The chalk here is so porous that the rain disappears within minutes.
porous.zh: 这里的白垩岩孔隙太多，雨水几分钟就渗没了。

portfolio.en: She keeps a portfolio of her drawings in a black folder under the bed.
portfolio.zh: 她把自己的画作装在一个黑色文件夹里，塞在床底下。

portray.en: The film portrays the general as a tired man rather than a hero.
portray.zh: 这部电影把那位将军演成一个疲惫的人，而不是英雄。

postage.en: Postage to New Zealand cost more than the book itself.
postage.zh: 寄到新西兰的邮费比书本身还贵。

postcode.en: The parcel went astray because someone typed the postcode with the last digit wrong.
postcode.zh: 包裹寄丢了，因为有人把邮编最后一位打错了。

posterity.en: He printed his diaries in a single copy and left it to posterity rather than to readers.
posterity.zh: 他把日记只印了一本，留给后世，而不是留给读者。

postgraduate.en: After her postgraduate degree she moved to a lab in Utrecht and stayed eight years.
postgraduate.zh: 读完研究生后，她去了乌得勒支的一个实验室，一待就是八年。

posthumous.en: His last novel was posthumous, pieced together from drafts found in his desk.
posthumous.zh: 他最后一部小说是去世后出版的，由书桌里的草稿拼成。

postpone.en: They postponed the wedding until the church roof had been repaired.
postpone.zh: 他们把婚礼推迟到教堂屋顶修好之后。

postscript.en: In a postscript she added that she had handed in her notice that morning.
postscript.zh: 她在附言里补了一句：那天早上她已经递了辞呈。

posture.en: Twenty years of laptops had wrecked his posture by the time he was forty.
posture.zh: 到四十岁，二十年的笔记本生涯已经把他的体态毁了。

potent.en: The chilli sauce was so potent that a single drop silenced the whole table.
potent.zh: 那辣椒酱太猛烈，一滴就让整桌人没了声音。

potion.en: The children brewed a muddy potion of leaves and ditch water in the garden.
potion.zh: 孩子们在花园里用树叶和沟水熬了一锅泥乎乎的“药水”。

poultry.en: The farm keeps poultry in the upper field and cattle down by the river.
poultry.zh: 农场在上面的地里养家禽，牛则在河边。

pounce.en: The cat pounced the moment the shadow moved under the curtain.
pounce.zh: 帘子下的影子一动，猫就扑了上去。

practicable.en: It is not practicable to inspect every crate by hand, so we sample one in ten.
practicable.zh: 逐箱手检不现实，所以我们每十箱抽一箱。

practitioner.en: A general practitioner, two nurses and a part-time physiotherapist staff the clinic.
practitioner.zh: 一名全科医生、两名护士和一位兼职理疗师撑起了这家诊所。

precarious.en: He climbed onto a precarious stack of crates to reach the top shelf.
precarious.zh: 他爬上一摞摇摇欲坠的木箱去够最上层架子。

precaution.en: As a precaution she copied everything onto an external drive before the upgrade.
precaution.zh: 为保险起见，升级前她把所有东西都拷到了移动硬盘上。

precautions.en: Take sensible precautions: lock the gate and don't leave tools out overnight.
precautions.zh: 做些稳妥的防范：锁好大门，工具别在外头过夜。

precedence.en: In this kitchen the birthday cake takes precedence over everything else on the list.
precedence.zh: 在这个厨房里，生日蛋糕比其他所有事都优先。

precipice.en: The path narrows to a metre beside the precipice, and there is no railing at all.
precipice.zh: 悬崖边的小路窄到只剩一米，而且完全没有护栏。

collocations.phrase: on the edge of a precipice

precipitate.en: The collapse of the bank precipitated a panic that lasted all winter.
precipitate.zh: 那家银行的倒闭引发了一场持续整个冬天的恐慌。

predictable.en: The plot was so predictable that I guessed the ending from the first chapter.
predictable.zh: 情节太好猜了，我第一章就猜到了结尾。

predisposition.en: Her family has a predisposition to high cholesterol, so she has it checked every year.
predisposition.zh: 她家有高胆固醇的倾向，所以她每年都检查一次。

predominant.en: Oak is the predominant tree on this slope, with birch only near the stream.
predominant.zh: 这个山坡上主要是橡树，只有溪边才有桦树。

preface.en: In the preface the author thanks the librarian who let him sleep in the reading room.
preface.zh: 作者在序言里感谢了那位让他在阅览室睡觉的图书管理员。

preference.en: I have no preference between the two flats, so you decide.
preference.zh: 这两套房子我都没偏好，你定吧。

preliminary.en: Preliminary results suggest the vaccine holds up for at least a year.
preliminary.zh: 初步结果表明，这种疫苗至少能顶一年。

prelude.en: The short piano piece is a prelude to the much longer sonata that follows.
prelude.zh: 这首短钢琴曲是后面那首长得多的奏鸣曲的前奏。

premium.en: Passengers pay a premium for seats near the front, and those sell out first.
premium.zh: 乘客愿意为靠前的座位多付钱，而那些座位总是最先卖光。

prerogative.en: Changing the rota is the manager's prerogative, not something an intern can decide.
prerogative.zh: 调整排班是经理的特权，不是实习生能定的。

prescribe.en: The doctor prescribed a course of antibiotics and a week off work.
prescribe.zh: 医生开了一个疗程的抗生素，还开了一周病假。

prestigious.en: She turned down a prestigious job in London to stay near her mother.
prestigious.zh: 她放弃了伦敦一份很有声望的工作，为了留在母亲身边。

presumably.en: They have gone already, presumably before dawn, since the car was cold when I touched it.
presumably.zh: 他们已经走了，大概是天亮前，因为我摸车时车早就凉了。

presumption.en: There is a presumption of innocence, however awkward the facts may be.
presumption.zh: 不管事实多难堪，都要先推定无罪。

pretentious.en: Calling plain mashed potato “a velvet of root vegetables” struck me as pretentious.
pretentious.zh: 把普通土豆泥叫作“根茎蔬菜的丝绒”，我觉得很装。

prevalent.en: In the villages the clinic has never reached, the old belief is still prevalent.
prevalent.zh: 在诊所从未到过的村子里，这种旧看法依然很普遍。

prior.en: Applicants with prior experience in a lab are interviewed first.
prior.zh: 有实验室经验的申请人会先面试。

priorities.en: My priorities this month are the roof, the dentist and finishing the report.
priorities.zh: 这个月我要先处理的是屋顶、牙医和写完那份报告。

prizes.en: The school gives prizes for effort as well as for marks.
prizes.zh: 这所学校既给成绩发奖，也给努力发奖。

processing.en: The visa application is still in processing and may take another three weeks.
processing.zh: 签证申请还在审理中，可能还要三周。

proclaim.en: The town proclaimed a holiday the day the bridge finally reopened.
proclaim.zh: 桥终于重新通车那天，全镇宣布放假。

procure.en: That spring the hospital had to procure masks from three different suppliers.
procure.zh: 那年春天，医院不得不从三家不同的供应商那里采购口罩。

prodigious.en: He has a prodigious memory for dates but regularly forgets where he parked.
prodigious.zh: 他对日期记得惊人地牢，却经常忘了车停在哪。

productivity.en: Two short walks a day did more for my productivity than any app ever did.
productivity.zh: 每天走两小段路，对效率的帮助比任何软件都大。

profane.en: The crowd broke into profane chants that the commentator apologized for on air.
profane.zh: 人群突然喊起脏话口号，解说员在直播里为此道了歉。

professions.en: Teaching and nursing are still among the professions the public trusts most.
professions.zh: 教师和护士仍是公众最信任的职业之一。

proficiency.en: The job requires proficiency in Spanish and a clean driving licence.
proficiency.zh: 这份工作要求西班牙语熟练，还得有没扣分的驾照。

profuse.en: After the fever broke, he was left with profuse sweating and a pounding headache.
profuse.zh: 退烧之后，他浑身大汗，头痛欲裂。
profuse.revisionNote: 原句用 profusely 副词，未示范形容词 profuse，已重写

prolific.en: She was a prolific letter writer, sometimes posting five in a single day.
prolific.zh: 她写信极多，有时一天就寄出五封。

prologue.en: The prologue is set in 1912, fifty years before the main story begins.
prologue.zh: 序章发生在1912年，比正故事开始早了五十年。

prolong.en: Turning the mattress every month prolongs its life by a year or two.
prolong.zh: 每月翻一次床垫，能多用一两年。

propagate.en: The plant propagates easily: cut a stem, stand it in water, and wait.
propagate.zh: 这种植物很好繁殖：剪一段茎，插水里等着就行。

propel.en: A small outboard motor propelled the boat across the bay in twenty minutes.
propel.zh: 一台小舷外机把船在二十分钟内推过了海湾。

propriety.en: He questioned the propriety of accepting a gift from a firm bidding for the contract.
propriety.zh: 他质疑，收下一家正在投标的公司的礼物是否得体。

propulsion.en: The ferry switched to electric propulsion last year and is much quieter now.
propulsion.zh: 那艘渡轮去年改用了电力推进，现在安静多了。

prosecute.en: The council decided to prosecute the owners for dumping waste on the same verge three times.
prosecute.zh: 那家业主三次在同一片路边乱倒垃圾，市政会决定起诉他们。

prospect.en: The prospect of another winter alone in that house depressed him for weeks.
prospect.zh: 一想到又要一个人在那栋房子里过冬，他郁闷了好几个星期。

prospective.en: Prospective buyers were shown round the flat on Saturday mornings only.
prospective.zh: 潜在买家只在周六上午被带来看房。

prospectus.en: The school prospectus promises small classes, which is true only in the sixth form.
prospectus.zh: 学校的招生简章承诺小班教学，可这话只在毕业班算数。

protein.en: She gets her protein from lentils and beans and hasn't eaten meat in years.
protein.zh: 她的蛋白质来自扁豆和豆子，已经好多年不吃肉了。

protocol.en: The lab protocol requires two people to sign off on every sample.
protocol.zh: 实验室规程要求每个样本都要两个人签字确认。

prototype.en: The first prototype weighed nine kilos and overheated after ten minutes.
prototype.zh: 第一台样机重九公斤，运行十分钟就过热。

protract.en: Negotiations were protracted and left both families exhausted and poorer.
protract.zh: 谈判一拖再拖，两家人最后又累又穷。

protrude.en: A nail protruded from the plank and tore the sleeve of my coat.
protrude.zh: 木板上一颗钉子突出来，把我外套袖子刮破了。

provision.en: The contract makes provision for two extra payments if the work runs late.
provision.zh: 合同规定，工程延期可以追加两次付款。

provisional.en: We booked a provisional date in June and confirmed it once the venue replied.
provisional.zh: 我们先把日子暂定在六月，等场地回复后才定下来。

provoke.en: His remark provoked a silence that lasted the whole drive home.
provoke.zh: 他那句话引来一阵沉默，一直沉默到开车回家。

proxy.en: She voted by proxy at the shareholders' meeting because she was abroad.
proxy.zh: 她人在国外，股东大会上是委托别人代投的票。

pseudonym.en: She published her crime novels under a pseudonym so her students wouldn't find them.
pseudonym.zh: 她的犯罪小说是用笔名出的，免得学生找上门来。

psycholinguistics.en: He moved from literary criticism into psycholinguistics after a lecture on how children pick up words.
psycholinguistics.zh: 听过一场讲儿童如何习得词汇的讲座后，他从文学批评转到了心理语言学。

pump.en: The volunteers pumped water out of the cellar until well past midnight.
pump.zh: 志愿者们一直把地窖里的水往外抽，抽到过了半夜。

puncture.en: A thorn punctured the front tyre four miles from the nearest village.
puncture.zh: 一根刺扎破了前胎，离最近的村子还有四英里。

pungent.en: The pungent smell of the cheese filled the whole bus within minutes.
pungent.zh: 那股刺鼻的奶酪味几分钟就充满了整辆公交车。

purest.en: The purest water in the valley comes from the spring above the farm.
purest.zh: 山谷里最纯净的水，来自农场上方的那眼泉。

purge.en: The new editor purged the archive of anything that might upset advertisers.
purge.zh: 新主编把所有可能惹恼广告商的内容都从档案里清掉了。

purity.en: The purity of the mountain air surprised her after ten years in the city.
purity.zh: 在山里待了十年城市生活之后，这山间空气的纯净让她吃了一惊。

pursuit.en: He gave up a career in law in pursuit of a life outdoors.
pursuit.zh: 为了过上户外的生活，他放弃了法律这行。

qualification.en: This teaching qualification is recognized in Scotland but not in England.
qualification.zh: 这个教师资格在苏格兰被认可，在英格兰不算。

qualifications.en: She has the qualifications on paper but has never actually run a team.
qualifications.zh: 她的资历纸上都齐了，却从没真正带过团队。

qualify.en: Finishing fourth was just enough to qualify for the final in Zurich.
qualify.zh: 拿第四名刚好够进苏黎世的决赛。

qualitative.en: Forty interviews and not a single number: the study is purely qualitative.
qualitative.zh: 四十次访谈，一个数字都没有——这项研究是纯定性的。

quantitative.en: Anecdote fills the report, and quantitative evidence is very thin.
quantitative.zh: 报告里全是轶事，定量证据非常单薄。

quarry.en: The old quarry is now a lake where local people swim all summer.
quarry.zh: 那座老采石场现在成了湖，当地人整个夏天都在里面游泳。

quarterly.en: The figures come out quarterly, always on the last Friday of the month.
quarterly.zh: 这些数据每季度公布一次，总在当月最后一个周五。

questionnaire.en: Only a third of the patients bothered to return the questionnaire.
questionnaire.zh: 只有三分之一的病人愿意把问卷寄回来。

quiver.en: Her voice quivered as she read the letter aloud to the family.
quiver.zh: 她给全家人念那封信时，声音在发抖。

quota.en: Each boat has a quota of cod and has to stop fishing once it is reached.
quota.zh: 每条船都有鳕鱼配额，一旦捕满就得停手。

rack.en: She hung her wet coat on the rack and shook the rain out of her hair.
rack.zh: 她把湿外套挂到架子上，甩了甩头发上的雨水。

radiate.en: The stove radiated heat for a full hour after the fire had died.
radiate.zh: 火灭了以后，炉子还散发了一个小时的热气。

raft.en: They crossed the river on a raft made of oil drums and old planks.
raft.zh: 他们坐着一条用油桶和旧木板扎成的筏子过了河。

ragged.en: After a winter on the pole the flag had gone ragged at the edges.
ragged.zh: 在旗杆上挂了一个冬天，旗子的边都磨毛了。

raid.en: Police raided the warehouse at dawn and found two hundred stolen bicycles.
raid.zh: 警察黎明时突袭了那间仓库，找到两百辆赃车。

ramble.en: He rambled for twenty minutes about his old job before anyone could ask the question again.
ramble.zh: 他东拉西扯讲了二十分钟他的旧工作，别人才有机会再问一遍。

rampant.en: Rumours were rampant after the director resigned without a word of explanation.
rampant.zh: 总监一声不吭就辞职后，办公室里的传言满天飞。

ransom.en: The gang demanded a ransom, and the family refused to pay a penny of it.
ransom.zh: 那伙人索要赎金，这家人一分钱都不肯给。

ravage.en: Beetles have ravaged the pine forests along the whole ridge.
ravage.zh: 甲虫把整道山脊的松林都啃毁了。

rave.en: The critics raved about the play, yet the theatre was half empty.
rave.zh: 评论界对这部戏赞不绝口，剧场却坐了一半。

realm.en: Tax law is a realm where I happily admit complete ignorance.
realm.zh: 税法这领域，我甘愿承认自己一窍不通。

reassure.en: The doctor reassured her that the scan was normal, and she cried anyway.
reassure.zh: 医生安慰她说扫描结果正常，她还是哭了。

receptionist.en: The receptionist rang up at lunchtime to say a parcel had arrived for me.
receptionist.zh: 前台中午打电话上来，说我有包裹到了。

reciprocal.en: The two universities have a reciprocal arrangement on library access.
reciprocal.zh: 这两所大学在图书馆使用上有互惠安排。

recital.en: Her piano recital was in a small hall with a bad piano and a full house.
recital.zh: 她的钢琴演奏会是在一个小厅里，琴很糟，人却坐满了。

reclaim.en: We reclaimed the old vegetable patch from the nettles over one long, scratched summer.
reclaim.zh: 我们花了一个漫长又伤痕累累的夏天，才把那片菜地从荨麻手里夺回来。

recline.en: He reclined the seat and slept through most of the flight.
recline.zh: 他把座椅放倒，一大半航程都在睡。

recording.en: The recording is muffled, but you can just make out a second voice.
recording.zh: 录音很闷，但勉强能听出还有第二个人的声音。

recycle.en: The council recycles glass separately and collects it every other Tuesday.
recycle.zh: 市政会把玻璃单独回收，每隔一个周二来收。

referees.en: The journal sent the paper to two referees, one of whom sat on it for four months.
referees.zh: 期刊把论文送给了两位审稿人，其中一位压了四个月。

referendum.en: The referendum on the new constitution was boycotted by two of the largest parties.
referendum.zh: 关于新宪法的公投遭到两个最大政党的抵制。

reflectance.en: A coat of white paint raises the roof's reflectance and keeps the building cooler.
reflectance.zh: 涂一层白漆能提高屋顶的反射率，让房子凉快些。

refreshment.en: Refreshments will be served in the hall after the ceremony.
refreshment.zh: 仪式结束后会在大厅供应茶点。

refugee.en: The family arrived as refugees with two bags and the address of a cousin they had never met.
refugee.zh: 这家人来的时候是难民，只带着两个包，和一个从没见过面的表亲的地址。

regeneration.en: The regeneration of the old docklands took fifteen years and cost more than the stadium did.
regeneration.zh: 旧港区的改造花了十五年，耗资比那座体育场还多。

registrar.en: The registrar asked us to check the spelling of our names before we signed.
registrar.zh: 登记员让我们签字前先核对名字的拼写。

rehabilitate.en: The centre rehabilitates injured birds and releases them in the spring.
rehabilitate.zh: 这家中心救治受伤的鸟，春天再把它们放归。

collocations.zh: 帮助罪犯重新融入社会

reign.en: Her reign lasted thirty years and ended with a single paragraph read out on the radio.
reign.zh: 她统治了三十年，最后以电台里念出的一段话收场。

reinforce.en: Steel bars reinforce the concrete right above the doorway, where the load is heaviest.
reinforce.zh: 门上方承重最重，那里的混凝土用钢筋加固过。

reinforced.en: Wire mesh reinforced the windows and kept out the stones thrown up from the road.
reinforced.zh: 窗户用铁丝网加固过，挡住了路上飞起的石子。

relapse.en: He stopped taking the tablets in May and relapsed within a fortnight.
relapse.zh: 他五月份停了药，不到两周就复发了。

relaxation.en: An hour with a book is the only real relaxation I get these days.
relaxation.zh: 如今我唯一真正放松的时候，就是捧着书看一小时。

relay.en: She relayed the message to the rest of the team before the meeting started.
relay.zh: 开会前她把这个消息转达给了团队其他人。

relentless.en: The relentless wind off the sea stripped the paint off the seaward wall.
relentless.zh: 海上刮来的风没完没了，把朝海那面墙的漆都剥掉了。

relinquish.en: He refused to relinquish control of the company even after the stroke.
relinquish.zh: 中风之后他也死活不肯交出公司的控制权。

remnant.en: A remnant of the old town wall still stands behind the car park.
remnant.zh: 老城墙还剩下一截，立在停车场后面。

render.en: The fire rendered the upper floor uninhabitable for six months.
render.zh: 那场火让二楼有半年没法住人。

renewal.en: Her visa is up for renewal in March, and the queue at the office is legendary.
renewal.zh: 她的签证三月要续，而那个办事处的队伍是出了名的。

renovation.en: The renovation uncovered a fireplace that had been bricked up since the fifties.
renovation.zh: 翻修时发现了一个从五十年代就被砖封上的壁炉。

renowned.en: Cheese made the village renowned; the weather made it notorious.
renowned.zh: 奶酪让这个村子出了名，天气让它出了恶名。

repatriate.en: The government repatriated the remains of the soldiers forty years after the war ended.
repatriate.zh: 战争结束四十年后，政府把那些士兵的遗骸运回了国。

repel.en: The spray repels mosquitoes for about four hours, then you have to reapply it.
repel.zh: 这喷雾驱蚊大约四小时，之后就得重喷。

repent.en: She repented the words the instant they left her mouth, but it was too late.
repent.zh: 那些话一出口她就后悔了，可是已经晚了。

reproach.en: He reproached me for never calling, though he had not called either.
reproach.zh: 他怪我不打电话，可他自己也没打过。

reptile.en: The reptile house smells of damp bark and warm lamps.
reptile.zh: 爬虫馆里一股湿树皮和暖灯的味道。

reservoir.en: Down to forty percent, the reservoir has forced the city to ban hosepipes.
reservoir.zh: 水位只剩四成，水库逼得市里禁了浇园的软管。

resilience.en: The resilience of the community after the flood surprised even the aid workers.
resilience.zh: 洪水过后社区的韧性，连救援人员都觉得意外。

resistance.en: The new strain shows resistance to the standard antibiotic.
resistance.zh: 这种新菌株对常规抗生素有抗药性。

resistant.en: These tomatoes are resistant to blight but taste of very little.
resistant.zh: 这些番茄抗病，可吃起来几乎没味。

resonant.en: His resonant voice carried to the back of the hall without a microphone.
resonant.zh: 他嗓音浑厚，不用麦克风也能传到大厅最后排。

respiration.en: The monitor tracks her respiration while she sleeps and wakes me if it drops.
respiration.zh: 监护仪在她睡觉时监测呼吸，一旦下降就会把我叫醒。

respondents.en: Most respondents said they would pay a little more for food grown locally.
respondents.zh: 多数受访者表示愿意为本地种植的食物多花点钱。

responsive.en: Since we threatened to move out, the landlord has been surprisingly responsive.
responsive.zh: 自从我们说要搬走，房东的反应出奇地积极。

restore.en: The gallery needed eighteen months to restore the painting's damaged corner.
restore.zh: 美术馆花了十八个月，才把那幅画损坏的一角修复好。

retails.en: The same jacket retails at twice the price in the city centre.
retails.zh: 同一件夹克在市中心零售价要贵一倍。

retain.en: The soil retains water so well that the bottom field floods every spring.
retain.zh: 这土保水太好，下面那块地年年春天都积水。

reticent.en: He is reticent about his childhood, and I have stopped asking.
reticent.zh: 他对自己的童年讳莫如深，我也就不问了。

retort.en: She retorted that she had been waiting an hour, not five minutes.
retort.zh: 她回嘴说她等了一个小时，不是五分钟。

retrieve.en: The dog retrieved the stick from the middle of the pond and shook water over everyone.
retrieve.zh: 狗从池塘中央把树枝叼了回来，还甩了大家一身水。

retrospect.en: In retrospect, selling the flat in 2019 was the best decision we ever made.
retrospect.zh: 回想起来，2019年卖掉那套房子是我们做过最对的决定。

revelation.en: The revelation that the letters were forged changed the whole biography.
revelation.zh: 那些信件是伪造的这一发现，改写了整本传记。

reverent.en: The visitors fell into a reverent hush as they stepped into the chapel.
reverent.zh: 参观者一走进小教堂，就不约而同地安静下来。

rhetoric.en: Behind all the rhetoric about efficiency lay a simple plan to cut staff.
rhetoric.zh: 关于效率的那套说辞背后，其实就是个裁员的简单计划。

riders.en: Riders on the night bus complained that the route had been quietly shortened.
riders.zh: 夜班公交的乘客抱怨说，这条线路被悄悄缩短了。

rig.en: They rigged a tarpaulin over the woodpile the evening before the rain came.
rig.zh: 下雨前一晚，他们在柴堆上方临时搭了块防水布。

righteous.en: He was righteous about recycling and furious when he found a bottle in the general waste.
righteous.zh: 他对回收这件事理直气壮，在普通垃圾里发现一个瓶子就火了。

rip.en: A branch ripped a hole in my jacket as I pushed through the hedge.
rip.zh: 我从树篱里挤过去时，一根树枝把外套扯了个洞。

ripple.en: A stone thrown into the pond sent ripples all the way to the far bank.
ripple.zh: 一块石头扔进池塘，涟漪一直荡到对岸。

rivet.en: Thumb-sized rivets held the hull together through two winters of ice.
rivet.zh: 拇指大的铆钉把船身铆在一起，扛过了两个结冰的冬天。

roam.en: Dogs are not allowed to roam freely on the reserve between April and July.
roam.zh: 四月到七月，保护区里不许狗自由乱跑。

roar.en: The crowd roared when the second goal went in, and my father hugged a stranger.
roar.zh: 第二个球进的时候全场沸腾，我爸还抱了个陌生人。

rotate.en: So that the soil is never exhausted, the crops are rotated every third year.
rotate.zh: 为了不耗尽地力，庄稼每三年轮换一次。

rouse.en: The noise outside failed to rouse him; he had slept through worse.
rouse.zh: 外面的动静没能把他弄醒，比这更吵的他都睡过去了。

ruffle.en: The wind ruffled the pages of the book she had left open on the grass.
ruffle.zh: 风把她摊在草地上的书页吹得翻动。

ruinous.en: The legal costs were ruinous, and in the end the case was quietly dropped.
ruinous.zh: 律师费高得能压垮人，最后案子悄悄撤了。

rupture.en: The pipe ruptured under the road and flooded the basement of the shop.
rupture.zh: 路面下的管道爆了，把店铺地下室淹了。

ruthless.en: He was ruthless about cutting anything that did not pay for itself within a year.
ruthless.zh: 凡是不能一年内回本的东西，他砍起来毫不手软。

sabotage.en: Someone sabotaged the generator the night before the harvest.
sabotage.zh: 收割前一晚，有人把发电机破坏了。

saddle.en: She saddled the horse and rode out before the sun was properly up.
saddle.zh: 她给马上了鞍，太阳还没完全出来就骑出去了。

safeguard.en: Tenants are meant to be safeguarded by that clause from sudden eviction.
safeguard.zh: 那一条本来是要保护租户不被突然赶走的。

saline.en: The nurse flushed the wound with saline and dressed it in under a minute.
saline.zh: 护士用生理盐水冲洗了伤口，不到一分钟就包扎好了。

salute.en: The soldiers saluted the flag as it went up, and nobody spoke.
salute.zh: 旗帜升起时士兵们敬礼，没人说话。

salvage.en: Divers salvaged most of the cargo two months after the ship went down.
salvage.zh: 船沉两个月后，潜水员把大部分货物打捞了上来。

sanitary.en: With no sanitary facilities at all, the camp saw disease spread within days.
sanitary.zh: 营地毫无卫生设施，疾病几天内就传开了。

sanity.en: A month of night shifts had begun to test her sanity.
sanity.zh: 一个月的夜班已经开始考验她的精神了。

sarcasm.en: His sarcasm went straight over the new intern's head.
sarcasm.zh: 他的讽刺新来的实习生完全没听出来。

saturate.en: Every step made a sucking sound, the ground was so saturated.
saturate.zh: 每走一步都咕唧作响，地面已经吸饱了水。

savage.en: Six years passed before the playwright wrote again, so savage was the review.
savage.zh: 六年过去，那位剧作家才重新动笔，那篇评论狠到了这种程度。

scalpel.en: The surgeon held the scalpel still for a second before the first cut.
scalpel.zh: 外科医生在下第一刀前，把手术刀停了一秒钟。

scan.en: The scan showed nothing wrong, which was somehow more unsettling than a diagnosis.
scan.zh: 扫描显示一切正常，可这反倒比给出诊断更让人不安。

scant.en: There is scant evidence for the claim, though it is repeated everywhere.
scant.zh: 这个说法证据少得可怜，却到处被人重复。

scapegoat.en: The junior clerk was made the scapegoat for a mistake made three levels above her.
scapegoat.zh: 这个错是上面三级的人犯的，黑锅却让那个小职员背了。

sceptical.en: I was sceptical about the diet until my blood pressure actually came down.
sceptical.zh: 我本来不信这套饮食法，直到血压真的降下来了。

scold.en: She scolded the dog for chasing the hens, then gave him a biscuit anyway.
scold.zh: 她骂了狗一顿，怪它追鸡，转头还是给了它一块饼干。

scoop.en: He scooped the coins into a paper bag and counted them out at the till.
scoop.zh: 他把硬币拢进纸袋，在收银台前一枚枚数。

scorch.en: The iron scorched the collar of my only good shirt.
scorch.zh: 熨斗把我唯一一件像样的衬衫领子烫焦了。

scorn.en: She poured scorn on the idea that the road could be finished by December.
scorn.zh: 有人说到十二月这条路能修完，她对此嗤之以鼻。

scotsman.en: A Scotsman at the next table heard us arguing about haggis and joined in with relish.
scotsman.zh: 邻桌一位苏格兰人听见我们在争哈吉斯，兴致勃勃地加入了。

scout.en: The club sent a scout to watch the striker twice before they made an offer.
scout.zh: 俱乐部先后派球探看了那名前锋两次，才提出报价。

scroll.en: I scrolled through the whole thread and found nothing that answered my question.
scroll.zh: 我把整个帖子从头翻到尾，没找到一句能回答我问题的。

scrutiny.en: The accounts came under scrutiny the week after the auditor resigned.
scrutiny.zh: 审计师辞职后一周，这些账目就受到了严查。

sculpture.en: The sculpture in the square is a bronze horse with no rider and no tail.
sculpture.zh: 广场上那座雕塑是一匹青铜马，没有骑手，也没有尾巴。

scum.en: By August a green scum covered the whole pond and the fish had gone.
scum.zh: 到了八月，一层绿沫盖住了整个池塘，鱼也没了。

seal.en: She sealed the jars with wax while the jam was still hot and wrote the date on each lid.
seal.zh: 果酱还热的时候她就用蜡把罐子封好，在每个盖子上写了日期。

seam.en: The seam of my coat gave way at the shoulder just as the rain started.
seam.zh: 雨刚开始下，我外套肩膀的缝线就裂了。

seclude.en: Hidden behind a thick wall of laurel, the house sits secluded and invisible from the lane.
seclude.zh: 房子藏在厚厚一道月桂树墙后，很僻静，从巷子里根本看不见。

secretion.en: The plant traps insects in a sticky secretion on its leaves.
secretion.zh: 这种植物用叶片上的黏性分泌物把虫子粘住。

sectional.en: Being sectional, the sofa can gain a corner piece when we move to a bigger flat.
sectional.zh: 这沙发是组合式的，搬到更大的房子时可以加一个转角。

secular.en: Carols are still sung every December at the school, secular though it is.
secular.zh: 学校虽是世俗学校，每年十二月照样唱颂歌。

sediment.en: Each flood leaves a band of sediment that geologists can date to the year.
sediment.zh: 每次洪水都留下一层沉积物，地质学家能把它精确到年份。

seemingly.en: A missing form that nobody could produce seemingly caused the whole delay.
seemingly.zh: 延误看起来是因为一份谁也拿不出来的表格。

seep.en: Rainwater seeps through the stone and drips into the cellar all winter.
seep.zh: 雨水渗过石头，整个冬天都在往地窖里滴。

segment.en: This segment of the market is small but growing faster than any other.
segment.zh: 这个细分市场很小，但增长比哪一块都快。

segregate.en: Waste is segregated at the depot into glass, metal and paper.
segregate.zh: 垃圾在回收站被分成玻璃、金属和纸张。

seismic.en: Seismic surveys suggest there may be gas under the estuary.
seismic.zh: 地震勘探显示，河口下面可能藏着天然气。

self-discipline.en: Writing for an hour before work takes a kind of self-discipline I can only manage in winter.
self-discipline.zh: 上班前写一小时需要一种自律，而我只有冬天做得到。

self-sufficient.en: In vegetables and eggs the farm is almost self-sufficient, though it still buys flour.
self-sufficient.zh: 蔬菜和鸡蛋农场几乎自给自足，不过面粉还得买。

semblance.en: By Friday we had restored some semblance of order to the flat.
semblance.zh: 到周五，我们总算让公寓看上去有点秩序了。

septic.en: The septic tank needs emptying every two years, whether it smells or not.
septic.zh: 化粪池每两年要清一次，不管有没有异味。

sequence.en: The sequence of events that night has never been fully explained.
sequence.zh: 那天晚上到底是怎么一步一步发生的，至今没个完整说法。

setback.en: Losing the grant was a setback, but the project carried on at half the scale.
setback.zh: 没拿到资助是个挫折，但项目还是以一半的规模继续做。

settlement.en: The two firms reached a settlement out of court and said nothing to the press.
settlement.zh: 两家公司庭外和解，对媒体一个字都没说。

shaft.en: A shaft of light came through the hole in the roof and landed on the piano.
shaft.zh: 一束光从屋顶的破洞射进来，正好落在钢琴上。

shamble.en: The old dog shambled to the door and lay down where the sun was.
shamble.zh: 那条老狗拖着步子走到门口，在有太阳的地方趴下。

shanty.en: The town grew out of a shanty of tin roofs into a proper port within thirty years.
shanty.zh: 这座镇子三十年间从一片铁皮棚户变成了像样的港口。

shatter.en: The glass shattered on the tiles, and we spent an hour sweeping up the pieces.
shatter.zh: 玻璃在瓷砖上碎了一地，我们扫了一个小时碎片。

shear.en: In June, before the worst of the heat, the sheep are sheared.
shear.zh: 六月，赶在最热的时候之前，羊要剪毛。

shield.en: She raised a hand to shield her eyes from the sun and squinted at the road ahead.
shield.zh: 她抬手挡着阳光，眯眼看着前面的路。

shimmer.en: The road shimmered in the heat all afternoon and the horizon kept moving.
shimmer.zh: 路面整个下午都在热浪里晃动，地平线像在挪动。

shoal.en: A shoal of small silver fish flickered past the rocks and was gone.
shoal.zh: 一群小银鱼在礁石边一闪而过，就没了。

shred.en: He shredded the old bank statements and took the bag to the tip himself.
shred.zh: 他把旧银行对账单都碎了，自己把袋子送去垃圾场。

shrewd.en: Buying the shop just before the road was widened turned out to be a shrewd move.
shrewd.zh: 在马路拓宽前买下那家店，事后看是很精明的一步。

shrub.en: The shrubs along the fence need cutting back every autumn or they swallow the path.
shrub.zh: 篱笆边的灌木每年秋天都得修剪，不然就把小路吞了。

shrug.en: She shrugged and said the decision was not hers to make anyway.
shrug.zh: 她耸了耸肩，说反正这决定轮不到她来做。

shutter.en: Closed and shuttered, the shop had a handwritten notice promising to be back within the hour.
shutter.zh: 店门关着，窗板也放下了，上面一张手写告示说一小时内回来。

sicken.en: He was sickened by how casually the men talked about the accident.
sicken.zh: 那些人谈起那场事故时的那种漫不经心，让他反胃。

siege.en: For eleven months the town was under siege before it finally surrendered.
siege.zh: 这座城被围了十一个月，最后才投降。

sieve.en: Drain the rice in a sieve and leave it covered for ten minutes to steam.
sieve.zh: 把米倒进筛子里沥干，盖上焖十分钟。

simulate.en: The software simulates traffic at the junction during the evening rush hour.
simulate.zh: 这个软件能模拟晚高峰时那个路口的车流。

simultaneous.en: The two broadcasts were simultaneous, and nobody noticed the error for a week.
simultaneous.zh: 两场转播是同时进行的，那个错误一周都没人发现。

singular.en: What struck me was the singular beauty of the place in fog, all grey and quiet.
singular.zh: 让我震动的是这地方起雾时那种奇特的美，灰蒙蒙，静悄悄。

skim.en: She skimmed the report, underlined two paragraphs and left the rest for Monday.
skim.zh: 她把报告翻了翻，划了两段，其余留到周一。

slab.en: A slab of concrete had fallen from the parapet of the bridge onto the path below.
slab.zh: 一块混凝土从桥的护栏上掉下来，砸在下面的路上。

slack.en: Business is slack in January, so the whole staff takes their holidays then.
slack.zh: 一月生意清淡，所以全体员工都在那时候休假。

slag.en: The slag heap from the old mine is now covered in birch and looks almost natural.
slag.zh: 那座老矿的矿渣堆如今长满了桦树，看着几乎像天然的。

slam.en: He slammed the door so hard that the picture fell off the wall.
slam.zh: 他关门太用力，墙上的画都震掉了。

slander.en: He sued the paper for slander and won a small settlement and an apology.
slander.zh: 他以诽谤起诉那家报纸，赢了小额赔偿和一句道歉。

slate.en: Two tiles of the slate roof came off in last week's gale.
slate.zh: 上周大风刮掉了石板屋顶的两片瓦。

slogan.en: The slogan on the poster read “Nothing about us without us”.
slogan.zh: 海报上的口号是“没有我们的参与，就不要替我们做决定”。

slot.en: I have a slot at the dentist at four on Thursday, which just fits.
slot.zh: 周四四点我有个牙医的预约，时间刚好。

sluggish.en: The engine felt sluggish until I changed the air filter.
sluggish.zh: 换了空气滤芯之前，发动机一直发闷。

smelly.en: The smelly bin bag had been sitting in the sun for a week.
smelly.zh: 那袋发臭的垃圾在太阳下放了一个星期。

smother.en: She smothered a laugh and turned it into a cough just in time.
smother.zh: 她硬把笑憋回去，及时变成了一声咳嗽。

smuggle.en: They were caught trying to smuggle cigarettes through customs in a guitar case.
smuggle.zh: 他们想用吉他盒把香烟走私过海关，被抓住了。

snatch.en: A gull snatched the sandwich straight out of his hand.
snatch.zh: 一只海鸥从他手里把三明治抢走了。

soak.en: Soak the beans overnight, then simmer them for an hour with bay leaves.
soak.zh: 豆子泡一夜，然后加香叶小火煮一小时。

solemn.en: He made a solemn promise to look after the dog, and he kept it for fourteen years.
solemn.zh: 他郑重承诺会照顾那条狗，这一照顾就是十四年。

solvent.en: Paint thinner is a strong solvent and should never go down the drain.
solvent.zh: 稀释剂是强力溶剂，绝不能倒进下水道。

soundproof.en: The rehearsal room is soundproof, so the neighbours never hear the drums at all.
soundproof.zh: 排练室是隔音的，邻居完全听不到鼓声。

sparse.en: Vegetation is sparse above the treeline, mostly moss and a little tough grass.
sparse.zh: 树线以上植被稀疏，主要是苔藓和一点硬草。

spatial.en: Children build spatial awareness by climbing, falling and judging gaps.
spatial.zh: 孩子靠攀爬、摔跤和判断间隙来建立空间感。

specialize.en: The firm specializes in restoring old windows that other people would replace.
specialize.zh: 这家公司专修别人会直接换掉的旧窗子。

specification.en: The specification calls for oak, but pine would do and cost half as much.
specification.zh: 规格书要求用橡木，可用松木也行，价钱还能省一半。

specimen.en: Collected in 1932, the specimen has never been examined since.
specimen.zh: 这个标本1932年采集，之后再没被人检查过。

spectator.en: From the spectator's side of the fence the race was over in the first hundred metres.
spectator.zh: 从围栏外观众的角度看，比赛头一百米就定胜负了。

collocations.phrase: from the spectator's point of view

spectrum.en: Opinions on the plan cover the whole spectrum, from real fury to total indifference.
spectrum.zh: 对这个方案的意见从暴怒到完全无所谓，什么都有。

speculate.en: Journalists speculated about the resignation for weeks before any statement appeared.
speculate.zh: 在正式声明出来之前，记者们已经猜了好几个星期。

splash.en: A car splashed through the puddle and soaked my trousers from the knee down.
splash.zh: 一辆车蹚过水坑，把我裤子从膝盖往下全溅湿了。

spokesman.en: A spokesman for the airline said the delay had been caused by a technical fault.
spokesman.zh: 航空公司的一位发言人表示，延误是技术故障造成的。

spontaneous.en: Longer than the speech itself, the applause was entirely spontaneous.
spontaneous.zh: 掌声比讲话本身还长，完全是自发的。

sportswear.en: She changed out of her office clothes into sportswear and jogged the two blocks to the pool before it closed.
sportswear.zh: 她脱下上班的套装，换成运动服，赶在泳池关门前跑过两个街区去游泳。

spotlight.en: When the theatre's spotlight swung to the back row, the young pianist realised the encore was hers to play.
spotlight.zh: 剧场聚光灯扫到后排时，那位年轻钢琴家才意识到返场曲要由自己来弹。

sprout.en: Beans sprouted in the damp paper towel within four days, and the children drew every new leaf in their notebooks.
sprout.zh: 豆子四天就在湿纸巾上发了芽，孩子们把每一片新叶都画进了本子里。

squeeze.en: He squeezed through the gap between a parked van and the wall, holding the cake box above his head.
squeeze.zh: 他侧身挤过货车和墙之间的缝隙，把蛋糕盒举过头顶。

stability.en: The bridge stayed closed for two weeks while engineers checked its stability after the flood.
stability.zh: 洪水过后，工程师检查桥梁的稳定性，桥因此封了两周。

stabilize.en: The doctors wanted to stabilize her blood pressure before letting anyone into the room, so the door stayed shut for two days.
stabilize.zh: 医生想先把她的血压稳住再让人进病房，所以门关了两天。

stagger.en: She staggered off the roller coaster and sat on the nearest bench until the ground stopped moving.
stagger.zh: 她踉跄着下了过山车，坐在最近的长椅上，等地面不再晃。

stagnant.en: The pond behind the mill had gone stagnant, and a green film covered the water where the ducks used to swim.
stagnant.zh: 磨坊后面的池塘已经成了一潭死水，鸭子原先游水的地方浮着一层绿膜。

starch.en: The hotel laundress added starch to the collars so that they stood up crisply under the uniform.
starch.zh: 酒店洗衣工在衣领上加了浆，好让它挺括地立在制服上方。

starter.en: For a starter we shared a plate of grilled octopus, which arrived before we had even ordered wine.
starter.zh: 开胃菜我们分了一盘烤章鱼，那盘菜在我们还没点酒时就端上来了。

static.en: The radio gave only static until my grandfather climbed onto the roof and turned the antenna a few degrees.
static.zh: 收音机全是杂音，直到我爷爷爬上屋顶把天线转了几度。

stationary.en: The cyclist swerved around a stationary bus and nearly hit a delivery cart.
stationary.zh: 骑车的人绕开一辆停着不动的公交车，差点撞上送货车。

statute.en: Under the new statute, landlords must return the deposit within thirty days of the move-out inspection.
statute.zh: 根据新的法规，房东必须在退租检查后三十天内退还押金。

steadfast.en: Throughout the divorce her aunt stayed steadfast, driving her to court every Tuesday without asking questions.
steadfast.zh: 整个离婚期间，她的姑妈始终坚定不移，每周二开车送她去法院，从不多问。

steamer.en: She set the bamboo steamer over boiling water and left the dumplings to cook for eight minutes.
steamer.zh: 她把竹蒸笼架在沸水上，让饺子蒸了八分钟。

steer.en: The ferry captain steered around the sandbar, and the whole deck seemed to exhale at once.
steer.zh: 渡轮船长绕开沙洲，整条甲板上的人好像同时松了口气。

stem.en: Most of the complaints stem from a booking system that crashes every Monday morning.
stem.zh: 大部分投诉都源自一个每周一早上必定崩溃的订票系统。

sterilize.en: The nurse sterilized the scissors in the small autoclave before the doctor began the stitches.
sterilize.zh: 医生缝针之前，护士用那台小高压锅把剪刀消了毒。

sterling.en: He paid in sterling at the border shop, and the cashier had to dig a rate card out from under the counter.
sterling.zh: 他在边境小店里用英镑付款，收银员只好从柜台底下翻出一张汇率表。

steward.en: A steward walked down the aisle with a jug of water, refilling cups for passengers stuck on the runway.
steward.zh: 一名乘务员提着水壶走过过道，给堵在跑道上的乘客续水。

stimulus.en: The tax rebate acted as a stimulus for small shops, which hired extra staff for the holiday season.
stimulus.zh: 退税对小店起到了刺激作用，他们为节日旺季多雇了人手。

stipulate.en: The lease stipulates that no pets are allowed, though the landlord has quietly ignored that rule for years.
stipulate.zh: 租约规定不许养宠物，不过房东多年来一直睁一只眼闭一只眼。

stoop.en: He stooped to pick up the dropped glove, and his glasses slid off into the puddle.
stoop.zh: 他弯腰去捡掉的手套，眼镜却滑进了水洼里。

storehouse.en: The old granary now serves as a storehouse for the museum's spare frames and crates.
storehouse.zh: 老谷仓如今成了博物馆存放备用画框和木箱的仓库。

strait.en: Fishing boats waited out the storm in the narrow strait between the two islands.
strait.zh: 渔船在两岸岛屿之间那道狭窄的海峡里避过了风暴。

strap.en: She strapped the suitcase to the back of the motorbike with two bungee cords and a prayer.
strap.zh: 她用两根弹力绳把箱子绑在摩托车后座，全凭运气。

strenuous.en: The hike looked easy on the map but turned strenuous once the trail began climbing through loose scree.
strenuous.zh: 那条徒步路线在地图上看着不难，可一进入碎石坡往上爬就变得十分吃力。

stride.en: He crossed the courtyard in three long strides and caught the door before it clicked shut.
stride.zh: 他三大步穿过院子，在门咔哒一声关上之前把门按住了。

stripe.en: A single yellow stripe ran down the middle of the road, fading wherever the sun hit it hardest.
stripe.zh: 路中间只有一道黄线，被太阳晒得最狠的地方都褪色了。

structural.en: Engineers found structural cracks in the parking garage and closed the top two floors.
structural.zh: 工程师在停车楼里发现了结构裂缝，于是封了最上面两层。

studio.en: They converted the garage into a small studio where she could paint without waking the baby.
studio.zh: 他们把车库改成了小画室，这样她画画就不会把孩子吵醒。

stumble.en: Halfway up the stairs he stumbled on a loose tile and grabbed the railing.
stumble.zh: 上楼梯上到一半，他踩到一块松动的砖，踉跄一下抓住了扶手。

styles.en: The shop sells hats in three styles, and the smallest one still slips down over my ears.
styles.zh: 这家店的帽子有三种款式，最小的那种戴上去还是会滑到耳朵上。

subcommittee.en: The subcommittee on housing met on Thursdays in a basement room with one working window.
subcommittee.zh: 住房小组委员会每周四在一间只有一扇窗能用、位于地下室的房间里开会。

subdue.en: Two officers subdued the man without drawing weapons, and the crowd on the platform slowly went quiet.
subdue.zh: 两名警员没有拔枪就制服了那个人，站台上的人群慢慢安静下来。

submerge.en: The tide submerged the lower steps of the pier by noon, forcing the fishermen to move their buckets.
submerge.zh: 到中午潮水就淹没了码头下面的台阶，渔民只好把水桶挪走。

subordinate.en: He never treated the interns as subordinate staff; he asked their opinion before every design review.
subordinate.zh: 他从没把实习生当成下属，每次设计评审前都会问他们的看法。

subsequent.en: The first batch sold out in a day, and subsequent shipments arrived to much longer queues.
subsequent.zh: 第一批一天就卖光了，之后每批货到的时候排队的人都更多。

subside.en: The wind subsided after midnight, leaving the garden scattered with broken branches.
subside.zh: 午夜过后风停了，院子里满地都是断枝。

subsidiary.en: The airline's catering subsidiary supplies meals to four rival carriers as well.
subsidiary.zh: 这家航空公司的配餐子公司还给另外四家竞争对手供餐。

substantial.en: A substantial part of the budget went into drainage, which nobody notices until it rains.
substantial.zh: 预算相当大的一部分投进了排水，那个东西不下雨谁也不会注意。

substantiate.en: The reporter could not substantiate the claim, so the editor pulled the story an hour before print.
substantiate.zh: 记者无法证实那个说法，编辑在付印前一小时撤了稿。

subtitle.en: The documentary's subtitles lagged half a second behind the speakers, which made every joke land awkwardly.
subtitle.zh: 纪录片的字幕比说话慢半拍，搞得每个笑点都很尴尬。

succession.en: A succession of failed harvests pushed the village to sell its draft horses.
succession.zh: 接连几季歉收，逼得村里把耕马都卖了。

succinct.en: Her email was succinct: three lines, one question, no apology for the delay.
succinct.zh: 她的邮件很简洁：三行字，一个问题，也没为迟到道歉。

succumb.en: Three of the seedlings succumbed to mildew before we moved the tray to a sunnier sill.
succumb.zh: 我们把育苗盘挪到更向阳的窗台之前，有三株幼苗已经让霉菌弄死了。

suite.en: We booked a suite for the wedding party, mostly so the bride could dress somewhere with a mirror.
suite.zh: 我们为婚礼包了一间套房，主要想让新娘有个带镜子的地方换衣服。

sulphur.en: The hot spring smelled of sulphur, and our silver rings turned dark before we left.
sulphur.zh: 温泉有股硫磺味，我们的银戒指还没走就变黑了。

sundial.en: A cracked sundial stood in the middle of the rose garden, useless on cloudy days but beautiful anyway.
sundial.zh: 玫瑰园中间立着一只裂了的日晷，阴天毫无用处，可还是很好看。

superb.en: The view from the ridge was superb, though we had to eat lunch with our backs to the wind.
superb.zh: 山脊上的景色棒极了，只是我们得背着风吃午饭。

superintend.en: A retired teacher superintends the exam hall, walking slowly between the rows and saying nothing.
superintend.zh: 一位退休教师负责监考，在座位之间慢慢走动，一句话也不说。

supersede.en: The paper ticket was superseded by an app code, which promptly failed at the gate.
supersede.zh: 纸质票被手机里的二维码取代了，结果在闸机口当场刷不出来。

supersonic.en: The supersonic jet crossed the Atlantic in under four hours, and the passengers barely felt it.
supersonic.zh: 那架超音速客机不到四小时就飞过了大西洋，乘客几乎没感觉。

superstructure.en: Rust had eaten into the superstructure of the old ferry, so the company sold it for scrap.
superstructure.zh: 锈蚀已经吃进了那艘老渡轮的上层结构，公司索性把它当废铁卖了。

supervise.en: Two teachers supervised the science fair, mostly to keep the younger children away from the dry ice.
supervise.zh: 两名老师看着科学展，主要是怕年纪小的孩子去碰干冰。

supervisor.en: Her supervisor gave her Friday afternoons off to finish the course, no questions asked.
supervisor.zh: 她的主管每周五下午给她放假去上课，什么都没多问。

supplementary.en: The textbook came with supplementary worksheets that the teacher never used.
supplementary.zh: 这本教材附了补充练习，老师一次都没用过。

surcharge.en: Tickets bought at the door carry a five-euro surcharge, which the sign explains in very small print.
surcharge.zh: 现场买票要加收五欧元，告示上用非常小的字说明了。

surge.en: A surge in demand for firewood left the yard empty by the second week of November.
surge.zh: 柴火需求猛增，到十一月第二周，场地里就空了。

surmount.en: She surmounted a string of injuries to qualify for the final, then lost in straight sets.
surmount.zh: 她克服了一连串伤病打进决赛，然后连丢两盘输了。

surpass.en: Sales this quarter surpassed last year's by a wide margin, thanks to one video that went viral.
surpass.zh: 多亏一条视频火了，这季度销售额大幅超过去年同期。

suspend.en: The city suspended all ferry services at noon as the typhoon warning went up.
suspend.zh: 台风预警升级，市里中午就暂停了所有轮渡。

suspense.en: The novel keeps you in suspense until the last page, when the letter is finally opened.
suspense.zh: 这本小说把悬念吊到最后一页，那封信才终于被拆开。

suspension.en: The bridge's suspension cables hummed in the wind, a sound the locals called singing.
suspension.zh: 桥的悬索在风里嗡嗡作响，当地人管这叫唱歌。

sustenance.en: The monks grew most of their own sustenance on terraces cut into the hillside.
sustenance.zh: 僧侣们的大部分口粮都种在山坡上开出的梯田里。

swell.en: His ankle swelled up after the fall, so we iced it in a bag from the hotel ice machine.
swell.zh: 他摔倒后脚踝肿了起来，我们用旅馆制冰机装的一袋冰敷着。

swerve.en: The taxi swerved to avoid a dog and clipped the wing mirror of a parked car.
swerve.zh: 出租车为了躲一只狗猛打方向，蹭掉了一辆停放车辆的后视镜。

swing.en: Every afternoon the children swing on the rope tied to the oak branch until the dinner bell rings.
swing.zh: 每天下午孩子们在拴着橡树枝的绳子上荡来荡去，直到晚饭铃响。

swirl.en: Steam swirled above the soup pot, fogging the kitchen window.
swirl.zh: 热气在汤锅上方打转，把厨房窗户蒙了一层雾。

syllabus.en: The syllabus lists twelve readings, but the professor only ever discusses the first three.
syllabus.zh: 课程大纲上列了十二篇阅读，教授却只讲前三篇。

symmetry.en: The garden's symmetry was deliberate: two hedges, two benches, and a fountain exactly in the middle.
symmetry.zh: 这座花园的对称是刻意设计的：两道树篱、两张长椅，喷泉正好在中间。

sympathetic.en: The receptionist was sympathetic but firm — the room was booked, and there was nothing she could do.
sympathetic.zh: 前台很同情，但态度很坚决：房间已经订出去了，她也无能为力。

symposium.en: The symposium brought together forty researchers, and the coffee breaks did more for collaboration than the talks.
symposium.zh: 研讨会聚集了四十位研究者，而茶歇对合作的推动比报告本身大得多。

symptom.en: A dry cough was her only symptom, which is why she waited a week before seeing anyone.
symptom.zh: 她唯一的症状就是干咳，所以拖了一周才去看医生。

syndicate.en: A syndicate of local investors bought the failing newspaper and kept the printing press running.
syndicate.zh: 一个本地投资人组成的辛迪加买下了那家濒临倒闭的报纸，让印刷机继续转。
