synthesis.en: Her thesis is a synthesis of field notes, lab data, and three years of interviews.
synthesis.zh: 她的论文把田野笔记、实验数据和三年的访谈综合在了一起。

systematic.en: The librarian did a systematic check of every shelf and found four misplaced volumes.
systematic.zh: 图书管理员逐架系统地查了一遍，发现四本书放错了位置。

tablet.en: He crushed a tablet into a spoonful of honey so his son would actually swallow it.
tablet.zh: 他把一片药碾碎拌进一勺蜂蜜，这样儿子才肯咽下去。

taboo.en: In that village it is taboo to speak the drowned men's names, so people say 'those from the river'.
taboo.zh: 在那个村子里提溺水者的名字是禁忌，所以大家只说“河里那些人”。

tacit.en: They had a tacit agreement never to discuss the money, and it kept family dinners peaceful.
tacit.zh: 他们有个默契，从不谈钱，这让家里的饭桌一直很太平。

tame.en: The fox had been tamed enough to eat from a bowl, but it still bit anyone who touched its tail.
tame.zh: 那只狐狸被驯到肯用碗吃饭了，可谁碰它尾巴它还是咬人。

tamper.en: Someone had tampered with the meter, and the gas company refused to reconnect the supply.
tamper.zh: 有人动过煤气表，燃气公司拒绝恢复供气。

tangible.en: The renovation brought tangible benefits: shorter queues, warmer rooms, fewer complaints.
tangible.zh: 这次改造带来了实实在在的好处：排队短了、屋子暖了、投诉也少了。

tangle.en: The kite string tangled around the lamppost, and it took the two of us to bring it down.
tangle.zh: 风筝线缠在路灯杆上，我们俩才把它弄下来。

tariff.en: The new tariff raised the price of imported tiles by nearly a third.
tariff.zh: 新关税把进口瓷砖的价格抬高了将近三分之一。

tarnish.en: The scandal tarnished the club's reputation for years, even after the chairman resigned.
tarnish.zh: 那桩丑闻多年来一直玷污着俱乐部的名声，即便主席已经辞职。

taxation.en: Heavy taxation on tobacco did more to cut smoking than any poster campaign.
taxation.zh: 对烟草课以重税，比任何宣传海报都更能减少吸烟。

tease.en: My brother teased me about my cooking until he tasted the soup and asked for the recipe.
tease.zh: 我哥一直拿我的厨艺打趣，直到他尝了那锅汤，转头来要食谱。

technical.en: The manual is full of technical language that assumes you already know what a manifold is.
technical.zh: 这本手册满篇术语，默认你早就知道什么是歧管。

tedious.en: Copying the data by hand was tedious, but it caught three errors the software had missed.
tedious.zh: 手工抄数据很枯燥，可也因此发现了软件漏掉的三处错误。

teem.en: The rock pools teem with tiny crabs in early summer, and the school groups arrive by bus.
teem.zh: 初夏时潮池里全是小螃蟹，学校的孩子们一车一车地来。

telex.en: In 1979 the office received the news by telex, and someone taped the strip to the wall.
telex.zh: 1979 年，办公室是靠电传收到那条消息的，有人还把纸带贴在了墙上。

temperament.en: She has the temperament for emergency medicine: calm, quick, and hard to rattle.
temperament.zh: 她的性情适合干急诊：冷静、麻利、很难被扰乱。

tempo.en: The drummer slowed the tempo for the last verse so the room could sing along.
tempo.zh: 鼓手把最后一段的速度放慢，好让全场跟着唱。

tenable.en: That explanation was tenable in March but has collapsed now that the emails are public.
tenable.zh: 那个说法三月时还站得住，如今邮件公开了，就彻底垮了。

tenacious.en: He is tenacious in a quiet way — he simply keeps asking until the answer changes.
tenacious.zh: 他那种坚持是不动声色的：就一直问，直到答案变了为止。

tenancy.en: The tenancy agreement runs for two years, with a break clause after twelve months.
tenancy.zh: 租约为期两年，满十二个月后有解约条款。

tension.en: Tension in the room rose when the auditor asked for receipts nobody had kept.
tension.zh: 审计员要票据，可谁也没留，屋里的气氛一下就紧了。

tentacle.en: A squid's tentacle curled around the diver's wrist before it let go and vanished.
tentacle.zh: 一条鱿鱼的触手缠上了潜水员的手腕，然后松开，消失在暗处。

tentative.en: We made tentative plans to meet in April, knowing the baby might rearrange everything.
tentative.zh: 我们初步定了四月见面，心里都清楚孩子一出生什么都得改。

terminate.en: The company terminated the contract after two missed deadlines and one very awkward phone call.
terminate.zh: 在错过两次截止日期、打了一通非常尴尬的电话之后，公司终止了合同。

terrace.en: We ate on the terrace above the harbour, watching the fishing boats come back at dusk.
terrace.zh: 我们在海港上方的露台上吃饭，看着渔船黄昏时回港。

terrestrial.en: Most of these frogs are terrestrial, so they drown if the water rises above their toes.
terrestrial.zh: 这些青蛙大多是陆生的，水一淹过脚趾它们就会被淹死。

terrify.en: The narrow mountain road would terrify anyone, and my mother kept her eyes shut for most of it.
terrify.zh: 那条窄山路谁走都得害怕，我妈大半程都闭着眼。

territorial.en: The cat is territorial about the hallway and will block the dog from passing.
territorial.zh: 那只猫把走廊当自己的地盘，会拦着狗不让过。

terse.en: His reply was terse — 'Not now' — and I did not ask again that week.
terse.zh: 他的回答只有一句“现在不行”，那一周我就没再问。

tertiary.en: She works in tertiary education, training nurses at a college outside the city.
tertiary.zh: 她在高等教育领域工作，在城郊一所学院培训护士。

textile.en: The town's textile mills closed in the nineties, and the river finally ran clear again.
textile.zh: 镇上的纺织厂九十年代陆续关门，那条河终于又变清了。

thereby.en: The new road bypasses the village, thereby cutting the morning traffic in half.
thereby.zh: 新修的路绕过了村子，早高峰的车流因此少了一半。

thesaurus.en: I keep a thesaurus on the desk, though most days I use it to look up words I already know.
thesaurus.zh: 我桌上放着一本同义词词典，可多数时候我只是拿它查自己已经会的词。

thigh.en: He tore a muscle in his thigh during the final sprint and had to be carried off.
thigh.zh: 他在最后冲刺时拉伤了大腿肌肉，只能被人抬下场。

thorough.en: The mechanic did a thorough check of the brakes and found the pads worn down to metal.
thorough.zh: 修车师傅把刹车彻底检查了一遍，发现刹车片已经磨到铁了。

thrill.en: It was a thrill to see the first seedling break through the soil after three failed attempts.
thrill.zh: 三次失败之后看见第一株幼苗破土，那种激动难以形容。

thriller.en: We watched a thriller about a translator who overhears the wrong conversation.
thriller.zh: 我们看了部惊悚片，讲一个译员不小心听到了不该听的对话。

tide.en: The tide came in faster than the tourists expected, and their sandals floated away.
tide.zh: 潮水涨得比游客预想的快，他们的凉鞋都漂走了。

tile.en: One tile in the bathroom is loose, and it clicks every time someone steps on it.
tile.zh: 浴室有一块地砖松了，谁踩上去都会咔哒响。

tilt.en: She tilted the umbrella against the sun and read until the shade moved off her.
tilt.zh: 她把伞斜过来挡太阳，一直读到阴影移开为止。

timidity.en: His timidity in meetings hid a sharp mind that only came out over lunch.
timidity.zh: 他在会上显得胆小，其实脑子很利，只有吃午饭时才显出来。

tinge.en: The sky had a faint tinge of orange above the hills, an hour before sunrise.
tinge.zh: 日出前一小时，山头上方的天空泛着一丝淡淡的橘色。

toddle.en: The toddler toddled across the kitchen and grabbed the dog's tail with both hands.
toddle.zh: 那孩子摇摇晃晃走过厨房，两只手一把抓住狗尾巴。

tonic.en: A cold beer on the balcony was exactly the tonic I needed after the audit.
tonic.zh: 审计结束后，阳台上那罐冰啤酒正是我需要的提神良药。

tornado.en: A tornado touched down outside town, flattening a barn but sparing the house next door.
tornado.zh: 一场龙卷风在镇外落地，把一座谷仓夷平，隔壁的房子却没事。

torrent.en: The storm turned the creek into a torrent that carried off the footbridge.
torrent.zh: 暴雨把那条小溪变成了激流，把小木桥整个冲走了。

touchy.en: Money is a touchy subject in that family, so we talk about the weather instead.
touchy.zh: 在那个家里钱是个敏感话题，所以我们干脆聊天气。

touring.en: The band spent the summer touring small venues, sleeping in the van to save money.
touring.zh: 乐队整个夏天在小场地巡演，为了省钱睡在面包车里。

toxic.en: The factory left toxic waste in the marsh, and the fish have not come back.
toxic.zh: 工厂把有毒废料留在了沼泽里，鱼就再没回来过。

tract.en: Vast tracts of the plain are still given over to wheat, though the farms are shrinking.
tract.zh: 平原上大片土地仍种着小麦，虽然农场正在缩小。

traction.en: The boots gave good traction on wet rock, which is why the guide insists on them.
traction.zh: 那双靴子在湿岩面上抓地很好，所以向导非让人穿它不可。

trait.en: Patience is the trait he values most in new hires, more than any certificate.
trait.zh: 在新人身上他最看重的品质是耐心，比任何证书都重要。

tramp.en: We tramped through six kilometres of mud to reach the lighthouse, and it was closed.
tramp.zh: 我们在泥里走了六公里才到灯塔，结果关门了。

transaction.en: The bank flagged the transaction because it came from a country she had never visited.
transaction.zh: 银行把那笔交易标了出来，因为汇款来自一个她从未去过的国家。

transcend.en: The best of her photographs transcend the subject — they are about light more than about people.
transcend.zh: 她最好的那些照片超越了题材本身，更多是在拍光，而不是拍人。

transcript.en: The university sent the transcript by post, and it arrived creased from the rain.
transcript.zh: 学校把成绩单邮寄过来，到手时已被雨淋得皱巴巴。

transfuse.en: The hospital transfused two units of blood before her colour came back.
transfuse.zh: 医院给她输了两袋血，她的脸色才缓过来。

transgress.en: He had transgressed the club's rules once too often, and the committee finally acted.
transgress.zh: 他违反俱乐部规定的次数实在太多，委员会终于出手了。

transit.en: Our luggage went missing in transit and turned up three days later in Lisbon.
transit.zh: 我们的行李在运输途中丢了，三天后在里斯本冒了出来。

translucent.en: The bathroom window is translucent, so the neighbours see shapes but no details.
translucent.zh: 浴室的窗是半透明的，邻居能看见轮廓，看不清细节。

transparent.en: The council promised a transparent process, then held the key meeting without minutes.
transparent.zh: 市议会承诺过程透明，结果关键会议连会议记录都没有。

transplant.en: The rose was transplanted in autumn, and it sulked for a whole season before flowering.
transplant.zh: 那株玫瑰秋天被移栽，结果闹了整整一季别扭才开花。

trauma.en: The fall left him with a bad knee and a lingering trauma about ladders.
trauma.zh: 那次摔下来让他膝盖落下了伤，还留下对梯子的心理阴影。

traverse.en: The trail traverses the ridge for four kilometres before dropping into the valley.
traverse.zh: 小径沿着山脊横穿四公里，然后下到谷底。

treatise.en: He published a short treatise on grain storage that farmers still quote.
treatise.zh: 他发表过一篇论谷物储存的短文，农民至今还在引用。

trek.en: We trekked for two days to the village, and the last hour was entirely uphill.
trek.zh: 我们走了两天才到那个村子，最后一段全是上坡。

trench.en: Workers dug a trench along the road to lay new cables, and the street stayed closed for a month.
trench.zh: 工人们沿路挖了一条沟铺设新电缆，那条街封了整整一个月。

trend.en: The trend toward smaller cars is visible even in rural dealerships now.
trend.zh: 如今连乡下经销商那儿都能看出车子越做越小的趋势。

trespass.en: Anyone who trespasses on the airfield will be prosecuted, and the signs say so twice.
trespass.zh: 任何人擅自进入机场都会被告，告示牌上写了两遍。

tributes.en: Tributes poured in from former students who remembered his evening lectures.
tributes.zh: 昔日学生纷纷致意，都记得他晚上的课。

trickle.en: Water trickled from a crack in the pipe and had soaked the floor by morning.
trickle.zh: 水从管子的裂缝里一点点渗出来，到早上地板已经泡透了。

trinity.en: The old church is dedicated to the Trinity, and its bell still rings at six.
trinity.zh: 那座老教堂供奉的是三位一体，钟至今还在六点敲响。

trolley.en: She pushed the trolley down the aisle, dodging a display of tinned tomatoes.
trolley.zh: 她推着购物车走过货道，绕开一堆番茄罐头。

tropic.en: The ship crossed the Tropic of Capricorn at dawn, and the crew handed out printed certificates.
tropic.zh: 天亮时船越过南回归线，船员给乘客发了印好的纪念证书。

troupe.en: A dance troupe from the coast performed in the square, and the children copied every step.
troupe.zh: 一支从海边来的舞蹈团在广场上表演，孩子们跟着学每一个动作。

truce.en: The neighbours called a truce over the fence dispute when the old man fell ill.
truce.zh: 那位老人病倒后，邻居们为篱笆的争吵暂时停了火。

tuck.en: She tucked the map under the windscreen wiper and hoped the rain would hold off.
tuck.zh: 她把地图塞在挡风玻璃雨刷下面，盼着别下雨。

tug.en: The dog tugged at the lead whenever a cyclist passed, nearly pulling me off the kerb.
tug.zh: 只要有骑车的人经过，狗就猛拽牵绳，差点把我拽下路缘。

tumble.en: Books tumbled off the shelf when the lorry went past, and nobody bothered to pick them up.
tumble.zh: 卡车一过，书就从架子上掉了下来，可没人愿意去捡。

tumour.en: The scan found a small tumour, but the specialist said it was slow-growing and operable.
tumour.zh: 检查发现了一个小肿瘤，但专家说它长得慢，可以手术。

tumult.en: The tumult in the hall died down as soon as the head teacher raised one hand.
tumult.zh: 校长一举手，礼堂里的喧闹立刻平息下来。

tunnels.en: The old railway tunnels were sealed with brick in the seventies and are now full of bats.
tunnels.zh: 那些废弃的铁路隧道七十年代就用砖封死了，如今里面全是蝙蝠。

turbulent.en: The flight was turbulent for a full hour, and the seatbelt sign never went off.
turbulent.zh: 那趟航班足足颠了一小时，系好安全带的指示灯一直没灭。

turf.en: They replaced the turf in the goal area, which had turned to mud by November.
turf.zh: 他们把球门区的草皮换了，那块地方到十一月已经全是泥。

turmoil.en: The company was in turmoil for months after the founder left without naming a successor.
turmoil.zh: 创始人没指定接班人就走人之后，公司乱了好几个月。

tutorial.en: The online tutorial walks you through the software in twenty short videos.
tutorial.zh: 这个在线教程用二十个短视频带你把软件过一遍。

twig.en: A twig snapped under his boot, and the deer was gone before he lifted the camera.
twig.zh: 一根细枝在他靴子底下折断，他还没举起相机，鹿就跑了。

twilight.en: In the twilight the orchard looked blue, and the bats came out over the pond.
twilight.zh: 暮色里果园泛着蓝色，蝙蝠在池塘上方飞了出来。

twinkle.en: Fairy lights twinkled along the fence, and the power cut at nine anyway.
twinkle.zh: 彩灯沿着篱笆一闪一闪，结果九点还是停电了。

tyrannical.en: The foreman was tyrannical about breaks, timing lunch with a stopwatch.
tyrannical.zh: 那个工头管休息管得很霸道，拿秒表给午休计时。

ultimatum.en: The landlord issued an ultimatum: pay by Friday or leave by Monday.
ultimatum.zh: 房东下了最后通牒：周五前交钱，不然周一搬走。

unconditional.en: Her grandmother's support was unconditional, which is why she always called her first.
unconditional.zh: 她奶奶的支持是无条件的，所以她有事总是先打给她。

unconvincing.en: His excuse sounded unconvincing, and even he seemed embarrassed saying it.
unconvincing.zh: 他的借口听着就不可信，说的时候他自己都有点窘。

undergraduate.en: As an undergraduate she washed dishes in a restaurant to pay for her textbooks.
undergraduate.zh: 读本科时她在一家餐馆洗碗，好挣出教材钱。

underline.en: The teacher underlined the last sentence twice but never explained what it meant.
underline.zh: 老师把最后一句划了两道线，却从没解释那是什么意思。

undermine.en: Constant delays undermined the team's confidence in the new schedule.
undermine.zh: 一再拖延让团队对新排期失去了信心。

underwrite.en: A local bank agreed to underwrite the festival, on condition that its logo appeared on every poster.
underwrite.zh: 一家本地银行同意为艺术节出资，条件是每张海报上都要有它的标志。

undue.en: The report found no undue delay, though the family disagreed loudly.
undue.zh: 报告认为不存在不当延误，可家属当场就大声反对。

uneven.en: The floor is uneven near the door, and the chair rocks unless you fold a menu under one leg.
uneven.zh: 门口那块地板不平，不垫张菜单在椅腿下面椅子就晃。

unfold.en: The story unfolded slowly over dinner, one detail at a time.
unfold.zh: 那件事在晚饭桌上一点点展开，一顿饭只说一个细节。

ungainly.en: The heron looks ungainly on land and utterly precise the moment it enters the water.
ungainly.zh: 苍鹭在岸上显得笨拙，一进水就精准得不得了。

unilateral.en: The board made a unilateral decision to close the branch, without consulting the staff.
unilateral.zh: 董事会单方面决定关掉那家分行，完全没跟员工商量。

unreliable.en: The bus is unreliable in winter, so most people walk the last kilometre.
unreliable.zh: 冬天公交很不靠谱，所以大多数人最后那一公里都靠走。

unrest.en: Rising bread prices led to unrest in the capital, and the shops shut early for a week.
unrest.zh: 面包涨价引发了首都的动荡，商铺整整一周都提前关门。

unsocial.en: Nursing involves unsocial hours, which is the main reason the ward is short-staffed.
unsocial.zh: 护理工作要上不合常规的班，这也是病房人手不足的主要原因。

untold.en: The flood caused untold damage to the lower farms, most of which was never counted.
untold.zh: 洪水给低处的农场造成了难以估量的损失，其中大部分根本没被统计过。

uphold.en: The appeals court refused to overturn the ruling and chose to uphold it, so the company had to rebuild the fence.
uphold.zh: 上诉法院拒绝推翻原判，选择维持，公司只好把篱笆重新修起来。

upkeep.en: The upkeep of the old house costs more each year than the family earns.
upkeep.zh: 那栋老房子的维护费一年比一年高，早就超过了这家人挣的钱。

upright.en: She sat upright for the whole journey because her back hurt whenever she leaned.
upright.zh: 整趟路上她都坐得笔直，因为一靠后背就疼。

uprising.en: The uprising began in the market square and was over within three days.
uprising.zh: 起义从集市广场开始，三天之内就结束了。

urchin.en: A sea urchin had lodged itself in the rock pool, its spines catching the light.
urchin.zh: 一只海胆卡在潮池里，刺在光下闪着亮。

utility.en: The utility company cut the water for six hours without warning anyone.
utility.zh: 自来水公司没通知任何人就把水停了六个小时。

vacancies.en: The hotel has vacancies in March, but by June you must book months ahead.
vacancies.zh: 这家酒店三月还有空房，可到了六月就得提前几个月订。

vacancy.en: There is one vacancy on the committee, and two people have already applied.
vacancy.zh: 委员会有一个空缺，已经有两个人报名了。

valuation.en: The valuation came in far below what they had paid, and the loan fell through.
valuation.zh: 估价远低于他们当初的买价，贷款就黄了。

valve.en: The plumber replaced a valve behind the boiler and charged for ninety minutes' work.
valve.zh: 水管工换了锅炉后面的一个阀门，按九十分钟工时收费。

vanity.en: The film is more about vanity than love, though the poster suggests otherwise.
vanity.zh: 这部片子讲的其实是虚荣而不是爱情，虽然海报上看着不像。

vanquish.en: The champion vanquished his old rival in straight sets and then hugged him at the net.
vanquish.zh: 卫冕者直落两盘击败了老对手，随即在网前抱住了他。

variant.en: A rare variant of the virus appeared in two coastal towns in late spring.
variant.zh: 春末，这种病毒的一种罕见变异株出现在两个沿海城镇。

variation.en: There is wide variation in the quality of school lunches, depending on who cooks them.
variation.zh: 学校午餐的质量差别很大，全看当天是谁掌勺。

vegetation.en: Thick vegetation closed over the path, and we lost the trail within minutes.
vegetation.zh: 茂密的草木把小路盖住了，我们几分钟内就找不着路了。

vehement.en: She was vehement that the meeting should be recorded, and she got her way.
vehement.zh: 她极力主张会议必须录音，最后她赢了。

veil.en: A thin veil of mist covered the lake until the sun burned it off.
veil.zh: 湖上蒙着一层薄雾，直到太阳把它晒散。

vein.en: The nurse found a vein on the second attempt, apologising for the first.
vein.zh: 护士第二次才找到血管，还替第一次没扎中道了歉。

velocity.en: The turbine spins faster as the wind velocity rises, up to a built-in safety limit.
velocity.zh: 风速升高时涡轮转得更快，但到内置的安全限值就封顶了。

velvet.en: The curtains are heavy red velvet, and they keep out both light and noise.
velvet.zh: 窗帘是厚重的红色丝绒，既挡光又隔音。

ventilate.en: The workshop must be ventilated properly before anyone starts welding.
ventilate.zh: 有人开始焊接之前，车间必须充分通风。

versed.en: She is well versed in contract law, having spent a decade reviewing leases.
versed.zh: 她精通合同法，审租约审了十年。

versus.en: The debate was framed as tradition versus progress, which suited neither side.
versus.zh: 辩论被框成传统对进步，可两边都不满意这种说法。

vertical.en: The climbers chose a vertical route up the north face, and it took them two days.
vertical.zh: 登山者选了北壁一条垂直路线，走了两天。

vessel.en: A fishing vessel drifted into the harbour with a broken engine and a very tired crew.
vessel.zh: 一艘渔船引擎坏了，载着疲惫不堪的船员漂进了港。

vex.en: The delay vexed him more than the cost, because waiting was what he could not stand.
vex.zh: 让他恼火的不是钱，而是拖延，他最受不了等。

viable.en: Solar power is now a viable option for the farm, even without subsidies.
viable.zh: 如今即便没有补贴，太阳能对这家农场来说也是个可行的选择。

vigilant.en: The guards stayed vigilant through the night shift, mostly to stay awake.
vigilant.zh: 保安在夜班一直保持警觉，多半是为了不让自己睡着。

vigorous.en: He took vigorous exercise at sixty and could still outwalk his sons.
vigorous.zh: 他六十岁还做剧烈运动，走路比儿子们都快。

vindicate.en: The audit vindicated the accountant, who had been blamed for the missing receipts.
vindicate.zh: 审计还了那名会计清白，之前丢票据的事都算在他头上。

virtually.en: Virtually every seat was taken by eight, and people stood in the aisle.
virtually.zh: 八点不到座位几乎坐满了，有人只能站在过道里。

virtuous.en: She made a virtuous show of recycling everything, then drove two blocks to the shop.
virtuous.zh: 她把回收做得很有道德感的样子，然后开车两个街区去商店。

visas.en: Our visas were approved in ten days, faster than the agency had promised.
visas.zh: 我们的签证十天就批了，比中介承诺的还快。

visual.en: The app's visual design is lovely, but the search barely works.
visual.zh: 这个应用的视觉设计很好看，可搜索功能基本不能用。

visualize.en: It helps to visualize the finished room before you buy the paint.
visualize.zh: 买涂料之前先在心里把刷好的房间想一遍，会很有帮助。

vivid.en: I have a vivid memory of the kitchen at four in the morning, everyone laughing.
vivid.zh: 我清楚记得凌晨四点的厨房，所有人都在笑。

volatile.en: The market has been volatile since the announcement, and small investors are nervous.
volatile.zh: 消息公布后市场一直剧烈波动，小投资者都很紧张。

vow.en: They made a vow to keep the orchard going, and they planted twelve new trees that spring.
vow.zh: 他们发誓要把果园撑下去，那年春天就种了十二棵新树。

wager.en: He wagered a week's wages on one horse and lost without much complaint.
wager.zh: 他把一周的工资押在一匹马上，输了也没怎么抱怨。

waggon.en: A waggon loaded with hay blocked the lane for a full ten minutes.
waggon.zh: 一辆装满干草的大车把小路堵了整整十分钟。

wail.en: The baby wailed in the next room, and the sitter walked the corridor with her.
wail.zh: 婴儿在隔壁哭个不停，保姆抱着她在走廊里来回走。

wane.en: Her enthusiasm for the club waned once the membership fees went up.
wane.zh: 会费一涨，她对那个俱乐部就没那么热乎了。

ward.en: He was moved to a quieter ward after the first night, where he finally slept.
ward.zh: 第一晚之后他被转到一间更安静的病房，终于睡着了。

wardrobe.en: The wardrobe is too tall for the bedroom, so it stands in the hall.
wardrobe.zh: 那个衣柜对卧室来说太高了，只好放在走廊里。

watchdog.en: An independent watchdog reviews every complaint the company receives.
watchdog.zh: 一家独立监督机构会审查公司收到的每一起投诉。

water-clock.en: The museum's water-clock drips steadily, marking the hours without any moving parts.
water-clock.zh: 博物馆里那座水钟一滴一滴稳稳地走，没有任何活动部件也能记时。

water-skiing.en: He tried water-skiing for the first time and spent most of it underwater.
water-skiing.zh: 他第一次尝试滑水，大半时间都在水下。

waver.en: Her voice wavered on the last line of the song, and the pianist covered for her.
waver.zh: 唱到最后一句她的声音抖了，琴师替她把场面圆了回来。

wax.en: Candle wax had pooled across the saucer and set hard overnight.
wax.zh: 烛泪流满了托盘，过夜就凝硬了。

wedge.en: He jammed a wedge under the door to keep it open while he carried boxes in.
wedge.zh: 他往门底下塞了个楔子让门敞着，好往里搬箱子。

weld.en: The gate was welded shut after the second break-in.
weld.zh: 第二次遭窃之后，那扇铁门被焊死了。

westerner.en: The shopkeeper could tell a westerner from a local by the way they haggled.
westerner.zh: 店主凭讲价的架势就能分辨出哪个是西方人、哪个是本地人。

wetland.en: The wetland behind the school floods every spring and fills with herons.
wetland.zh: 学校后面的湿地每年春天都涨水，来满了苍鹭。

whereby.en: They agreed on a scheme whereby the farmer is paid for every tree that survives.
whereby.zh: 他们谈定了一个方案：农民每种活一棵树就拿一份钱。

whirl.en: The dancers whirled across the floor until the band took a break.
whirl.zh: 舞者在地板上旋转不停，直到乐队中场休息。

wholesale.en: He buys flour wholesale and sells it in small bags at the market.
wholesale.zh: 他整批进面粉，再分装成小袋拿到集市上卖。

wield.en: The mayor wields more influence than the council, though on paper they are equal.
wield.zh: 市长的影响力比议会大，虽然纸面上两者平级。

wilderness.en: Beyond the last fence lies wilderness, and the rangers advise against walking it alone.
wilderness.zh: 最后一道围栏之外就是荒野，护林员建议不要一个人走。

withhold.en: The company decided to withhold payment until the final inspection passed.
withhold.zh: 公司决定先扣着款不付，直到最终验收合格。

wollongong.en: She studied engineering in Wollongong and stayed on to work at the steelworks.
wollongong.zh: 她在伍伦贡读工程，毕业后留下来在钢厂工作。

workload.en: Her workload doubled when a colleague left, and nobody was hired to replace him.
workload.zh: 同事走了以后她的工作量翻了一倍，也没人补上那个位置。

workshops.en: The museum runs weekend workshops for children, mostly on pottery and printmaking.
workshops.zh: 博物馆周末给孩子办工作坊，主要是陶艺和版画。

wreathe.en: The doorway was wreathed in paper flowers for the wedding.
wreathe.zh: 为了婚礼，门口缠满了纸花。

wrench.en: He wrenched the window open and climbed out onto the fire escape.
wrench.zh: 他使劲把窗户撬开，爬到了消防梯上。

wrestle.en: Two men wrestled with the tarpaulin as the wind tried to take it.
wrestle.zh: 两个人跟防雨布较劲，风一个劲儿地想把它掀走。

wretched.en: The wretched little heater gave out on the coldest night of the year.
wretched.zh: 那台可怜的小暖气在一年里最冷的夜里坏了。

wrinkle.en: Wrinkles in the map made the river look as if it doubled back on itself.
wrinkle.zh: 地图上的褶皱让那条河看起来像是折回了原处。

wrought.en: The gate is wrought iron, made by a smith three villages away.
wrought.zh: 那扇门是锻铁做的，出自三个村子外一位铁匠之手。

yarn.en: She wound the yarn into a ball while telling us about the flood.
yarn.zh: 她一边把毛线绕成球，一边跟我们讲那场洪水。

yoke.en: The oxen were yoked together before the plough was lifted into place.
yoke.zh: 犁还没架好，两头牛就先被套上了轭。

youngster.en: A youngster on the touchline asked for his autograph, and he stayed to sign it.
youngster.zh: 边线旁一个小孩找他要签名，他停下来签了。

zest.en: She attacked the renovation with zest, tearing out the old kitchen single-handed.
zest.zh: 她干劲十足地扑在装修上，一个人把旧厨房拆了。

zoology.en: He studied zoology because he wanted to work with bats, and now he does.
zoology.zh: 他学动物学是因为想研究蝙蝠，现在真的在做。

amplify.en: The hall's curved ceiling amplified every whisper, so the speaker kept her voice low.
amplify.zh: 大厅的弧形天花板把每声耳语都放大了，演讲者只好压低声音。

contemplate.en: She sat on the step contemplating whether to knock or simply walk away.
contemplate.zh: 她坐在台阶上，琢磨着是敲门，还是干脆转身走。

contingency.en: The expedition budget keeps a fund for contingencies such as a broken radio or a sudden storm.
contingency.zh: 探险预算里留了一笔应急款，用来应付电台故障或突降暴风这类情况。

defy.en: That old tree has defied every storm that came across the valley.
defy.zh: 那棵老树扛住了穿过山谷的每一场风暴。

embody.en: The old station embodies everything people love about this town.
embody.zh: 这座老车站装下了人们喜欢这座镇子的全部理由。

exemplify.en: The little market exemplifies how much the town has changed.
exemplify.zh: 这个小市集正好说明这座镇子变了多少。

fortify.en: Workers fortified the sea wall with concrete blocks after the last flood.
fortify.zh: 上次洪水过后，工人用混凝土块加固了海堤。

incite.en: Three men were charged with inciting violence outside the courthouse.
incite.zh: 三名男子因在法院外煽动暴力被起诉。

intensify.en: After the dog was spotted near the quarry, the search intensified.
intensify.zh: 有人在采石场附近看到那条狗后，搜寻加紧了。

levy.en: On every van entering the old town, the council levies a small charge.
levy.zh: 凡进入老城的货车，市政都要收一点费用。

lounge.en: We spent the afternoon lounging by the pool while the kids built sandcastles.
lounge.zh: 整个下午我们都在池边闲着，孩子们在堆沙堡。

magnify.en: This lens magnifies the print about ten times, so every crack in the paper shows.
magnify.zh: 这块镜片能把字迹放大约十倍，纸上每条裂纹都藏不住。

nicety.en: The legal niceties of the contract were lost on everyone at the table.
nicety.zh: 合同里那些法律细节，在座没人听得懂。

nullify.en: A single missing signature nullifies the whole agreement.
nullify.zh: 少一个签名，整份协议就作废。

rally.en: The team rallied in the last ten minutes and won by a single point.
rally.zh: 球队在最后十分钟咬牙追了回来，赢了一分。

rectify.en: Within five working days, the bank has promised, the error will be rectified.
rectify.zh: 银行承诺在五个工作日内把这个错误改过来。

signify.en: A red flag on the beach signifies that swimming is forbidden.
signify.zh: 海滩上挂红旗表示禁止游泳。

simplify.en: The new form simplifies the whole process to one page instead of six.
simplify.zh: 新表格把整个流程简化成一页，原来是六页。

flee.en: When the fire alarm rang, the whole family had to flee the building in slippers.
flee.zh: 火警一响，全家人只能穿着拖鞋逃出大楼。

overrun.en: The kitchen was overrun by ants after the sugar bag tore open.
overrun.zh: 糖袋破了以后，厨房里全是蚂蚁。

overthrow.en: The general plotted to overthrow the government within a year.
overthrow.zh: 这位将军密谋在一年内推翻政府。

slide.en: The children took turns sliding down the wet grass on cardboard.
slide.zh: 孩子们轮流坐在纸板上，从湿草地上滑下去。

fling.en: She flung her coat onto the chair and went straight to the stove.
fling.zh: 她把外套往椅子上一扔，径直走向灶台。
